DuelCanvas.jsx
JS
"use client";

/**
 * DuelCanvas — the procedural sword-fight renderer.
 *
 * Reads engine state from lib/sim.js every frame and paints the arena:
 * torch-lit crowd, dual spotlights, scarf-fluttering duelists, sword
 * trails, spark bursts, shockwave rings, floating damage numbers,
 * screen shake and slow-mo KO banners.
 *
 * Props:
 *   fightKey  — change to start a brand-new bout
 *   seed      — rng seed for the bout
 *   matchup   — { a, b } real names (engine keeps them blind-safe)
 *   speed     — 1 | 2 | 4
 *   paused    — freeze the world (still renders)
 *   sound     — enable synthesized sfx
 *   ambient   — hero mode: mini HP bars, no reliance on parent HUD
 *   onEvent   — engine events (turn/hp/line/ko/end)
 */

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { createFight } from "@/lib/sim";
import { play, setSoundMuted } from "@/lib/sound";

const W = 960;
const H = 540;
const GY = 452; // ground line

function makeCrowd() {
  const dots = [];
  let s = 12345;
  const rnd = () => {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647;
    return s / 2147483647;
  };
  for (let row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
      dots.push({
        x: 20 + rnd() * (W - 40),
        y: 44 + row * 30 + rnd() * 14,
        r: 1 + rnd() * 1.8,
        ph: rnd() * Math.PI * 2,
        sp: 1 + rnd() * 2.4,
        warm: rnd() < 0.72,
      });
    }
  }
  return dots;
}

export default function DuelCanvas({
  fightKey = 0,
  seed = 7,
  matchup = { a: "Fighter A", b: "Fighter B" },
  speed = 1,
  paused = false,
  sound = false,
  ambient = false,
  onEvent = () => {},
  className = "",
}) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const engineRef = useRef(null);
  const trailsRef = useRef([[], []]);
  const crowd = useMemo(makeCrowd, []);
  const liveRef = useRef({ speed, paused, sound, onEvent });
  liveRef.current = { speed, paused, sound, onEvent };

  // (re)create the bout
  useEffect(() => {
    const reduced =
      typeof window !== "undefined" &&
      window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const engine = createFight({
      seed,
      names: { ...matchup },
      onEvent: (e) => {
        if (e.type === "sfx") {
          if (liveRef.current.sound) play(e.name);
          return;
        }
        liveRef.current.onEvent(e);
      },
    });
    engine.state.reducedMotion = !!reduced;
    engineRef.current = engine;
    trailsRef.current = [[], []];
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [fightKey]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSoundMuted(!liveRef.current.sound);
  }, [sound]);

  // main loop
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    let raf = 0;
    let last = performance.now();

    const resize = () => {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * dpr));
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round((rect.width * H) / W * dpr));
    };
    resize();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
    ro.observe(canvas);

    const frame = (now) => {
      const engine = engineRef.current;
      if (engine) {
        engine.state.speed = liveRef.current.speed;
        engine.state.paused = liveRef.current.paused;
        engine.update((now - last) / 1000);
        draw(ctx, canvas, engine.state, crowd, trailsRef.current, liveRef.current.paused, ambient);
      }
      last = now;
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      ro.disconnect();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      role="img"
      aria-label={`Simulated duel: ${matchup.a} versus ${matchup.b}`}
      className={className}
      style={{ width: "100%", aspectRatio: `${W} / ${H}`, display: "block" }}
    />
  );
}

/* ============================== RENDER ============================== */

function draw(ctx, canvas, S, crowd, trails, paused, ambient) {
  const t = S.t;
  ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.width / W, 0, 0);

  // screen shake
  if (S.trauma > 0) {
    const m = S.trauma * S.trauma * 14;
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * m);
  }

  // sky
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  sky.addColorStop(0, "#080706");
  sky.addColorStop(0.55, "#12100c");
  sky.addColorStop(1, "#0b0908");
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

  // fighter glow orbs
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const f = S.fighters[i];
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, 300, 10, f.x, 300, 190);
    g.addColorStop(0, hexA(f.color, 0.16));
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(f.x - 200, 100, 400, 320);
  }

  // crowd torches
  for (const d of crowd) {
    const tw = 0.25 + 0.55 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * d.sp + d.ph));
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw;
    ctx.fillStyle = d.warm ? "#e8a33d" : "#8a8474";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // spotlight beams
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,244,220,0.045)";
  beam(ctx, 190, -10, 300, GY);
  beam(ctx, 770, -10, 660, GY);

  // floor
  const fl = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GY - 40, 0, H);
  fl.addColorStop(0, "#1b1510");
  fl.addColorStop(0.25, "#171310");
  fl.addColorStop(1, "#0b0908");
  ctx.fillStyle = fl;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, GY - 40, W + 40, H - GY + 60);

  // arena ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(232,163,61,0.28)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(W / 2, GY + 26, 330, 52, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(232,163,61,0.12)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(W / 2, GY + 26, 380, 66, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // floor etch lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(236,231,220,0.05)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
    const x = 120 + (i * (W - 240)) / 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + (x - W / 2) * 0.3, GY - 30);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // sword trails (under fighters)
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) drawTrail(ctx, trails[i], S.fighters[i].color);

  // fighters
  const [A, B] = S.fighters;
  drawFighter(ctx, A, B, t, trails[0]);
  drawFighter(ctx, B, A, t, trails[1]);

  // particles
  for (const p of S.particles) {
    const a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.kind === "ember" ? a * 0.8 : a;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    if (p.kind === "spark") {
      ctx.strokeStyle = p.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = p.size * 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - p.vx * 0.03, p.y - p.vy * 0.03);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // shockwave rings
  for (const r of S.rings) {
    const a = Math.max(0, r.life / r.maxLife);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.8;
    ctx.strokeStyle = r.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1 + 5 * a;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // floating combat text
  for (const fl2 of S.floaters) {
    const age = fl2.maxLife - fl2.life;
    const pop = age < 0.16 ? 0.6 + (age / 0.16) * 0.4 : 1;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, fl2.life / 0.4);
    ctx.font = `800 ${Math.round(fl2.size * pop)}px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)";
    ctx.strokeText(fl2.text, fl2.x, fl2.y);
    ctx.fillStyle = fl2.color;
    ctx.fillText(fl2.text, fl2.x, fl2.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // turn pip
  if (S.phase === "fight" || S.phase === "ko") {
    ctx.font = '700 19px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(232,163,61,0.92)";
    ctx.fillText(`TURN ${String(Math.max(1, S.turn)).padStart(2, "0")}`, W / 2, 34);
  }

  // ambient mini HP bars
  if (ambient) {
    hpBar(ctx, 24, 18, 200, S.fighters[0], false);
    hpBar(ctx, W - 224, 18, 200, S.fighters[1], true);
  }

  // intro card
  if (S.phase === "intro") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * 9);
    ctx.font = '700 44px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.lineWidth = 7;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.8)";
    ctx.strokeText("READY", W / 2, 210);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ece7dc";
    ctx.fillText("READY", W / 2, 210);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // KO / decision banner
  if (S.banner && S.bannerT > 0) {
    const age = (S.phase === "ended" ? 0.3 : 1.6 - S.bannerT);
    const pop = Math.min(1, age / 0.22);
    const sc = 0.5 + 0.5 * (1 - Math.pow(1 - pop, 3));
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W / 2, 215);
    ctx.scale(sc, sc);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = '700 116px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(255,90,31,0.8)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 46;
    ctx.lineWidth = 10;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.85)";
    ctx.strokeText(S.banner.big, 0, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillText(S.banner.big, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.font = '700 21px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffc547";
    ctx.fillText(S.banner.sub, W / 2, 262);
  }

  // hit flash
  if (S.flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,240,220,${(S.flash * 0.28).toFixed(3)})`;
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
  }

  // vignette
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.36, W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.95);
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

  if (paused) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
    ctx.font = '700 30px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ece7dc";
    ctx.fillText("PAUSED", W / 2, H / 2);
  }
}

function beam(ctx, xTop, yTop, xBot, yBot) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(xTop - 26, yTop);
  ctx.lineTo(xTop + 26, yTop);
  ctx.lineTo(xBot + 90, yBot);
  ctx.lineTo(xBot - 90, yBot);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function hpBar(ctx, x, y, w, f, right) {
  const pct = Math.max(0, f.hp / f.maxHp);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 10);
  const bw = w * pct;
  ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
  ctx.fillRect(right ? x + w - bw : x, y, bw, 10);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, w - 1, 9);
}

function hexA(hex, a) {
  const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16);
  const g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16);
  const b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
  return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${a})`;
}

/* ------------------------------ Fighter ------------------------------ */

function drawFighter(ctx, f, foe, t, trail) {
  const d = foe.x >= f.x ? 1 : -1; // facing
  const C = f.color;
  const st = f.state;
  const sT = f.stateT;

  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(f.x, GY + 8, 44, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  if (st === "down") {
    drawFallen(ctx, f, d, C);
    return;
  }

  const moving = Math.abs(f.vx) > 40;
  const bob = st === "victory" ? Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 7)) * -10 : Math.sin(t * 3.1 + f.seed) * 2.2;
  const crouch = st === "dodge" ? 16 : st === "strike" ? 7 : 0;
  const lean = st === "strike" ? 14 : st === "stagger" ? -16 : st === "dodge" ? -8 : st === "victory" ? 4 : moving ? 6 : 2;
  const runPh = t * 11 + f.seed;

  const hip = { x: f.x, y: GY - 54 + bob * 0.4 + crouch };
  const chest = { x: f.x + d * lean, y: hip.y - 48 };
  const neck = { x: chest.x + d * 3, y: chest.y - 8 };
  const head = { x: neck.x + d * 4, y: neck.y - 16 };

  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";

  // legs
  let fF, fB;
  if (st === "strike") {
    fF = { x: f.x + d * 46, y: GY };
    fB = { x: f.x - d * 26, y: GY };
  } else if (moving) {
    fF = { x: f.x + d * (20 + Math.sin(runPh) * 12), y: GY - Math.max(0, Math.sin(runPh + 1.4)) * 9 };
    fB = { x: f.x - d * (20 + Math.sin(runPh + Math.PI) * 12), y: GY - Math.max(0, Math.sin(runPh + Math.PI + 1.4)) * 9 };
  } else {
    fF = { x: f.x + d * 22, y: GY };
    fB = { x: f.x - d * 17, y: GY };
  }
  limb(ctx, hip, knee(hip, fF, d, 10), fF, 7, "#3a332b");
  limb(ctx, hip, knee(hip, fB, -d, 8), fB, 7, "#2e2822");

  // torso
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#453c30";
  ctx.lineWidth = 10;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(chest.x, chest.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  // belt glow
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x - 8, hip.y + 2);
  ctx.lineTo(hip.x + 8, hip.y + 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // sword arm + blade
  const shoulder = { x: chest.x, y: chest.y + 4 };
  let hand, bladeAng;
  if (st === "strike") {
    const p = Math.min(1, sT / 0.3);
    hand = { x: chest.x + d * (30 + p * 30), y: chest.y - 6 + p * 10 };
    bladeAng = d === 1 ? -1.9 + p * 2.5 : Math.PI + 1.9 - p * 2.5;
  } else if (st === "victory") {
    hand = { x: chest.x + d * 10, y: chest.y - 34 };
    bladeAng = -Math.PI / 2 + d * 0.18;
  } else if (st === "stagger") {
    hand = { x: chest.x - d * 6, y: chest.y + 26 };
    bladeAng = d === 1 ? 0.7 : Math.PI - 0.7;
  } else {
    const sway = Math.sin(t * 2.2 + f.seed) * 3;
    hand = { x: chest.x + d * 24, y: chest.y + 2 + sway };
    bladeAng = d === 1 ? -1.15 : Math.PI + 1.15;
  }
  limb(ctx, shoulder, { x: (shoulder.x + hand.x) / 2 + d * 4, y: (shoulder.y + hand.y) / 2 + 8 }, hand, 6, "#3a332b");

  const BL = st === "victory" ? 72 : 64;
  const tip = { x: hand.x + Math.cos(bladeAng) * BL, y: hand.y + Math.sin(bladeAng) * BL };
  // record trail while striking
  if (st === "strike") {
    trail.push({ x: tip.x, y: tip.y, life: 0.32, max: 0.32 });
    if (trail.length > 26) trail.shift();
  }
  // glow pass + white core
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = C;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 7;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hand.x, hand.y);
  ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.92;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hand.x, hand.y);
  ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // guard
  const gx = Math.cos(bladeAng + Math.PI / 2);
  const gy = Math.sin(bladeAng + Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a8474";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hand.x - gx * 8, hand.y - gy * 8);
  ctx.lineTo(hand.x + gx * 8, hand.y + gy * 8);
  ctx.stroke();

  // off arm
  const off = { x: chest.x - d * 16, y: chest.y + 24 };
  limb(ctx, shoulder, { x: chest.x - d * 12, y: chest.y + 12 }, off, 5, "#2e2822");

  // scarf — three fluttering segments
  const flutter = moving || st === "strike" ? 1.7 : 1;
  let sx = neck.x - d * 4;
  let sy = neck.y + 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
  for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
    sx -= d * 13;
    sy += Math.sin(t * 9 * flutter + f.seed + i * 1.3) * 4.5 * i * 0.5 + 2.4;
    ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // head + visor
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2b251f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(head.x, head.y, 12.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(C, 0.55);
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = C;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(head.x + d * 1, head.y - 1);
  ctx.lineTo(head.x + d * 12, head.y - 1);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFallen(ctx, f, d, C) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  const hip = { x: f.x, y: GY - 8 };
  const chest = { x: f.x - d * 40, y: GY - 14 };
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#38312a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 10;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(chest.x, chest.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2b251f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(chest.x - d * 16, chest.y - 4, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // limbs sprawled
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#332c25";
  ctx.lineWidth = 6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(hip.x + d * 26, GY - 2);
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(hip.x + d * 12, GY - 22);
  ctx.moveTo(chest.x, chest.y);
  ctx.lineTo(chest.x - d * 6, GY - 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  // dropped sword
  const sx = f.x + d * 34;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = C;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(sx, GY - 2);
  ctx.lineTo(sx + 52, GY - 22);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function knee(a, b, d, bend) {
  return { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2 + d * bend, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 + 2 };
}

function limb(ctx, a, mid, b, w, color) {
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = w;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
  ctx.lineTo(mid.x, mid.y);
  ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawTrail(ctx, trail, color) {
  for (let i = trail.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = trail[i];
    p.life -= 1 / 60;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      trail.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
  }
  if (trail.length < 2) return;
  for (let i = 1; i < trail.length; i++) {
    const a = trail[i - 1];
    const b = trail[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha = (b.life / b.max) * 0.55;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 8 * (i / trail.length) + 2;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
    ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

sound.js
JS
/**
 * Synthesized arena audio — zero assets, pure WebAudio.
 * whoosh / hit / clash / crit / ko / bell / click / reveal.
 */

let ctx = null;
let muted = false;
let noiseCache = null;

export function setSoundMuted(m) {
  muted = m;
}

function ac() {
  if (!ctx) {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return null;
    ctx = new AC();
  }
  if (ctx.state === "suspended") ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
  return ctx;
}

function noise(c) {
  if (noiseCache) return noiseCache;
  const len = c.sampleRate;
  const buf = c.createBuffer(1, len, c.sampleRate);
  const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
  noiseCache = buf;
  return buf;
}

function burst(c, t, { freq = 1200, q = 1, dur = 0.15, gain = 0.2, sweepTo = null, type = "bandpass" }) {
  const src = c.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = noise(c);
  const f = c.createBiquadFilter();
  f.type = type;
  f.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  if (sweepTo) f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(sweepTo, t + dur);
  f.Q.value = q;
  const g = c.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(gain, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + dur);
  src.connect(f).connect(g).connect(c.destination);
  src.start(t);
  src.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
}

function tone(c, t, { freq = 440, slideTo = null, dur = 0.15, gain = 0.15, type = "sine" }) {
  const o = c.createOscillator();
  o.type = type;
  o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t + dur);
  const g = c.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(gain, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + dur);
  o.connect(g).connect(c.destination);
  o.start(t);
  o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
}

export function play(name) {
  if (muted || typeof window === "undefined") return;
  try {
    const c = ac();
    if (!c) return;
    const t = c.currentTime;
    switch (name) {
      case "whoosh":
        burst(c, t, { freq: 500, sweepTo: 2600, dur: 0.16, gain: 0.10, q: 2 });
        break;
      case "hit":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 170, slideTo: 48, dur: 0.2, gain: 0.32 });
        burst(c, t, { freq: 300, dur: 0.12, gain: 0.16, type: "lowpass" });
        break;
      case "clash":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 1244, dur: 0.14, gain: 0.10, type: "square" });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 1866, dur: 0.11, gain: 0.08, type: "square" });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 932, dur: 0.18, gain: 0.10, type: "square" });
        burst(c, t, { freq: 5200, dur: 0.14, gain: 0.14, type: "highpass" });
        break;
      case "crit":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 150, slideTo: 44, dur: 0.24, gain: 0.36 });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 1567, dur: 0.16, gain: 0.10, type: "square" });
        burst(c, t, { freq: 4200, dur: 0.2, gain: 0.16, type: "highpass" });
        break;
      case "ko":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 95, slideTo: 28, dur: 0.7, gain: 0.5 });
        burst(c, t, { freq: 220, dur: 0.5, gain: 0.3, type: "lowpass" });
        tone(c, t + 0.05, { freq: 622, dur: 0.4, gain: 0.08, type: "triangle" });
        break;
      case "bell":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 880, dur: 0.6, gain: 0.12, type: "triangle" });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 1318, dur: 0.45, gain: 0.07, type: "triangle" });
        break;
      case "click":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 660, dur: 0.05, gain: 0.08, type: "square" });
        break;
      case "reveal":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 523, dur: 0.16, gain: 0.12, type: "triangle" });
        tone(c, t + 0.09, { freq: 659, dur: 0.16, gain: 0.12, type: "triangle" });
        tone(c, t + 0.18, { freq: 784, dur: 0.3, gain: 0.14, type: "triangle" });
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  } catch {
    /* audio unavailable — the show goes on silently */
  }
}

sim.js
JS
/**
 * Procedural duel engine.
 *
 * Owns ALL fight state: turn scheduling, fighter physics, particles,
 * screen shake, commentary lines and the result. The canvas renderer
 * (components/DuelCanvas.jsx) only reads this state and draws it.
 *
 * Blind-safe: commentary always says "Fighter A/B". Real names travel
 * only inside the final `end` event payload, revealed after the vote.
 */

export function mulberry32(a) {
  return function () {
    a |= 0;
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

const R = (rng, min, max) => min + rng() * (max - min);
const RI = (rng, min, max) => Math.floor(R(rng, min, max + 1));
const pick = (rng, arr) => arr[Math.floor(rng() * arr.length)];

const LINES = {
  open: [
    "The gate slams shut. Fighter A and Fighter B circle each other.",
    "Steel catches the torchlight. Neither fighter blinks first.",
    "The crowd hushes as the duelists take their marks.",
    "A tap of blades — pure disrespect. This one will be fast.",
    "The sand is fresh, the odds are even, the crowd is feral.",
  ],
  hit: [
    "{W} finds the gap — a clean cut across the guard!",
    "{W} punishes the whiffed parry. {L} staggers!",
    "A vicious exchange — {W} lands the telling blow on {L}.",
    "{W} fakes high, cuts low. Textbook cruelty.",
    "{L} overcommits and {W} makes them pay for it.",
  ],
  crit: [
    "CRITICAL! {W} nearly takes {L}'s head off with that swing!",
    "A devastating counter from {W} — {L} is on unsteady legs!",
    "{W} threads the needle — a perfect strike on {L}!",
  ],
  clash: [
    "CLASH — sparks shower the sand as steel meets steel.",
    "Blades lock! {W} and {L} grind edge-to-edge, neither yielding.",
    "A thunderous parry — the whole arena felt that one.",
    "{L} turns the blade aside at the last heartbeat. Superb defense.",
  ],
  miss: [
    "{W} swings at air — {L} was already gone.",
    "A wild lunge from {W}. {L} sidesteps with insulting ease.",
    "{L} reads it like a book and slips the strike.",
  ],
  ko: [
    "K.O.! {W} stands alone in the circle!",
    "IT'S OVER! A final, brutal exchange — {W} takes the duel!",
    "The sand drinks deep. {W} is victorious over {L}!",
  ],
  decision: [
    "The horn sounds! Judges score it for {W} on damage dealt.",
    "Time! A gruelling duel — the decision goes to {W}.",
  ],
};

function fill(template, w, l) {
  return template.replaceAll("{W}", w).replaceAll("{L}", l);
}

const W = 960; // internal arena units
const MARK_A = 340;
const MARK_B = 620;
const MIN_X = 90;
const MAX_X = 870;

export function createFight({ seed = 1, names = { a: "Fighter A", b: "Fighter B" }, onEvent = () => {} } = {}) {
  const rng = mulberry32(seed);
  const LA = "Fighter A";
  const LB = "Fighter B";

  const mk = (x, home, color) => ({
    x, home, vx: 0, hp: 100, maxHp: 100,
    state: "idle", stateT: 0, seed: rng() * 10, color,
  });

  const S = {
    t: 0,
    turn: 0,
    phase: "intro", // intro -> fight -> ko -> ended
    introT: 1.7,
    koT: 0,
    method: null,
    winner: null, // 0 | 1 | "draw"
    lastAttacker: 1,
    turnTimer: 0,
    slowmo: 1,
    trauma: 0,
    flash: 0,
    banner: null,
    bannerT: 0,
    fighters: [mk(60, MARK_A, "#ff5a1f"), mk(900, MARK_B, "#4da3ff")],
    impacts: [],
    particles: [],
    rings: [],
    floaters: [],
    log: [],
    speed: 1,
    paused: false,
    reducedMotion: false,
  };

  const emit = (e) => onEvent(e);
  const line = (turn, text, kind = "info") => {
    S.log.push({ turn, text });
    emit({ type: "line", turn, text, kind });
  };
  const hp = () =>
    emit({ type: "hp", turn: S.turn, a: Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[0].hp)), b: Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[1].hp)) });

  function burst(x, y, n, colors, power = 1) {
    const count = S.reducedMotion ? Math.ceil(n / 2) : n;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = R(rng, -Math.PI, Math.PI);
      const sp = R(rng, 90, 420) * power;
      S.particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 140,
        life: R(rng, 0.35, 0.9),
        maxLife: 0.9,
        size: R(rng, 1.5, 3.6),
        color: pick(rng, colors),
        grav: 950,
        kind: "spark",
      });
    }
    if (S.particles.length > 450) S.particles.splice(0, S.particles.length - 450);
  }

  function ring(x, y, color, max = 130) {
    S.rings.push({ x, y, r: 8, vr: 420, life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color, max });
  }

  function floater(x, y, text, color, size = 26) {
    S.floaters.push({ x, y, vy: -64, life: 1.05, maxLife: 1.05, text, color, size });
  }

  function shake(amount) {
    if (!S.reducedMotion) S.trauma = Math.min(1, S.trauma + amount);
  }

  function startKO(loser, method) {
    const winner = loser === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    S.phase = "ko";
    S.method = method;
    S.winner = winner;
    S.koT = method === "ko" ? 1.6 : 1.3;
    S.slowmo = S.reducedMotion ? 1 : 0.28;
    const L = S.fighters[loser];
    const Wn = S.fighters[winner];
    L.state = "down";
    L.vx = (loser === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 160;
    if (method === "ko") {
      Wn.state = "victory";
      Wn.vx = 0;
      burst(L.x, 360, 46, ["#ffc547", "#ff5a1f", "#ffffff", winner === 0 ? "#ff5a1f" : "#4da3ff"], 1.4);
      ring(L.x, 380, "#ffc547", 220);
      S.flash = S.reducedMotion ? 0 : 0.9;
      shake(1);
      S.banner = { big: "K.O.", sub: `${loser === 0 ? LB : LA} TAKES THE DUEL` };
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.ko), loser === 0 ? LB : LA, loser === 0 ? LA : LB), "ko");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "ko" });
      emit({ type: "ko", winner });
    } else {
      S.banner = { big: "DECISION", sub: `JUDGES SCORE IT FOR ${winner === 0 ? "FIGHTER A" : "FIGHTER B"}` };
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.decision), winner === 0 ? LA : LB, ""), "ko");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "bell" });
      emit({ type: "ko", winner });
    }
    S.bannerT = S.koT;
    hp();
  }

  function applyImpact(impact) {
    const { outcome, ai, di, dmg } = impact;
    const A = S.fighters[ai];
    const D = S.fighters[di];
    const AW = ai === 0 ? LA : LB;
    const DW = di === 0 ? LA : LB;
    const mx = (A.x + D.x) / 2;
    const my = 340;

    if (outcome === "miss") {
      D.state = "dodge";
      D.stateT = 0;
      D.vx += (di === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 120;
      floater(D.x, 250, "MISS", "#8a8474", 20);
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.miss), AW, DW), "info");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "whoosh" });
    } else if (outcome === "clash") {
      A.state = "recover";
      A.stateT = 0;
      D.state = "recover";
      D.stateT = 0;
      A.vx += (ai === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 90;
      D.vx += (di === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 90;
      burst(mx, my, 16, ["#ffc547", "#ffffff", "#e8a33d"], 1);
      ring(mx, my, "#e8a33d");
      shake(0.45);
      floater(mx, 240, "CLASH!", "#ffc547", 24);
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.clash), AW, DW), "clash");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "clash" });
    } else {
      const crit = outcome === "crit";
      D.hp -= dmg;
      D.state = "stagger";
      D.stateT = 0;
      D.vx += (di === 0 ? -1 : 1) * (crit ? 320 : 210);
      burst(D.x + (di === 0 ? 20 : -20), my, crit ? 24 : 12,
        crit ? ["#ffc547", "#ff5a1f", "#ffffff"] : [A.color, "#ffffff", "#ffc547"], crit ? 1.25 : 1);
      if (crit) {
        ring(D.x, my, "#ff5a1f");
        S.flash = S.reducedMotion ? 0 : 0.45;
      }
      shake(crit ? 0.9 : 0.55);
      floater(D.x, 240, crit ? `CRIT -${dmg}` : `-${dmg}`, crit ? "#ffc547" : "#ffffff", crit ? 30 : 26);
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, crit ? LINES.crit : LINES.hit), AW, DW), crit ? "crit" : "hit");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: crit ? "crit" : "hit" });
      hp();
      if (D.hp <= 0) {
        D.hp = 0;
        startKO(di, "ko");
        return;
      }
    }
    if (S.turn >= 40 && S.phase === "fight") {
      const [a, b] = S.fighters;
      if (Math.abs(a.hp - b.hp) < 4) {
        S.phase = "ko";
        S.method = "draw";
        S.winner = "draw";
        S.koT = 1.3;
        S.slowmo = 1;
        S.banner = { big: "DRAW", sub: "THE JUDGES CANNOT SPLIT THEM" };
        S.bannerT = S.koT;
        line(S.turn, "The horn sounds on a dead-even duel — a draw!", "ko");
        emit({ type: "sfx", name: "bell" });
        emit({ type: "ko", winner: "draw" });
      } else {
        startKO(a.hp < b.hp ? 0 : 1, "decision");
      }
    }
  }

  function doTurn() {
    S.turn += 1;
    const repeat = rng() < 0.3;
    const ai = repeat ? S.lastAttacker : 1 - S.lastAttacker;
    const di = 1 - ai;
    S.lastAttacker = ai;
    const A = S.fighters[ai];
    A.state = "strike";
    A.stateT = 0;
    A.vx += (ai === 0 ? 1 : -1) * 260;
    S.fighters[di].state = "brace";
    S.fighters[di].stateT = 0;

    const roll = rng();
    const outcome = roll < 0.12 ? "crit" : roll < 0.42 ? "clash" : roll < 0.58 ? "miss" : "hit";
    const dmg = outcome === "crit" ? RI(rng, 13, 21) : outcome === "hit" ? RI(rng, 6, 12) : 0;
    S.impacts.push({ at: S.t + 0.24, outcome, ai, di, dmg });
    emit({ type: "sfx", name: "whoosh" });
    emit({ type: "turn", turn: S.turn });
  }

  function update(rawDt) {
    if (S.paused || S.phase === "ended") return;
    const dt = Math.min(rawDt, 0.05) * S.speed;
    const worldDt = dt * (S.phase === "ko" ? S.slowmo : 1);
    S.t += worldDt;

    // ambient embers
    if (rng() < worldDt * 7 && S.particles.length < 450) {
      S.particles.push({
        x: R(rng, 40, W - 40), y: 560,
        vx: R(rng, -14, 14), vy: R(rng, -46, -18),
        life: R(rng, 4, 7), maxLife: 7,
        size: R(rng, 1, 2.4),
        color: pick(rng, ["#e8480c", "#e8a33d", "#ff5a1f"]),
        grav: -6, kind: "ember",
      });
    }

    if (S.phase === "intro") {
      S.introT -= dt;
      for (const f of S.fighters) {
        f.x += (f.home - f.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.2);
        f.stateT += worldDt;
      }
      if (S.introT <= 0) {
        S.phase = "fight";
        S.turnTimer = 0.55;
        line(0, pick(rng, LINES.open), "info");
        emit({ type: "sfx", name: "bell" });
        hp();
      }
    } else if (S.phase === "fight") {
      S.turnTimer -= dt;
      if (S.turnTimer <= 0) {
        doTurn();
        S.turnTimer = R(rng, 1.25, 1.7);
      }
    } else if (S.phase === "ko") {
      S.koT -= dt; // real-time countdown so slow-mo still ends
      S.bannerT = Math.max(0, S.bannerT - dt);
      if (S.koT <= 0) {
        S.phase = "ended";
        S.bannerT = 0;
        emit({
          type: "end",
          result: {
            winner: S.winner,
            method: S.method,
            turns: S.turn,
            names: { ...names },
            hp: [Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[0].hp)), Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[1].hp))],
            log: [...S.log],
          },
        });
      }
    }

    // impacts due
    for (let i = S.impacts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (S.impacts[i].at <= S.t) {
        const [im] = S.impacts.splice(i, 1);
        if (S.phase === "fight") applyImpact(im);
      }
    }

    // fighter physics
    for (const f of S.fighters) {
      f.stateT += worldDt;
      if ((f.state === "strike" || f.state === "stagger" || f.state === "dodge" || f.state === "recover" || f.state === "brace") && f.stateT > 0.55) {
        f.state = "idle";
        f.stateT = 0;
      }
      if (f.state !== "down") {
        const pull = (f.home - f.x) * 1.6;
        f.vx += pull * worldDt;
        f.vx *= Math.pow(0.06, worldDt); // friction
        f.x += f.vx * worldDt;
      } else {
        f.vx *= Math.pow(0.01, worldDt);
        f.x += f.vx * worldDt;
      }
      f.x = Math.max(MIN_X, Math.min(MAX_X, f.x));
    }

    // fx
    for (let i = S.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = S.particles[i];
      p.life -= worldDt;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        S.particles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      p.vy += p.grav * worldDt;
      p.x += p.vx * worldDt;
      p.y += p.vy * worldDt;
    }
    for (let i = S.rings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const r = S.rings[i];
      r.life -= worldDt;
      r.r += r.vr * worldDt;
      if (r.life <= 0 || r.r > r.max) S.rings.splice(i, 1);
    }
    for (let i = S.floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const fl = S.floaters[i];
      fl.life -= dt; // floaters ignore slow-mo so text stays readable
      fl.y += fl.vy * dt;
      if (fl.life <= 0) S.floaters.splice(i, 1);
    }
    S.trauma = Math.max(0, S.trauma - dt * 1.7);
    S.flash = Math.max(0, S.flash - dt * 2.4);
  }

  return { state: S, update };
}

Reveal.jsx
JS
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

/** Fades content up the first time it scrolls into view. */
export function Reveal({ children, className, delay = 0, as: Tag = "div" }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      setInView(true);
      return;
    }
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          io.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.12 }
    );
    io.observe(el);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <Tag
      ref={ref}
      className={cn("reveal", inView && "is-in", className)}
      style={delay ? { animationDelay: `${delay}ms` } : undefined}
    >
      {children}
    </Tag>
  );
}

/** Eased count-up; starts when `active` flips true. */
export function useCountUp(target, { duration = 1400, active = true } = {}) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    let raf = 0;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const tick = (now) => {
      const p = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / duration);
      setValue(Math.round(target * (1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * p))));
      if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else setValue(target);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [target, duration, active]);
  return value;
}

/* ---------- Input ---------- */

    <input
      className={cn(
        "h-10 w-full rounded-sm border border-line-strong bg-coal px-3.5 text-sm text-bone placeholder:text-mute",
        "transition-colors hover:border-dim/60 focus:border-gold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold/25 focus:outline-none",

      )}

/* ---------- Progress ---------- */
const TONES = {
  ember: "from-ember-deep to-gold",
  mint: "from-mint/70 to-mint",
  ice: "from-ice/70 to-ice",
  blood: "from-blood/70 to-blood",
};

export function Progress({ value = 0, max = 100, tone = "ember", className, ...props }) {
  const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (value / max) * 100));
  return (
    <div
      role="progressbar"
      aria-valuenow={Math.round(pct)}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={100}
      className={cn("h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-line bg-coal", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <div
        className={cn("h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r transition-[width] duration-500", TONES[tone])}
        style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- Skeleton ---------- */
export function Skeleton({ className, ...props }) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn("rounded-xs bg-[linear-gradient(100deg,var(--color-raise)_30%,#33291d_50%,var(--color-raise)_70%)] bg-[length:200%_100%] [animation:shimmerSlide_1.4s_linear_infinite]", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );

/* ---------- Callout ---------- */
const CALLOUT = {
  gold: "border-gold/40 bg-gold/[0.07] text-gold",
  mint: "border-mint/40 bg-mint/[0.07] text-mint",
  ice: "border-ice/40 bg-ice/[0.07] text-ice",
  blood: "border-blood/40 bg-blood/[0.07] text-blood",
};

export function Callout({ tone = "gold", title, children, className }) {

    <div className={cn("flex gap-3 rounded-sm border p-4", CALLOUT[tone], className)}>
      <Info size={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />

      </div>
    </div>
  );

/* ---------- Avatar: deterministic gradient monogram ---------- */
export function Avatar({ name = "?", hue = 20, size = 40, className }) {
  const initials = name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((w) => w[0])
    .slice(0, 2)
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full font-display font-bold text-white",
        className
      )}
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        fontSize: Math.max(11, size * 0.34),
        background: `linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(${hue} 65% 42%), hsl(${(hue + 50) % 360} 70% 26%))`,
        boxShadow: `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.18), 0 4px 14px -4px hsl(${hue} 80% 45% / 0.5)`,
      }}
    >
      {initials}
    </span>
  );
}

  return <div aria-hidden="true" className={cn("h-px w-full bg-line", className)} {...props} />;

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export function Dialog({ open, onClose, children, wide = false }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose?.();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "pop-in relative max-h-[88vh] w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-md border border-line-strong bg-panel shadow-card",
          wide ? "max-w-3xl" : "max-w-lg"
        )}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close dialog"
          autoFocus
          className="absolute top-3 right-3 cursor-pointer rounded-xs p-1.5 text-dim transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-bone"
        >
          <X size={18} />
        </button>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }) {
  return <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-6 pb-0", className)} {...props} />;
}

export function DialogTitle({ className, ...props }) {
  return (
    <h2 className={cn("font-display text-xl font-bold text-bone", className)} {...props} />
  );
}

export function DialogDescription({ className, ...props }) {
  return <p className={cn("text-sm leading-relaxed text-dim", className)} {...props} />;
}

"use client";

import { createContext, useContext } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const TabsCtx = createContext(null);

export function Tabs({ value, onValueChange, className, children, ...props }) {
  return (
    <TabsCtx.Provider value={{ value, onValueChange }}>
      <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-4", className)} {...props}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </TabsCtx.Provider>
  );
}

export function TabsList({ className, children, ...props }) {
  return (
    <div
      role="tablist"
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex h-auto w-fit max-w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-start gap-1 rounded-sm border border-line bg-coal/80 p-1",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function TabsTrigger({ value, className, children, ...props }) {
  const ctx = useContext(TabsCtx);
  const active = ctx?.value === value;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="tab"
      aria-selected={active}
      onClick={() => ctx?.onValueChange?.(value)}
      className={cn(
        "cursor-pointer rounded-xs px-3.5 py-2 font-display text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.2px] transition-all duration-150",
        active
          ? "bg-raise text-gold shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--color-line-strong),0_0_18px_-6px_rgba(232,163,61,0.5)]"
          : "text-dim hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-fog",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

const VARIANTS = {

"use client";

import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const VARIANTS = {
  default:
    "bg-ember-deep text-white shadow-ember hover:bg-ember hover:shadow-[0_0_36px_-6px_rgba(255,90,31,0.65)]",
  gold: "bg-gold text-[#12100d] shadow-gold hover:bg-gold-soft",
  secondary:
    "border border-line-strong bg-raise/60 text-bone hover:border-gold/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-raise",
  ghost: "text-dim hover:text-bone hover:bg-white/5",
  outline: "border border-line-strong text-fog hover:border-ember/70 hover:text-white",
};

const SIZES = {
  sm: "h-8 px-3 text-[11px]",
  default: "h-10 px-5 text-[13px]",
  lg: "h-12 px-7 text-sm",
  icon: "size-10",
};

export function Button({ variant = "default", size = "default", className, ...props }) {
  return (
    <button
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-sm font-display font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.5px] transition-all duration-150 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-45",
        VARIANTS[variant] || VARIANTS.default,
        SIZES[size] || SIZES.default,
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Play, Pause, Volume2, VolumeX, RotateCcw, Swords, ScrollText } from "lucide-react";
import DuelCanvas from "@/components/DuelCanvas";
import CommentaryTicker from "@/components/CommentaryTicker";
import VotePanel from "@/components/VotePanel";
import { Reveal } from "@/components/Reveal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/extras";
import { FIGHTERS, WEAPONS, ARENAS } from "@/lib/data";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const rnd = (n) => Math.floor(Math.random() * n);

function newBout() {
  const a = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  let b = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  while (b.id === a.id) b = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  return {
    a: a.name,
    b: b.name,
    seed: rnd(1_000_000),
    weapon: WEAPONS[rnd(WEAPONS.length)],
    arena: ARENAS[rnd(ARENAS.length)],
  };
}

const SPEEDS = [1, 2, 4];

export default function LivePage() {
  const [fightKey, setFightKey] = useState(0);
  const bout = useMemo(() => newBout(), [fightKey]);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(1);
  const [sound, setSound] = useState(false);
  const [hp, setHp] = useState({ a: 100, b: 100 });
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState([]);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("watch"); // watch | open | revealed
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const onEvent = useCallback((e) => {
    if (e.type === "hp") {
      setHp({ a: e.a, b: e.b });
      setTurn(e.turn);
    } else if (e.type === "line") {
      idRef.current += 1;
      const entry = { id: idRef.current, turn: e.turn, text: e.text, kind: e.kind };
      setLines((prev) => [...prev.slice(-39), entry]);
    } else if (e.type === "ko") {
      setPhase((p) => (p === "watch" ? "open" : p));
    } else if (e.type === "end") {
      setResult(e.result);
    }
  }, []);

  const rematch = useCallback(() => {
    setLines([]);
    setHp({ a: 100, b: 100 });
    setTurn(0);
    setPhase("watch");
    setResult(null);
    setPaused(false);
    setFightKey((k) => k + 1);
  }, []);

  const revealed = phase === "revealed" && result;
  const labelA = revealed ? result.names.a : "Fighter A";
  const labelB = revealed ? result.names.b : "Fighter B";

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6">
      {/* header */}
      <Reveal>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <p className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[2px] text-blood">
              <span className="live-dot inline-block size-2 rounded-full bg-blood text-blood" />
              Live from the {bout.arena}
            </p>
            <h1 className="mt-2 font-display text-3xl font-bold sm:text-4xl">
              <span className="text-fighter-a">{labelA}</span>
              <span className="mx-3 text-mute">vs</span>
              <span className="text-fighter-b">{labelB}</span>
            </h1>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Badge variant="outline">{bout.weapon}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline">{bout.arena}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="gold" className="tabular">
              Turn {String(Math.max(1, turn)).padStart(2, "0")}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      {/* HUD */}
      <Reveal delay={80}>
        <div className="mt-5 grid items-center gap-3 rounded-md border border-line bg-panel/80 p-4 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr]">
          <div>
            <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <b className="truncate font-display tracking-wide text-fighter-a uppercase">{labelA}</b>
              <span className="text-dim tabular">{hp.a}</span>
            </div>
            <Progress value={hp.a} tone="ember" />
          </div>
          <div className="hidden size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-gold/40 bg-gold/10 text-gold sm:flex">
            <Swords size={19} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-dim tabular">{hp.b}</span>
              <b className="truncate font-display tracking-wide text-fighter-b uppercase">{labelB}</b>
            </div>
            <Progress value={hp.b} tone="ice" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      {/* canvas */}
      <Reveal delay={140}>
        <div className="mt-3 overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-line-strong bg-black shadow-card">
          <DuelCanvas
            fightKey={fightKey}
            seed={bout.seed}
            matchup={{ a: bout.a, b: bout.b }}
            speed={speed}
            paused={paused}
            sound={sound}
            onEvent={onEvent}
          />
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      {/* controls */}
      <Reveal delay={200}>
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setPaused((p) => !p)}
            aria-pressed={paused}
          >
            {paused ? <Play size={14} /> : <Pause size={14} />}
            {paused ? "Resume" : "Pause"}
          </Button>
          <div className="flex overflow-hidden rounded-sm border border-line-strong" role="group" aria-label="Playback speed">
            {SPEEDS.map((s) => (
              <button
                key={s}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSpeed(s)}
                aria-pressed={speed === s}
                className={cn(
                  "cursor-pointer px-3.5 py-2 font-display text-xs font-bold tabular transition-colors",
                  speed === s ? "bg-gold/15 text-gold" : "bg-coal text-dim hover:text-fog"
                )}
              >
                {s}×
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => setSound((s) => !s)} aria-pressed={sound}>
            {sound ? <Volume2 size={14} /> : <VolumeX size={14} />}
            {sound ? "Sound on" : "Sound off"}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={rematch}>
            <RotateCcw size={14} />
            New matchup
          </Button>
          <span className="ml-auto hidden text-xs text-mute sm:block">
            seed <span className="font-mono tabular">{bout.seed}</span> · reproducible bout
          </span>
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      {/* commentary + vote */}
      <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.25fr_1fr]">
        <Reveal delay={100}>
          <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-2">
            <p className="font-display text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.6px] text-mute">
              Ringside commentary
            </p>
            <CommentaryTicker lines={lines} className="max-h-[380px] flex-1 lg:max-h-none" />
          </div>
        </Reveal>
        <Reveal delay={180}>
          <VotePanel
            phase={phase}
            result={result}
            onVote={() => setPhase("revealed")}
            onRematch={rematch}
          />
        </Reveal>
      </div>

      {/* transcript */}
      {revealed && (
        <Reveal>
          <Card className="mt-4">
            <CardContent className="p-5">
              <p className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.6px] text-mute">
                <ScrollText size={14} />
                Bout transcript · {result.turns} turns · {result.method}
              </p>
              <ol className="mt-3 space-y-1.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed">
                {result.log.map((l, i) => (
                  <li key={i} className="flex gap-3">
                    <span className="w-8 shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] text-mute tabular">
                      {l.turn > 0 ? `T${String(l.turn).padStart(2, "0")}` : "—"}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-fog/90">{l.text}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Reveal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

} from "lucide-react";
import DuelCanvas from "@/components/DuelCanvas";
import Marquee from "@/components/Marquee";

import { fmtInt, fmtDelta } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const rnd = (n) => Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
const pickPair = () => {
  const a = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  let b = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  while (b.id === a.id) b = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  return { a, b };
};

/* ------------------------------- Hero ------------------------------- */

function HeroDuel() {
  const [key, setKey] = useState(0);
  const bout = useMemo(
    () => ({
      ...pickPair(),
      seed: rnd(1_000_000),
      weapon: WEAPONS[rnd(WEAPONS.length)],
      arena: ARENAS[rnd(ARENAS.length)],
    }),
    [key]
  );

  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-line-strong bg-abyss shadow-card">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-2.5">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.6px] text-blood">
          <span className="live-dot inline-block size-2 rounded-full bg-blood text-blood" />
          Live now
        </span>
        <span className="truncate text-xs text-dim">
          {bout.weapon} · {bout.arena}
        </span>
      </div>
      <DuelCanvas
        fightKey={key}
        seed={bout.seed}
        matchup={{ a: bout.a.name, b: bout.b.name }}
        ambient
        onEvent={(e) => {
          if (e.type === "end") setTimeout(() => setKey((k) => k + 1), 2800);
        }}
      />
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-2.5 text-xs">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="font-bold text-fighter-a">FIGHTER A</span>
          <span className="text-mute">vs</span>
          <span className="font-bold text-fighter-b">FIGHTER B</span>
        </span>
        <Link href="/live" className="flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-gold hover:text-gold-soft">
          Judge this <ChevronRight size={14} />
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------- Stats ------------------------------ */

function Stat({ value, suffix = "", label, sub, delay = 0 }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([e]) => e.isIntersecting && (setOn(true), io.disconnect()),
      { threshold: 0.4 }
    );
    io.observe(el);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);
  const v = useCountUp(value, { active: on });
  return (
    <Reveal delay={delay}>
      <div ref={ref} className="rounded-md border border-line bg-panel/80 p-5">
        <p className="font-display text-3xl font-bold text-bone tabular sm:text-4xl">
          {fmtInt(v)}
          <span className="gold-text">{suffix}</span>
        </p>
        <p className="mt-1 font-display text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.6px] text-gold">
          {label}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-dim">{sub}</p>
      </div>
    </Reveal>
  );
}

function Trend({ value }) {
  if (value > 0) return <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-mint"><TrendingUp size={13} />{fmtDelta(value)}</span>;
  if (value < 0) return <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-blood"><TrendingDown size={13} />{fmtDelta(value)}</span>;
  return <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-dim"><Minus size={13} />±0</span>;
}

import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

function MatchCard({ match }) {
  const live = match.score === "live";
  const decided = match.winner != null;
  const row = (name, side) => {
    const won = decided && match.winner === side;
    const lost = decided && match.winner !== side;
    return (
      <div
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xs px-3 py-2 text-sm",
          won && "bg-gold/10 shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--color-gold)]",
          !won && !lost && "bg-coal/60"
        )}
      >
        <span className={cn("truncate", won ? "font-bold text-bone" : lost ? "text-mute line-through" : "text-fog")}>
          {name}
        </span>
        {won && <Crown size={14} className="shrink-0 text-gold" />}
      </div>
    );
  };
  return (
    <div className={cn("rounded-sm border bg-panel/80 p-2", live ? "border-blood/50 shadow-[0_0_24px_-8px_rgba(255,61,92,0.6)]" : "border-line")}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1 pt-1 pb-2">
        <span className="text-[11px] text-mute">
          {match.a === "TBD" ? "Awaiting semifinal winners" : `${match.a} vs ${match.b}`}
        </span>
        {live ? (
          <Badge variant="blood">
            <span className="live-dot inline-block size-1.5 rounded-full bg-blood text-blood" />
            Live
          </Badge>
        ) : (
          <Badge variant={decided ? "mint" : "dim"}>{match.score}</Badge>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        {row(match.a, "a")}
        {row(match.b, "b")}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FormDots({ form }) {
  return (
    <span className="flex gap-1" aria-label={`Recent form: ${form.join(", ")}`}>
      {form.map((r, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          className={cn(
            "flex size-5 items-center justify-center rounded-xs text-[9px] font-bold",
            r === "W" ? "bg-mint/15 text-mint" : r === "L" ? "bg-blood/15 text-blood" : "bg-dim/15 text-dim"
          )}
        >
          {r}
        </span>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

function FighterCard({ fighter, onDetails }) {
  const wr = fmtPct(fighter.wins, fighter.losses, fighter.draws);
  return (

        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <Avatar name={fighter.name} hue={fighter.hue} size={48} />

            <p className="truncate font-display text-base font-bold text-bone">{fighter.name}</p>
            <p className="truncate text-xs text-dim">{fighter.provider}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right">
            <p className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-gold tabular">{fmtInt(fighter.elo)}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-mute">elo</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-3 line-clamp-2 min-h-[40px] text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-dim">
          {fighter.blurb}
        </p>
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs tabular">

            Details

          <Link href="/live" className="flex-1">

              Arena
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>

    else if (sort === "wins") filtered.sort((a, b) => b.wins - a.wins);
    else filtered.sort((a, b) => b.trend - a.trend);

  return (

                  ["Wins", fmtInt(selected.wins)],

JS
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Crown, Flame, Search, TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Minus, Swords } from "lucide-react";
import { Reveal } from "@/components/Reveal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Input, Avatar } from "@/components/ui/extras";
import { FIGHTERS } from "@/lib/data";
import { fmtInt, fmtPct, fmtDelta } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const SORTS = [
  { id: "elo", label: "Elo rating" },
  { id: "winrate", label: "Win rate" },
  { id: "streak", label: "Hot streak" },
];

function winrate(f) {
  const n = f.wins + f.losses + f.draws;
  return n ? (f.wins + f.draws / 2) / n : 0;
}

function Trend({ value }) {
  if (value > 0)
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-mint">
        <TrendingUp size={13} /> {fmtDelta(value)}
      </span>
    );
  if (value < 0)
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-blood">
        <TrendingDown size={13} /> {fmtDelta(value)}
      </span>
    );
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-dim">
      <Minus size={13} /> ±0
    </span>
  );
}

function PodiumCard({ fighter, place }) {
  const first = place === 1;
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "relative flex flex-col items-center rounded-md border px-4 py-6 text-center",
        first
          ? "border-gold/50 bg-gradient-to-b from-gold/[0.12] to-panel shadow-gold sm:-mt-6 sm:py-9"
          : "border-line bg-panel/80",
        place === 2 && "sm:order-1",
        first && "sm:order-2",
        place === 3 && "sm:order-3"
      )}
    >
      {first && (
        <Crown size={22} className="absolute -top-3 bg-void px-1 text-gold" aria-label="Champion" />
      )}
      <Avatar name={fighter.name} hue={fighter.hue} size={first ? 64 : 52} />
      <p className="mt-3 font-display text-sm font-bold text-bone">{fighter.name}</p>
      <p className="text-xs text-dim">{fighter.provider}</p>
      <p className={cn("mt-2 font-display text-2xl font-bold tabular", first ? "gold-text" : "text-bone")}>
        {fmtInt(fighter.elo)}
      </p>
      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-dim tabular">
        {fighter.wins}W · {fighter.losses}L · {fighter.draws}D
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function LeaderboardPage() {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("elo");
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const query = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = FIGHTERS.filter(
      (f) =>
        !query ||
        f.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        f.provider.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
    const sorted = [...filtered];
    if (sort === "elo") sorted.sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo);
    else if (sort === "winrate") sorted.sort((a, b) => winrate(b) - winrate(a));
    else sorted.sort((a, b) => b.streak - a.streak || b.elo - a.elo);
    return sorted;
  }, [sort, q]);

  const elos = FIGHTERS.map((f) => f.elo);
  const lo = Math.min(...elos);
  const hi = Math.max(...elos);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6">
      <Reveal>
        <p className="font-display text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[2px] text-ember">
          Season 4 standings
        </p>
        <h1 className="mt-2 font-display text-3xl font-bold sm:text-4xl">Leaderboard</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-fog">
          Every rank earned the hard way — blind votes on real physics duels.
          Minimum 50 judged bouts to hold a ranked slot.
        </p>
      </Reveal>

      <Reveal delay={80}>
        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <Tabs value={sort} onValueChange={setSort}>
            <TabsList aria-label="Sort leaderboard">
              {SORTS.map((s) => (
                <TabsTrigger key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                  {s.label}
                </TabsTrigger>
              ))}
            </TabsList>
          </Tabs>
          <div className="relative sm:w-64">
            <Search size={15} className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-3 -translate-y-1/2 text-mute" />
            <Input
              value={q}
              onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search fighters…"
              aria-label="Search fighters"
              className="pl-9"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      {!q && (
        <div className="mt-8 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 sm:items-end">
          {rows.slice(0, 3).map((f, i) => (
            <Reveal key={f.id} delay={i * 90}>
              <PodiumCard fighter={f} place={i + 1} />
            </Reveal>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <Reveal delay={120}>
        <div className="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-line">
          <div className="hidden grid-cols-[44px_1fr_130px_90px_90px_90px_80px] items-center gap-3 border-b border-line bg-coal/70 px-5 py-2.5 font-display text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.4px] text-mute lg:grid">
            <span>#</span>
            <span>Fighter</span>
            <span>Rating</span>
            <span className="text-right">Record</span>
            <span className="text-right">Win%</span>
            <span className="text-right">Streak</span>
            <span className="text-right">Trend</span>
          </div>
          {rows.map((f, i) => {
            const pct = ((f.elo - lo) / (hi - lo)) * 100;
            return (
              <div
                key={f.id}
                className={cn(
                  "grid grid-cols-[36px_1fr_auto] items-center gap-3 bg-panel/70 px-4 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-raise/60 sm:px-5 lg:grid-cols-[44px_1fr_130px_90px_90px_90px_80px]",
                  i > 0 && "border-t border-line"
                )}
              >
                <span className={cn("font-display text-base font-bold tabular", i < 3 ? "text-gold" : "text-dim")}>
                  {i + 1}
                </span>
                <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
                  <Avatar name={f.name} hue={f.hue} size={36} />
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold text-bone">{f.name}</span>
                    <span className="block truncate text-xs text-dim">
                      {f.provider} · <span className="tabular">{f.wins}W {f.losses}L {f.draws}D</span>
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-right lg:text-left">
                  <span className="block font-display text-base font-bold text-bone tabular">
                    {fmtInt(f.elo)}
                  </span>
                  <span className="mt-1 hidden h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-coal lg:block">
                    <span
                      className="block h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-ember-deep to-gold"
                      style={{ width: `${Math.max(8, pct)}%` }}
                    />
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span className="hidden text-right text-xs text-dim tabular lg:block">
                  {f.wins}–{f.losses}–{f.draws}
                </span>
                <span className="hidden text-right text-sm font-bold text-fog tabular lg:block">
                  {fmtPct(f.wins, f.losses, f.draws)}
                </span>
                <span className="hidden justify-end lg:flex">
                  {f.streak > 1 ? (
                    <Badge variant="ember">
                      <Flame size={12} /> {f.streak}
                    </Badge>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-xs text-mute">–</span>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span className="hidden justify-end lg:flex">
                  <Trend value={f.trend} />
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
          {rows.length === 0 && (
            <p className="bg-panel/70 px-5 py-10 text-center text-sm text-dim">
              No fighters match “{q}”. The sand keeps no record of them.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      <Reveal delay={160}>
        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-line bg-panel/60 px-5 py-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-dim">
            Think the rankings are wrong? <b className="text-bone">Prove it with a vote.</b>
          </p>
          <Link href="/live">
            <Button size="sm">
              <Swords size={14} />
              Judge a duel
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </Reveal>
    </div>
  );
}

Stickblade Arena — fresh concept build
MD
Stickblade Arena — fresh concept build
A from-zero reimagining of the Stickblade Arena frontend: cinematic,
broadcast-style, fully self-contained. No backend required — every bout
is simulated locally and every page reads through one data module.

Run it
Bash

cd stickblade-arena-new
npm install
npm run build
npx next start -p 4177 -H 0.0.0.0
Then open the live preview (port 4177).

What's inside
Route	What it is
/	Hero with a live ambient duel, results ticker, count-up stats, how-it-works, top-5, tournament banner
/live	The arena: procedural canvas duel, HP HUD, pause/1×/2×/4×, synthesized sound, ringside commentary, blind vote → reveal flow, bout transcript
/leaderboard	Podium + sortable/searchable standings (Elo / win rate / streak)
/fighters	Filterable roster cards with detail dialogs
/tournaments	Ember Cup IV bracket, semifinal live states, hall of champions
/kit	The full hand-built UI kit on one page
Highlights
Procedural fight engine (lib/sim.js) — turn scheduling, fighter
physics, particles, screen shake, slow-mo KOs, commentary lines.
Blind-safe: only "Fighter A/B" until the reveal event.
Canvas renderer (components/DuelCanvas.jsx) — torch-lit crowd,
spotlights, scarf-fluttering duelists, sword trails, spark bursts,
shockwave rings, floating damage numbers, KO banners. Respects
prefers-reduced-motion.
Synthesized audio (lib/sound.js) — whoosh/hit/clash/crit/KO/bell,
pure WebAudio, zero assets. Off by default.
Design system — Tailwind v4 @theme ember tokens, Space Grotesk +
Inter, hand-built Button/Badge/Card/Tabs/Dialog/Input/Progress/
Skeleton/Callout/Avatar/Tooltip/kbd components.
Data layer (lib/data.js) — swap these exports for live API
fetchers later; pages never import data from anywhere else.
Open
Your new Stickblade Arena is live — built from zero in /home/user/stickblade-arena-new, running on the preview at port 4177. README is open above; the app itself is in your live previews.

The centerpiece: a fully procedural sword-fight engine. Two duelists with fluttering scarves and glowing blades trade lunges, parries, clashes, and crits on a torch-lit canvas — with spark bursts, shockwave rings, floating damage numbers, screen shake, slow-mo K.O. banners, ringside commentary, and synthesized WebAudio sound (zero audio files). It plays ambient in the home-page hero and full-interactive in the arena.

Six pages:

Home — live duel hero, results ticker, count-up stats, how-it-works, top-5 rankings, tournament banner
/live — the arena: HP HUD, pause + 1×/2×/4× speed, sound toggle, auto-scrolling commentary, blind vote → dramatic identity reveal → bout transcript
/leaderboard — podium, sortable/searchable standings
/fighters — filterable roster with detail dialogs
/tournaments — Ember Cup IV bracket with live semifinal states + hall of champions
/kit — the entire hand-built UI kit (buttons, badges, cards, tabs, dialogs, inputs, progress, skeletons, callouts, avatars, CSS-only tooltips) on one page
Blind voting is honored end-to-end — "Fighter A vs Fighter B" everywhere until your vote locks. Zero backend needed (all simulated locally), but everything reads through lib/data.js, so pointing it at the real API later is a clean swap.

Build is green, all routes 200. Tell me which part to push further — same-matchup rematches, a working ⌘K menu, fighter head-to-head compare, or wiring it to the real backend.

  accent: "bg-accent",
  ink: "bg-ink",
  ultra: "bg-ultra",
  moss: "bg-moss",

export function Progress({ value = 0, max = 100, tone = "accent", className, ...props }) {

      role="progressbar"

    </div>
  );
}

export function Avatar({ name = "?", hue = 20, size = 40, className }) {
  const initials = name
    .split(/\s+/)

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export function Dialog({ open, onClose, children, wide = false }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose?.();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-ink/50 p-4"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "pop-in relative max-h-[88vh] w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-xs border border-ink bg-card shadow-lift",
          wide ? "max-w-3xl" : "max-w-lg"
        )}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close dialog"
          autoFocus
          className="absolute top-3 right-3 cursor-pointer rounded-xs p-1.5 text-mute transition-colors hover:bg-paper-deep hover:text-ink"
        >
          <X size={18} />
        </button>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }) {
  return <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-6 pb-0", className)} {...props} />;
}

export function DialogTitle({ className, ...props }) {
  return (
    <h2 className={cn("font-display text-xl font-bold text-ink", className)} {...props} />
  );
}

export function DialogDescription({ className, ...props }) {
  return <p className={cn("text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-soft", className)} {...props} />;
}

"use client";

import { createContext, useContext } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const TabsCtx = createContext(null);

export function Tabs({ value, onValueChange, className, children, ...props }) {
  return (
    <TabsCtx.Provider value={{ value, onValueChange }}>
      <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-4", className)} {...props}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </TabsCtx.Provider>
  );
}

export function TabsList({ className, children, ...props }) {
  return (
    <div
      role="tablist"
      aria-label="Tabs"
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex w-fit max-w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-0 border border-line bg-card",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function TabsTrigger({ value, className, children, ...props }) {
  const ctx = useContext(TabsCtx);
  const active = ctx?.value === value;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="tab"
      aria-selected={active}
      onClick={() => ctx?.onValueChange?.(value)}
      className={cn(
        "cursor-pointer border-r border-line px-4 py-2.5 font-display text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] transition-colors last:border-r-0",
        active ? "bg-ink text-paper" : "text-mute hover:bg-paper-deep/60 hover:text-ink",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
