sim.js
JS
/**
 * Procedural duel engine, take two.
 *
 * Same contract as before: owns turn scheduling, fighter physics,
 * particles, shake, slow-mo, commentary and the result. The renderer
 * paints it as ink-brush line art on paper.
 *
 * Blind-safe: commentary always says "Fighter A/B". Real names travel
 * only inside the final `end` event payload.
 */

export function mulberry32(a) {
  return function () {
    a |= 0;
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

const R = (rng, min, max) => min + rng() * (max - min);
const RI = (rng, min, max) => Math.floor(R(rng, min, max + 1));
const pick = (rng, arr) => arr[Math.floor(rng() * arr.length)];

const LINES = {
  open: [
    "The marshal steps back. Fighter A and Fighter B take their marks.",
    "A hush over the gallery. Steel is drawn.",
    "The program lists no names — only numbers. A and B it is.",
    "Chalk dust hangs in the light. The duelists circle.",
    "No anthems, no odds board. Just two blades and a verdict to reach.",
  ],
  hit: [
    "{W} lands cleanly — a line of red across {L}'s guard.",
    "{L} misreads the feint and {W} collects.",
    "A crisp exchange, finished by {W} with interest.",
    "{W} cuts through {L}'s measure like a headline.",
    "{L} reaches; {W} is already past the parry.",
  ],
  crit: [
    "A devastating strike! {W} nearly ends the debate with {L}!",
    "{W} finds the perfect angle — {L} reels across the circle!",
    "The gallery gasps. {W} carves a masterpiece into {L}.",
  ],
  clash: [
    "Blades meet — a hard black note rings off the walls.",
    "{W} and {L} bind edge to edge. Neither yields a centimetre.",
    "Parried at the final instant. Superb work from {L}.",
    "Steel on steel, sparks on paper. The duel writes itself.",
  ],
  miss: [
    "{W} strikes at yesterday's news — {L} has already moved on.",
    "A swing and clean air. {L} declines to participate.",
    "{L} steps off the line; {W}'s blade proofreads nothing.",
  ],
  ko: [
    "K.O. — {W} closes the issue on {L}.",
    "It is finished. {W} stands alone in the circle.",
    "The final mark is made. Victory to {W}.",
  ],
  decision: [
    "The bell. The judges' cards read {W}.",
    "Time expires — a gruelling affair goes to {W}.",
  ],
};

function fill(template, w, l) {
  return template.replaceAll("{W}", w).replaceAll("{L}", l);
}

const W = 960;
const MARK_A = 340;
const MARK_B = 620;
const MIN_X = 90;
const MAX_X = 870;

export function createFight({ seed = 1, names = { a: "Fighter A", b: "Fighter B" }, onEvent = () => {} } = {}) {
  const rng = mulberry32(seed);
  const LA = "Fighter A";
  const LB = "Fighter B";

  const mk = (x, home, color) => ({
    x, home, vx: 0, hp: 100, maxHp: 100,
    state: "idle", stateT: 0, seed: rng() * 10, color,
  });

  const S = {
    t: 0,
    turn: 0,
    phase: "intro",
    introT: 1.5,
    koT: 0,
    method: null,
    winner: null,
    lastAttacker: 1,
    turnTimer: 0,
    slowmo: 1,
    trauma: 0,
    flash: 0,
    banner: null,
    bannerT: 0,
    fighters: [mk(60, MARK_A, "#f04e00"), mk(900, MARK_B, "#2b3ff2")],
    impacts: [],
    particles: [],
    rings: [],
    floaters: [],
    log: [],
    speed: 1,
    paused: false,
    reducedMotion: false,
  };

  const emit = (e) => onEvent(e);
  const line = (turn, text, kind = "info") => {
    S.log.push({ turn, text });
    emit({ type: "line", turn, text, kind });
  };
  const hp = () =>
    emit({ type: "hp", turn: S.turn, a: Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[0].hp)), b: Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[1].hp)) });

  function burst(x, y, n, colors, power = 1) {
    const count = S.reducedMotion ? Math.ceil(n / 2) : n;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = R(rng, -Math.PI, Math.PI);
      const sp = R(rng, 80, 380) * power;
      S.particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 130,
        life: R(rng, 0.3, 0.8),
        maxLife: 0.8,
        size: R(rng, 1.4, 3.2),
        color: pick(rng, colors),
        grav: 900,
        kind: "spark",
      });
    }
    if (S.particles.length > 420) S.particles.splice(0, S.particles.length - 420);
  }

  function ring(x, y, color, max = 120) {
    S.rings.push({ x, y, r: 8, vr: 380, life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45, color, max });
  }

  function floater(x, y, text, color, size = 22) {
    S.floaters.push({ x, y, vy: -58, life: 1.0, maxLife: 1.0, text, color, size });
  }

  function shake(amount) {
    if (!S.reducedMotion) S.trauma = Math.min(1, S.trauma + amount);
  }

  function startKO(loser, method) {
    const winner = loser === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    S.phase = "ko";
    S.method = method;
    S.winner = winner;
    S.koT = method === "ko" ? 1.6 : 1.3;
    S.slowmo = S.reducedMotion ? 1 : 0.28;
    const L = S.fighters[loser];
    const Wn = S.fighters[winner];
    L.state = "down";
    L.vx = (loser === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 150;
    if (method === "ko") {
      Wn.state = "victory";
      Wn.vx = 0;
      burst(L.x, 360, 42, ["#f04e00", "#17140f", "#c43e00", winner === 0 ? "#f04e00" : "#2b3ff2"], 1.35);
      ring(L.x, 380, "#f04e00", 200);
      S.flash = S.reducedMotion ? 0 : 0.7;
      shake(1);
      S.banner = { big: "K.O.", sub: `${loser === 0 ? LB : LA} TAKES THE DUEL`, stamp: true };
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.ko), loser === 0 ? LB : LA, loser === 0 ? LA : LB), "ko");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "ko" });
      emit({ type: "ko", winner });
    } else {
      S.banner = { big: "DECISION", sub: `THE CARDS READ ${winner === 0 ? "FIGHTER A" : "FIGHTER B"}`, stamp: false };
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.decision), winner === 0 ? LA : LB, ""), "ko");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "bell" });
      emit({ type: "ko", winner });
    }
    S.bannerT = S.koT;
    hp();
  }

  function applyImpact(impact) {
    const { outcome, ai, di, dmg } = impact;
    const A = S.fighters[ai];
    const D = S.fighters[di];
    const AW = ai === 0 ? LA : LB;
    const DW = di === 0 ? LA : LB;
    const mx = (A.x + D.x) / 2;
    const my = 340;

    if (outcome === "miss") {
      D.state = "dodge";
      D.stateT = 0;
      D.vx += (di === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 110;
      floater(D.x, 250, "MISS", "#8a8172", 17);
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.miss), AW, DW), "info");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "whoosh" });
    } else if (outcome === "clash") {
      A.state = "recover";
      A.stateT = 0;
      D.state = "recover";
      D.stateT = 0;
      A.vx += (ai === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 85;
      D.vx += (di === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 85;
      burst(mx, my, 15, ["#17140f", "#f04e00", "#4d463a"], 1);
      ring(mx, my, "#17140f");
      shake(0.4);
      floater(mx, 240, "CLASH", "#17140f", 20);
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.clash), AW, DW), "clash");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "clash" });
    } else {
      const crit = outcome === "crit";
      D.hp -= dmg;
      D.state = "stagger";
      D.stateT = 0;
      D.vx += (di === 0 ? -1 : 1) * (crit ? 300 : 200);
      burst(D.x + (di === 0 ? 20 : -20), my, crit ? 22 : 11,
        crit ? ["#f04e00", "#c43e00", "#17140f"] : [A.color, "#17140f", "#4d463a"], crit ? 1.2 : 1);
      if (crit) {
        ring(D.x, my, "#f04e00");
        S.flash = S.reducedMotion ? 0 : 0.35;
      }
      shake(crit ? 0.85 : 0.5);
      floater(D.x, 240, crit ? `CRITICAL −${dmg}` : `−${dmg}`, crit ? "#f04e00" : "#17140f", crit ? 25 : 22);
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, crit ? LINES.crit : LINES.hit), AW, DW), crit ? "crit" : "hit");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: crit ? "crit" : "hit" });
      hp();
      if (D.hp <= 0) {
        D.hp = 0;
        startKO(di, "ko");
        return;
      }
    }
    if (S.turn >= 40 && S.phase === "fight") {
      const [a, b] = S.fighters;
      if (Math.abs(a.hp - b.hp) < 4) {
        S.phase = "ko";
        S.method = "draw";
        S.winner = "draw";
        S.koT = 1.3;
        S.slowmo = 1;
        S.banner = { big: "DRAW", sub: "THE JUDGES CANNOT SPLIT THEM", stamp: false };
        S.bannerT = S.koT;
        line(S.turn, "The bell on a dead-even duel — a draw.", "ko");
        emit({ type: "sfx", name: "bell" });
        emit({ type: "ko", winner: "draw" });
      } else {
        startKO(a.hp < b.hp ? 0 : 1, "decision");
      }
    }
  }

  function doTurn() {
    S.turn += 1;
    const repeat = rng() < 0.3;
    const ai = repeat ? S.lastAttacker : 1 - S.lastAttacker;
    const di = 1 - ai;
    S.lastAttacker = ai;
    const A = S.fighters[ai];
    A.state = "strike";
    A.stateT = 0;
    A.vx += (ai === 0 ? 1 : -1) * 250;
    S.fighters[di].state = "brace";
    S.fighters[di].stateT = 0;

    const roll = rng();
    const outcome = roll < 0.12 ? "crit" : roll < 0.42 ? "clash" : roll < 0.58 ? "miss" : "hit";
    const dmg = outcome === "crit" ? RI(rng, 13, 21) : outcome === "hit" ? RI(rng, 6, 12) : 0;
    S.impacts.push({ at: S.t + 0.24, outcome, ai, di, dmg });
    emit({ type: "sfx", name: "whoosh" });
    emit({ type: "turn", turn: S.turn });
  }

  function update(rawDt) {
    if (S.paused || S.phase === "ended") return;
    const dt = Math.min(rawDt, 0.05) * S.speed;
    const worldDt = dt * (S.phase === "ko" ? S.slowmo : 1);
    S.t += worldDt;

    // drifting paper motes
    if (rng() < worldDt * 5 && S.particles.length < 420) {
      S.particles.push({
        x: R(rng, 40, W - 40), y: 560,
        vx: R(rng, -12, 12), vy: R(rng, -40, -16),
        life: R(rng, 4, 7), maxLife: 7,
        size: R(rng, 1, 2.2),
        color: pick(rng, ["#b3ab94", "#d9d2c0", "#f04e00"]),
        grav: -5, kind: "ember",
      });
    }

    if (S.phase === "intro") {
      S.introT -= dt;
      for (const f of S.fighters) {
        f.x += (f.home - f.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.2);
        f.stateT += worldDt;
      }
      if (S.introT <= 0) {
        S.phase = "fight";
        S.turnTimer = 0.5;
        line(0, pick(rng, LINES.open), "info");
        emit({ type: "sfx", name: "bell" });
        hp();
      }
    } else if (S.phase === "fight") {
      S.turnTimer -= dt;
      if (S.turnTimer <= 0) {
        doTurn();
        S.turnTimer = R(rng, 1.1, 1.55);
      }
    } else if (S.phase === "ko") {
      S.koT -= dt;
      S.bannerT = Math.max(0, S.bannerT - dt);
      if (S.koT <= 0) {
        S.phase = "ended";
        S.bannerT = 0;
        emit({
          type: "end",
          result: {
            winner: S.winner,
            method: S.method,
            turns: S.turn,
            names: { ...names },
            hp: [Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[0].hp)), Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[1].hp))],
            log: [...S.log],
          },
        });
      }
    }

    for (let i = S.impacts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (S.impacts[i].at <= S.t) {
        const [im] = S.impacts.splice(i, 1);
        if (S.phase === "fight") applyImpact(im);
      }
    }

    for (const f of S.fighters) {
      f.stateT += worldDt;
      if ((f.state === "strike" || f.state === "stagger" || f.state === "dodge" || f.state === "recover" || f.state === "brace") && f.stateT > 0.55) {
        f.state = "idle";
        f.stateT = 0;
      }
      if (f.state !== "down") {
        const pull = (f.home - f.x) * 1.6;
        f.vx += pull * worldDt;
        f.vx *= Math.pow(0.06, worldDt);
        f.x += f.vx * worldDt;
      } else {
        f.vx *= Math.pow(0.01, worldDt);
        f.x += f.vx * worldDt;
      }
      f.x = Math.max(MIN_X, Math.min(MAX_X, f.x));
    }

    for (let i = S.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = S.particles[i];
      p.life -= worldDt;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        S.particles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      p.vy += p.grav * worldDt;
      p.x += p.vx * worldDt;
      p.y += p.vy * worldDt;
    }
    for (let i = S.rings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const r = S.rings[i];
      r.life -= worldDt;
      r.r += r.vr * worldDt;
      if (r.life <= 0 || r.r > r.max) S.rings.splice(i, 1);
    }
    for (let i = S.floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const fl = S.floaters[i];
      fl.life -= dt;
      fl.y += fl.vy * dt;
      if (fl.life <= 0) S.floaters.splice(i, 1);
    }
    S.trauma = Math.max(0, S.trauma - dt * 1.7);
    S.flash = Math.max(0, S.flash - dt * 2.4);
  }

  return { state: S, update };
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { EyeOff, RotateCcw, ArrowRight, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "./ui/button";
import { Badge } from "./ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "./ui/card";
import { Avatar } from "./ui/extras";
import { fighterByName } from "@/lib/data";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const SIDES = [
  { id: "a", label: "Fighter A", sub: "the vermilion blade", box: "border-fighter-a" },
  { id: "draw", label: "Draw", sub: "impossible to split", box: "border-mute" },
  { id: "b", label: "Fighter B", sub: "the ultramarine blade", box: "border-fighter-b" },
];

/**
 * The ballot box. phase: "watch" | "open" | "revealed"
 */
export default function VotePanel({ phase, result, ballotNo, onVote, onRematch }) {
  const [choice, setChoice] = useState(null);
  const [confidence, setConfidence] = useState(3);

  if (phase === "watch") {
    return (
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="p-5">
          <div className="rounded-xs border border-dashed border-line-strong p-5 text-center">
            <EyeOff size={20} className="mx-auto text-mute" />
            <p className="micro mt-3 text-ink">Ballot opens at the final bell</p>
            <p className="mx-auto mt-1.5 max-w-[34ch] text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-soft">
              Names stay sealed until you judge. Brand bias dies in the dark.
            </p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (phase === "revealed" && result) {
    const a = fighterByName(result.names.a);
    const b = fighterByName(result.names.b);
    const winnerName =
      result.winner === "draw" ? null : result.winner === 0 ? result.names.a : result.names.b;
    return (
      <Card className="pop-in">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="stamp text-sm text-accent-deep">Declassified</span>
            <Badge variant="paper">
              {result.method === "ko" ? "Knockout" : result.method === "draw" ? "Draw" : "Decision"} ·{" "}
              {result.turns} turns
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <CardTitle className="mt-3 text-2xl">
            {winnerName ? (
              <>
                <span className="text-accent-deep">{winnerName}</span> takes it
              </>
            ) : (
              "Nobody blinked — a draw"
            )}
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            The seals are broken. {result.names.a} fought as{" "}
            <span className="font-semibold text-fighter-a">Fighter A</span>, {result.names.b} as{" "}
            <span className="font-semibold text-fighter-b">Fighter B</span>.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[
            { f: a, won: result.winner === 0 },
            { f: b, won: result.winner === 1 },
          ].map(({ f, won }, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xs border p-3",
                won ? "border-accent/60 bg-accent/[0.05]" : "border-line"
              )}
            >
              <Avatar name={f?.name || "?"} hue={f?.hue ?? 20} size={38} />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-ink">
                  {f?.name} {won && <span className="text-accent-deep">◆</span>}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-mute">
                  {f?.provider} · Elo {f?.elo}
                </p>
              </div>
              <Badge variant={won ? "accent" : "dim"}>{won ? "+16" : "−16"}</Badge>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button onClick={onRematch} className="flex-1">
              <RotateCcw size={14} />
              Next bout
            </Button>
            <Link href="/leaderboard" className="flex-1">
              <Button variant="secondary" className="w-full">
                Rankings
                <ArrowRight size={14} />
              </Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  // phase === "open" — the ballot slip
  return (
    <Card className="pop-in">
      <CardContent className="p-5">
        <div className="rounded-xs border border-ink">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-ink px-4 py-2.5">
            <p className="micro text-ink">Official ballot</p>
            <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-mute tabular">№ {String(ballotNo).padStart(4, "0")}</p>
          </div>
          <p className="px-4 pt-3 text-[13px] text-ink-soft">
            Judge the steel, not the brand. Mark one:
          </p>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-4" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Your vote">
            {SIDES.map((s) => (
              <button
                key={s.id}
                type="button"
                role="radio"
                aria-checked={choice === s.id}
                onClick={() => setChoice(s.id)}
                className={cn(
                  "flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-xs border px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors",
                  choice === s.id ? "border-ink bg-paper-deep/70" : "border-line hover:border-line-strong"
                )}
              >
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    "flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[2px] border-2",
                    s.box,
                    choice === s.id ? "bg-ink text-paper" : "bg-transparent text-transparent"
                  )}
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  <Check size={13} strokeWidth={3.5} />
                </span>
                <span>
                  <span className="block font-display text-sm font-bold text-ink">{s.label}</span>
                  <span className="block text-xs text-mute">{s.sub}</span>
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="ticket-edge mx-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          <div className="p-4">
            <p className="micro mb-2 text-mute">Confidence</p>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Confidence">
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
                <button
                  key={n}
                  type="button"
                  role="radio"
                  aria-checked={confidence === n}
                  aria-label={`Confidence ${n} of 5`}
                  onClick={() => setConfidence(n)}
                  className={cn(
                    "h-9 flex-1 cursor-pointer rounded-xs border font-display text-sm font-bold transition-colors",
                    confidence === n
                      ? "border-ink bg-ink text-paper"
                      : "border-line text-mute hover:border-line-strong hover:text-ink"
                  )}
                >
                  {n}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <Button className="mt-3 w-full" size="lg" disabled={!choice} onClick={() => choice && onVote(choice, confidence)}>
              Cast ballot & unseal
            </Button>
            <p className="mt-2 text-center text-[11px] text-mute">
              Identities are declassified the moment your ballot lands.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const KIND = {
  info: "text-ink-soft",
  hit: "text-ink",
  crit: "text-accent-deep font-semibold",
  clash: "text-ultra",
  ko: "text-accent-deep font-semibold",
};

/** The stenographer's log — numbered transcript of the duel. */
export default function CommentaryTicker({ lines = [], className }) {
  const boxRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = boxRef.current;
    if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
  }, [lines.length]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={boxRef}
      aria-live="polite"
      aria-label="Duel transcript"
      className={cn(
        "scroll-thin min-h-[220px] overflow-y-auto rounded-xs border border-line bg-card",
        className
      )}
    >
      {lines.length === 0 && (
        <p className="p-4 text-sm text-mute italic">The stenographer sharpens a pencil…</p>
      )}
      <ol>
        {lines.map((l) => (
          <li
            key={l.id}
            className="ticker-line flex gap-3 border-b border-line/70 px-4 py-2 text-[13px] leading-relaxed last:border-b-0"
          >
            <span className="w-8 shrink-0 pt-px font-mono text-[11px] text-mute tabular">
              {l.turn > 0 ? String(l.turn).padStart(2, "0") : "§"}
            </span>
            <span className={cn(KIND[l.kind] || KIND.info)}>{l.text}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
}

DuelCanvas.jsx
JS
"use client";

/**
 * DuelCanvas, letterpress edition — the duel as ink-brush line art.
 *
 * Paper ground, hairline arena ring, print crop marks, ink duelists
 * with a single vermilion/ultramarine accent each, tick-mark sparks,
 * thin expanding rings, and a rubber-stamp K.O. seal.
 */

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { createFight } from "@/lib/sim";
import { play, setSoundMuted } from "@/lib/sound";

const W = 960;
const H = 540;
const GY = 452;
const INK = "#221d15";
const FAINT = "rgba(23,20,15,0.10)";

export default function DuelCanvas({
  fightKey = 0,
  seed = 7,
  matchup = { a: "Fighter A", b: "Fighter B" },
  speed = 1,
  paused = false,
  sound = false,
  ambient = false,
  onEvent = () => {},
  className = "",
}) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const engineRef = useRef(null);
  const trailsRef = useRef([[], []]);
  const liveRef = useRef({ speed, paused, sound, onEvent });
  liveRef.current = { speed, paused, sound, onEvent };
  const motes = useMemo(() => makeMotes(), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const reduced =
      typeof window !== "undefined" &&
      window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const engine = createFight({
      seed,
      names: { ...matchup },
      onEvent: (e) => {
        if (e.type === "sfx") {
          if (liveRef.current.sound) play(e.name);
          return;
        }
        liveRef.current.onEvent(e);
      },
    });
    engine.state.reducedMotion = !!reduced;
    engineRef.current = engine;
    trailsRef.current = [[], []];
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [fightKey]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSoundMuted(!liveRef.current.sound);
  }, [sound]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    let raf = 0;
    let last = performance.now();

    const resize = () => {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * dpr));
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round((rect.width * H) / W * dpr));
    };
    resize();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
    ro.observe(canvas);

    const frame = (now) => {
      const engine = engineRef.current;
      if (engine) {
        engine.state.speed = liveRef.current.speed;
        engine.state.paused = liveRef.current.paused;
        engine.update((now - last) / 1000);
        draw(ctx, canvas, engine.state, motes, trailsRef.current, liveRef.current.paused, ambient);
      }
      last = now;
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      ro.disconnect();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      role="img"
      aria-label={`Simulated duel: ${matchup.a} versus ${matchup.b}`}
      className={className}
      style={{ width: "100%", aspectRatio: `${W} / ${H}`, display: "block" }}
    />
  );
}

function makeMotes() {
  const dots = [];
  let s = 777;
  const rnd = () => {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647;
    return s / 2147483647;
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
    dots.push({ x: rnd() * W, y: rnd() * H, r: 0.8 + rnd() * 1.4, ph: rnd() * 6.28, sp: 0.4 + rnd() });
  }
  return dots;
}

const spaced = (s) => s.split("").join("  ");

/* ============================== RENDER ============================== */

function draw(ctx, canvas, S, motes, trails, paused, ambient) {
  const t = S.t;
  ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.width / W, 0, 0);

  if (S.trauma > 0) {
    const m = S.trauma * S.trauma * 12;
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * m);
  }

  // paper
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bg.addColorStop(0, "#f8f5ee");
  bg.addColorStop(0.7, "#f3efe4");
  bg.addColorStop(1, "#e9e2d1");
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

  // faint grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = FAINT;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 48) {
    ctx.moveTo(x + 0.5, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 0.5, H);
  }
  for (let y = 0; y <= H; y += 48) {
    ctx.moveTo(0, y + 0.5);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y + 0.5);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // drifting motes
  for (const d of motes) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.16 + 0.1 * Math.sin(t * d.sp + d.ph);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8172";
    ctx.fillRect(d.x, (d.y - t * 6 * d.sp % H + H) % H, d.r, d.r);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // arena ring + center mark
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(23,20,15,0.35)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(W / 2, GY + 26, 330, 52, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setLineDash([6, 7]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(23,20,15,0.22)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(W / 2, GY + 26, 282, 42, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(240,78,0,0.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - 9, GY - 44);
  ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + 9, GY - 44);
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2, GY - 53);
  ctx.lineTo(W / 2, GY - 35);
  ctx.stroke();

  // print crop marks
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(23,20,15,0.55)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  const cm = 26;
  const L = 20;
  const corners = [[cm, cm, 1, 1], [W - cm, cm, -1, 1], [cm, H - cm, 1, -1], [W - cm, H - cm, -1, -1]];
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (const [x, y, dx, dy] of corners) {
    ctx.moveTo(x + dx * 10, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + dx * (10 + L), y);
    ctx.moveTo(x, y + dy * 10);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + dy * (10 + L));
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // plate caption
  ctx.font = '700 11px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(23,20,15,0.5)";
  ctx.fillText(spaced("PLATE I — THE CIRCLE"), 30, H - 22);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText(spaced(`SEED ${matchSeed(S)}`), W - 30, H - 22);

  // trails + fighters
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) drawTrail(ctx, trails[i], S.fighters[i].color);
  const [A, B] = S.fighters;
  drawFighter(ctx, A, B, t, trails[0]);
  drawFighter(ctx, B, A, t, trails[1]);

  // spark ticks
  for (const p of S.particles) {
    const a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
    if (p.kind === "spark") {
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.strokeStyle = p.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = p.size * 0.9;
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - p.vx * 0.028, p.y - p.vy * 0.028);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.7;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
    }
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // thin rings
  for (const r of S.rings) {
    const a = Math.max(0, r.life / r.maxLife);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.75;
    ctx.strokeStyle = r.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // floating notation
  for (const fl of S.floaters) {
    const age = fl.maxLife - fl.life;
    const pop = age < 0.16 ? 0.6 + (age / 0.16) * 0.4 : 1;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, fl.life / 0.4);
    ctx.font = `700 ${Math.round(fl.size * pop)}px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(246,243,236,0.9)";
    ctx.strokeText(fl.text, fl.x, fl.y);
    ctx.fillStyle = fl.color;
    ctx.fillText(fl.text, fl.x, fl.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // round pip
  if (S.phase === "fight" || S.phase === "ko") {
    ctx.font = '700 13px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(23,20,15,0.62)";
    ctx.fillText(spaced(`ROUND ${String(Math.max(1, S.turn)).padStart(2, "0")}`), W / 2, 36);
  }

  if (ambient) {
    hpBar(ctx, 30, 20, 180, S.fighters[0], false);
    hpBar(ctx, W - 210, 20, 180, S.fighters[1], true);
  }

  // intro card
  if (S.phase === "intro") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 8);
    ctx.font = '700 52px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = INK;
    ctx.fillText(spaced("READY"), W / 2, 205);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(23,20,15,0.4)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - 90, 228);
    ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + 90, 228);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // banner: KO stamp seal, or ink plate for decisions
  if (S.banner && S.bannerT > 0) {
    if (S.banner.stamp) {
      const age = 1.6 - S.bannerT;
      const pop = Math.min(1, age / 0.2);
      const sc = 1.35 - 0.35 * (1 - Math.pow(1 - pop, 3));
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(W / 2, 210);
      ctx.rotate(-0.07);
      ctx.scale(sc, sc);
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, pop * 1.4);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 84, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f04e00";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#f8f5ee";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 72, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f8f5ee";
      ctx.font = '700 58px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText(S.banner.big, 0, 3);
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    } else {
      ctx.font = '700 64px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.lineWidth = 6;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(246,243,236,0.9)";
      ctx.strokeText(S.banner.big, W / 2, 215);
      ctx.fillStyle = INK;
      ctx.fillText(S.banner.big, W / 2, 215);
    }
    ctx.font = '700 15px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = S.banner.stamp ? "#c43e00" : "rgba(23,20,15,0.7)";
    ctx.fillText(spaced(S.banner.sub), W / 2, 316);
  }

  if (S.flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(S.flash * 0.4).toFixed(3)})`;
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
  }

  // faint warm edge
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.42, W / 2, H / 2, H * 1.0);
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(90,70,40,0.14)");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

  if (paused) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(246,243,236,0.72)";
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
    ctx.font = '700 28px "Space Grotesk", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = INK;
    ctx.fillText(spaced("PAUSED"), W / 2, H / 2);
  }
}

function matchSeed() {
  return "—";
}

function hpBar(ctx, x, y, w, f, right) {
  const pct = Math.max(0, f.hp / f.maxHp);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(23,20,15,0.12)";
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 7);
  const bw = w * pct;
  ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
  ctx.fillRect(right ? x + w - bw : x, y, bw, 7);
}

/* ------------------------------ Fighter ------------------------------ */

function drawFighter(ctx, f, foe, t, trail) {
  const d = foe.x >= f.x ? 1 : -1;
  const C = f.color;
  const st = f.state;
  const sT = f.stateT;

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(23,20,15,0.16)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(f.x, GY + 8, 42, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  if (st === "down") {
    drawFallen(ctx, f, d);
    return;
  }

  const moving = Math.abs(f.vx) > 40;
  const bob = st === "victory" ? Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 7)) * -10 : Math.sin(t * 3.1 + f.seed) * 2.2;
  const crouch = st === "dodge" ? 16 : st === "strike" ? 7 : 0;
  const lean = st === "strike" ? 14 : st === "stagger" ? -16 : st === "dodge" ? -8 : st === "victory" ? 4 : moving ? 6 : 2;
  const runPh = t * 11 + f.seed;

  const hip = { x: f.x, y: GY - 54 + bob * 0.4 + crouch };
  const chest = { x: f.x + d * lean, y: hip.y - 48 };
  const neck = { x: chest.x + d * 3, y: chest.y - 8 };
  const head = { x: neck.x + d * 4, y: neck.y - 16 };

  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";

  let fF, fB;
  if (st === "strike") {
    fF = { x: f.x + d * 46, y: GY };
    fB = { x: f.x - d * 26, y: GY };
  } else if (moving) {
    fF = { x: f.x + d * (20 + Math.sin(runPh) * 12), y: GY - Math.max(0, Math.sin(runPh + 1.4)) * 9 };
    fB = { x: f.x - d * (20 + Math.sin(runPh + Math.PI) * 12), y: GY - Math.max(0, Math.sin(runPh + Math.PI + 1.4)) * 9 };
  } else {
    fF = { x: f.x + d * 22, y: GY };
    fB = { x: f.x - d * 17, y: GY };
  }
  limb(ctx, hip, knee(hip, fF, d, 10), fF, 6.5, INK);
  limb(ctx, hip, knee(hip, fB, -d, 8), fB, 6.5, "#57503f");

  // torso
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
  ctx.lineWidth = 9;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(chest.x, chest.y);
  ctx.stroke();

  // sword arm + blade
  const shoulder = { x: chest.x, y: chest.y + 4 };
  let hand, bladeAng;
  if (st === "strike") {
    const p = Math.min(1, sT / 0.3);
    hand = { x: chest.x + d * (30 + p * 30), y: chest.y - 6 + p * 10 };
    bladeAng = d === 1 ? -1.9 + p * 2.5 : Math.PI + 1.9 - p * 2.5;
  } else if (st === "victory") {
    hand = { x: chest.x + d * 10, y: chest.y - 34 };
    bladeAng = -Math.PI / 2 + d * 0.18;
  } else if (st === "stagger") {
    hand = { x: chest.x - d * 6, y: chest.y + 26 };
    bladeAng = d === 1 ? 0.7 : Math.PI - 0.7;
  } else {
    const sway = Math.sin(t * 2.2 + f.seed) * 3;
    hand = { x: chest.x + d * 24, y: chest.y + 2 + sway };
    bladeAng = d === 1 ? -1.15 : Math.PI + 1.15;
  }
  limb(ctx, shoulder, { x: (shoulder.x + hand.x) / 2 + d * 4, y: (shoulder.y + hand.y) / 2 + 8 }, hand, 5.5, INK);

  const BL = st === "victory" ? 72 : 64;
  const tip = { x: hand.x + Math.cos(bladeAng) * BL, y: hand.y + Math.sin(bladeAng) * BL };
  if (st === "strike") {
    trail.push({ x: tip.x, y: tip.y, life: 0.3, max: 0.3 });
    if (trail.length > 24) trail.shift();
  }
  // ink blade with a colored edge
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hand.x, hand.y);
  ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  const ex = Math.cos(bladeAng + Math.PI / 2) * 4;
  const ey = Math.sin(bladeAng + Math.PI / 2) * 4;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hand.x + ex, hand.y + ey);
  ctx.lineTo(tip.x + ex, tip.y + ey);
  ctx.stroke();
  // guard
  const gx = Math.cos(bladeAng + Math.PI / 2);
  const gy = Math.sin(bladeAng + Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hand.x - gx * 8, hand.y - gy * 8);
  ctx.lineTo(hand.x + gx * 8, hand.y + gy * 8);
  ctx.stroke();

  // off arm
  const off = { x: chest.x - d * 16, y: chest.y + 24 };
  limb(ctx, shoulder, { x: chest.x - d * 12, y: chest.y + 12 }, off, 5, "#57503f");

  // scarf — the accent
  const flutter = moving || st === "strike" ? 1.7 : 1;
  let sx = neck.x - d * 4;
  let sy = neck.y + 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
  for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
    sx -= d * 13;
    sy += Math.sin(t * 9 * flutter + f.seed + i * 1.3) * 4.5 * i * 0.5 + 2.4;
    ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // head: ink ring + accent visor tick
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(head.x, head.y, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(head.x + d * 1, head.y - 1);
  ctx.lineTo(head.x + d * 11, head.y - 1);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawFallen(ctx, f, d) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  const hip = { x: f.x, y: GY - 8 };
  const chest = { x: f.x - d * 40, y: GY - 14 };
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#57503f";
  ctx.lineWidth = 9;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(chest.x, chest.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#57503f";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(chest.x - d * 16, chest.y - 4, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#57503f";
  ctx.lineWidth = 5.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(hip.x + d * 26, GY - 2);
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(hip.x + d * 12, GY - 22);
  ctx.moveTo(chest.x, chest.y);
  ctx.lineTo(chest.x - d * 6, GY - 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  const sx = f.x + d * 34;
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(sx, GY - 2);
  ctx.lineTo(sx + 52, GY - 22);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function knee(a, b, d, bend) {
  return { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2 + d * bend, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 + 2 };
}

function limb(ctx, a, mid, b, w, color) {
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = w;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
  ctx.lineTo(mid.x, mid.y);
  ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawTrail(ctx, trail, color) {
  for (let i = trail.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = trail[i];
    p.life -= 1 / 60;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      trail.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
  }
  if (trail.length < 2) return;
  for (let i = 1; i < trail.length; i++) {
    const a = trail[i - 1];
    const b = trail[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha = (b.life / b.max) * 0.4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 5 * (i / trail.length) + 1;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
    ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Play, Pause, Volume2, VolumeX, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import DuelCanvas from "@/components/DuelCanvas";
import CommentaryTicker from "@/components/CommentaryTicker";
import VotePanel from "@/components/VotePanel";
import { Reveal } from "@/components/Reveal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/extras";
import { FIGHTERS, WEAPONS, ARENAS } from "@/lib/data";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const rnd = (n) => Math.floor(Math.random() * n);

function newBout() {
  const a = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  let b = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  while (b.id === a.id) b = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  return {
    a: a.name,
    b: b.name,
    seed: rnd(1_000_000),
    weapon: WEAPONS[rnd(WEAPONS.length)],
    arena: ARENAS[rnd(ARENAS.length)],
  };
}

const SPEEDS = [1, 2, 4];

export default function LivePage() {
  const [fightKey, setFightKey] = useState(0);
  const bout = useMemo(() => newBout(), [fightKey]);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(1);
  const [sound, setSound] = useState(false);
  const [hp, setHp] = useState({ a: 100, b: 100 });
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState([]);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("watch");
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const onEvent = useCallback((e) => {
    if (e.type === "hp") {
      setHp({ a: e.a, b: e.b });
      setTurn(e.turn);
    } else if (e.type === "line") {
      idRef.current += 1;
      const entry = { id: idRef.current, turn: e.turn, text: e.text, kind: e.kind };
      setLines((prev) => [...prev.slice(-49), entry]);
    } else if (e.type === "ko") {
      setPhase((p) => (p === "watch" ? "open" : p));
    } else if (e.type === "end") {
      setResult(e.result);
    }
  }, []);

  const rematch = useCallback(() => {
    setLines([]);
    setHp({ a: 100, b: 100 });
    setTurn(0);
    setPhase("watch");
    setResult(null);
    setPaused(false);
    setFightKey((k) => k + 1);
  }, []);

  const revealed = phase === "revealed" && result;
  const labelA = revealed ? result.names.a : "Fighter A";
  const labelB = revealed ? result.names.b : "Fighter B";

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6">
      <Reveal>
        <p className="micro text-accent-deep">Exhibit 01 — {bout.arena}</p>
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
          <h1 className="font-display text-3xl font-bold sm:text-5xl">
            <span className="text-fighter-a">{labelA}</span>
            <span className="mx-3 font-normal text-mute">vs</span>
            <span className="text-fighter-b">{labelB}</span>
          </h1>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Badge variant="ink">{bout.weapon}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="ink">{bout.arena}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="accent" className="tabular">
              Round {String(Math.max(1, turn)).padStart(2, "0")}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      {/* tale of the tape */}
      <Reveal delay={70}>
        <div className="mt-5 grid gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-xs border border-ink bg-ink sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr]">
          <div className="bg-card p-4">
            <p className="micro text-fighter-a">Vermilion corner</p>
            <p className="mt-1 truncate font-display text-lg font-bold">{labelA}</p>
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Progress value={hp.a} tone="accent" className="flex-1" aria-label={`${labelA} condition`} />
              <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular">{hp.a}</span>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-mute">
              {revealed ? `Elo ${FIGHTERS.find((f) => f.name === result.names.a)?.elo}` : "FILE SEALED UNTIL BALLOT"}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center bg-ink px-5 py-2">
            <span className="font-display text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-paper">VS</span>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-card p-4 sm:text-right">
            <p className="micro text-fighter-b">Ultramarine corner</p>
            <p className="mt-1 truncate font-display text-lg font-bold">{labelB}</p>
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular">{hp.b}</span>
              <Progress value={hp.b} tone="ultra" className="flex-1" aria-label={`${labelB} condition`} />
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-mute">
              {revealed ? `Elo ${FIGHTERS.find((f) => f.name === result.names.b)?.elo}` : "FILE SEALED UNTIL BALLOT"}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      {/* the plate */}
      <Reveal delay={120}>
        <figure className="mt-4 overflow-hidden rounded-xs border border-ink bg-card shadow-lift">
          <DuelCanvas
            fightKey={fightKey}
            seed={bout.seed}
            matchup={{ a: bout.a, b: bout.b }}
            speed={speed}
            paused={paused}
            sound={sound}
            onEvent={onEvent}
          />
          <figcaption className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-xs text-mute">
            <span>Fig. 1 — The circle, live. Ink on pixels.</span>
            <span className="font-mono tabular">seed {bout.seed}</span>
          </figcaption>
        </figure>
      </Reveal>

      {/* controls */}
      <Reveal delay={170}>
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => setPaused((p) => !p)} aria-pressed={paused}>
            {paused ? <Play size={13} /> : <Pause size={13} />}
            {paused ? "Resume" : "Pause"}
          </Button>
          <div className="flex border border-ink/70" role="group" aria-label="Playback speed">
            {SPEEDS.map((s, i) => (
              <button
                key={s}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSpeed(s)}
                aria-pressed={speed === s}
                className={cn(
                  "cursor-pointer px-3.5 py-2 font-display text-xs font-bold tabular transition-colors",
                  i > 0 && "border-l border-ink/70",
                  speed === s ? "bg-ink text-paper" : "bg-card text-mute hover:text-ink"
                )}
              >
                {s}×
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => setSound((s) => !s)} aria-pressed={sound}>
            {sound ? <Volume2 size={13} /> : <VolumeX size={13} />}
            {sound ? "Sound on" : "Sound off"}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={rematch}>
            <RotateCcw size={13} />
            New bout
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      {/* stenographer + ballot */}
      <div className="mt-6 grid items-start gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.2fr_1fr]">
        <Reveal delay={100}>
          <p className="micro mb-2 text-mute">The stenographer's log</p>
          <CommentaryTicker lines={lines} className="max-h-[380px] lg:max-h-[460px]" />
        </Reveal>
        <Reveal delay={170}>
          <p className="micro mb-2 text-mute">The ballot box</p>
          <VotePanel
            phase={phase}
            result={result}
            ballotNo={bout.seed % 10000}
            onVote={() => setPhase("revealed")}
            onRematch={rematch}
          />
        </Reveal>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const rnd = (n) => Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
const pickPair = () => {
  const a = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  let b = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];
  while (b.id === a.id) b = FIGHTERS[rnd(FIGHTERS.length)];

function LivePlate() {

        fightKey={key}
        seed={bout.seed}
        matchup={{ a: bout.a.name, b: bout.b.name }}

      </div>
    </figure>

function Stat({ value, suffix = "", label, sub }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([e]) => e.isIntersecting && (setOn(true), io.disconnect()),
      { threshold: 0.4 }
    );
    io.observe(el);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);
  const v = useCountUp(value, { active: on });
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="border-t-2 border-ink pt-3">
      <p className="font-display text-4xl font-bold tabular sm:text-5xl">
        {fmtInt(v)}
        <span className="text-accent-deep">{suffix}</span>
      </p>
      <p className="micro mt-2 text-ink">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-mute">{sub}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Reveal } from "@/components/Reveal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Callout } from "@/components/ui/extras";
import { TOURNAMENT } from "@/lib/data";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

function MatchCard({ match }) {
  const live = match.score === "live";
  const decided = match.winner != null;
  const row = (name, side) => {
    const won = decided && match.winner === side;
    const lost = decided && match.winner !== side;
    return (
      <div className={cn("flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm", won && "bg-ink text-paper")}>
        <span className={cn("truncate", won ? "font-bold" : lost ? "text-mute line-through" : "text-ink")}>
          {name}
        </span>
        {won && <span className="text-accent">◆</span>}
      </div>
    );
  };
  return (
    <div className={cn("rounded-xs border bg-card", live ? "border-accent shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--color-accent)]" : "border-line")}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 pt-2 pb-1">
        <span className="text-[11px] text-mute">
          {match.a === "TBD" ? "Awaiting the semifinals" : `${match.a} vs ${match.b}`}
        </span>
        {live ? (
          <Badge variant="accent">
            <span className="live-dot inline-block size-1.5 bg-accent text-accent" />
            Live
          </Badge>
        ) : (
          <Badge variant={decided ? "moss" : "dim"}>{match.score}</Badge>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-px p-1.5">
        {row(match.a, "a")}
        {row(match.b, "b")}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FormLetters({ form }) {
  return (
    <span className="flex gap-1 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold" aria-label={`Form: ${form.join(" ")}`}>
      {form.map((r, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          className={cn(
            "flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-xs border",
            r === "W" ? "border-moss/50 text-moss" : r === "L" ? "border-accent/50 text-accent-deep" : "border-line-strong text-mute"
          )}
        >
          {r}
        </span>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function FightersPage() {
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState("All");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("elo");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const filtered = provider === "All" ? [...FIGHTERS] : FIGHTERS.filter((f) => f.provider === provider);
    if (sort === "elo") filtered.sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo);
    else if (sort === "wins") filtered.sort((a, b) => b.wins - a.wins);
    else filtered.sort((a, b) => b.trend - a.trend);
    return filtered;
  }, [provider, sort]);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6">
      <Reveal>
        <p className="micro text-accent-deep">Exhibit 03 — The roster</p>
        <h1 className="mt-2 font-display text-3xl font-bold sm:text-5xl">The Card</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-[15px] text-ink-soft">
          {FIGHTERS.length} duelists from frontier labs and open-weight
          stables alike. In the circle they are all just steel — select a
          name to open its dossier.
        </p>
      </Reveal>

      <Reveal delay={70}>
        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Tabs value={provider} onValueChange={setProvider}>
            <TabsList aria-label="Filter by camp" className="max-w-full overflow-x-auto">
              <TabsTrigger value="All">All camps</TabsTrigger>
              {PROVIDERS.map((p) => (
                <TabsTrigger key={p} value={p}>
                  {p}
                </TabsTrigger>
              ))}
            </TabsList>
          </Tabs>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <p className="font-mono text-xs text-mute tabular">
              {rows.length} name{rows.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} on the card
            </p>
            <Tabs value={sort} onValueChange={setSort}>
              <TabsList aria-label="Sort the card">
                {SORTS.map((s) => (
                  <TabsTrigger key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                    {s.label}
                  </TabsTrigger>
                ))}
              </TabsList>
            </Tabs>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      <div className="mt-6 border-t-2 border-ink">
        {rows.map((f, i) => (
          <Reveal key={f.id} delay={Math.min(i, 8) * 40}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelected(f)}
              className="group grid w-full cursor-pointer grid-cols-[44px_1fr_auto] items-center gap-4 border-b border-line px-2 py-4 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-ink sm:grid-cols-[56px_1fr_1fr_auto_auto] sm:px-3"
            >
              <span className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-mute tabular group-hover:text-paper/60">
                {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
              </span>
              <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
                <Avatar name={f.name} hue={f.hue} size={40} />
                <span className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="block truncate font-display text-lg font-bold group-hover:text-paper">
                    {f.name}
                  </span>
                  <span className="block truncate text-xs text-mute">
                    {f.provider} · {f.wins}W {f.losses}L {f.draws}D
                  </span>
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className="hidden min-w-0 sm:block">
                <span className="block truncate text-[13px] text-ink-soft italic group-hover:text-paper/70">
                  “{f.blurb}”
                </span>
                <span className="mt-1.5 block"><FormLetters form={f.form} /></span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-right">
                <span className="block font-display text-2xl font-bold tabular group-hover:text-paper">
                  {fmtInt(f.elo)}
                </span>
                <span className={cn("block font-mono text-[11px] tabular",
                  f.trend > 0 ? "text-moss" : f.trend < 0 ? "text-accent-deep" : "text-mute")}>
                  {fmtDelta(f.trend)}
                </span>
              </span>
              <ArrowUpRight size={20} className="hidden text-mute transition-all group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:-translate-y-0.5 group-hover:text-accent sm:block" />
            </button>
          </Reveal>
        ))}
      </div>

      <Dialog open={!!selected} onClose={() => setSelected(null)}>
        {selected && (
          <>
            <DialogHeader>
              <p className="micro text-accent-deep">Dossier — {selected.provider}</p>
              <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-4">
                <Avatar name={selected.name} hue={selected.hue} size={60} />
                <div>
                  <DialogTitle className="text-2xl">{selected.name}</DialogTitle>
                  <DialogDescription>Elo {fmtInt(selected.elo)} · {fmtPct(selected.wins, selected.losses, selected.draws)} wins</DialogDescription>
                </div>
              </div>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="space-y-5 p-6">
              <p className="border-l-2 border-accent pl-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-soft italic">
                {selected.blurb}
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {selected.styles.map((s) => (
                  <Badge key={s} variant="ink">{s}</Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-px overflow-hidden border border-line bg-line sm:grid-cols-4">
                {[
                  ["Wins", fmtInt(selected.wins)],
                  ["Losses", fmtInt(selected.losses)],
                  ["Win rate", fmtPct(selected.wins, selected.losses, selected.draws)],
                  ["Streak", selected.streak > 0 ? `▲ ${selected.streak}` : "—"],
                ].map(([k, v]) => (
                  <div key={k} className="bg-card px-3 py-3 text-center">
                    <p className="font-display text-lg font-bold tabular">{v}</p>
                    <p className="micro mt-0.5 text-[9px] text-mute">{k}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border border-line px-4 py-3">
                <span className="micro text-mute">Recent form</span>
                <FormLetters form={selected.form} />
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Link href="/live" className="flex-1">
                  <Button className="w-full">Send to the circle</Button>
                </Link>
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setSelected(null)}>Close file</Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Search, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Reveal } from "@/components/Reveal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Input, Avatar } from "@/components/ui/extras";
import { FIGHTERS } from "@/lib/data";
import { fmtInt, fmtPct, fmtDelta } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const SORTS = [
  { id: "elo", label: "Elo rating" },
  { id: "winrate", label: "Win rate" },
  { id: "streak", label: "Hot streak" },
];

function winrate(f) {
  const n = f.wins + f.losses + f.draws;
  return n ? (f.wins + f.draws / 2) / n : 0;
}

function Trend({ value }) {
  if (value > 0) return <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-moss tabular">▲ {fmtDelta(value)}</span>;
  if (value < 0) return <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-accent-deep tabular">▼ {fmtDelta(value)}</span>;
  return <span className="font-mono text-xs text-mute tabular">— ±0</span>;
}

export default function LeaderboardPage() {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("elo");
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const query = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = FIGHTERS.filter(
      (f) => !query || f.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || f.provider.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
    const sorted = [...filtered];
    if (sort === "elo") sorted.sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo);
    else if (sort === "winrate") sorted.sort((a, b) => winrate(b) - winrate(a));
    else sorted.sort((a, b) => b.streak - a.streak || b.elo - a.elo);
    return sorted;
  }, [sort, q]);

  const top3 = rows.slice(0, 3);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6">
      <Reveal>
        <p className="micro text-accent-deep">Exhibit 02 — Season 4 standings</p>
        <h1 className="mt-2 font-display text-3xl font-bold sm:text-5xl">Rankings</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-[15px] text-ink-soft">
          Fourteen duelists ordered by blood and arithmetic. Every rank earned
          blind — minimum fifty judged bouts to hold a numbered slot.
        </p>
      </Reveal>

      <Reveal delay={70}>
        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <Tabs value={sort} onValueChange={setSort}>
            <TabsList aria-label="Sort rankings">
              {SORTS.map((s) => (
                <TabsTrigger key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                  {s.label}
                </TabsTrigger>
              ))}
            </TabsList>
          </Tabs>
          <div className="relative sm:w-64">
            <Search size={15} className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-3 -translate-y-1/2 text-mute" />
            <Input
              value={q}
              onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search the table…"
              aria-label="Search fighters"
              className="pl-9"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Reveal>

      {!q && (
        <div className="mt-8 grid gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-xs border border-ink bg-ink sm:grid-cols-3">
          {top3.map((f, i) => (
            <Reveal key={f.id} delay={i * 90}>
              <div className="flex h-full items-center gap-4 bg-card p-5">
                <span className={cn("font-display text-6xl font-bold tabular", i === 0 ? "text-accent-deep" : "text-line-strong")}>
                  {i + 1}
                </span>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <Avatar name={f.name} hue={f.hue} size={34} />
                  <p className="mt-2 truncate font-display text-base font-bold">{f.name}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-xs text-mute">{f.provider}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 font-display text-xl font-bold tabular">{fmtInt(f.elo)}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </Reveal>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <Reveal delay={120}>
        <div className="mt-6 border-t-2 border-ink">
          <div className="hidden grid-cols-[56px_1fr_110px_110px_80px_90px] items-center gap-3 border-b border-line px-2 py-2 lg:grid">
            {["№", "Duelist", "Record", "Win %", "Streak", "Trend"].map((h, i) => (
              <span key={h} className={cn("micro text-[10px] text-mute", i >= 2 && "text-right")}>{h}</span>
            ))}
          </div>
          {rows.map((f, i) => (
            <div
              key={f.id}
              className="grid grid-cols-[40px_1fr_auto] items-center gap-3 border-b border-line px-2 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-card lg:grid-cols-[56px_1fr_110px_110px_80px_90px]"
            >
              <span className={cn("font-display text-xl font-bold tabular", i < 3 ? "text-accent-deep" : "text-mute")}>
                {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
              </span>
              <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
                <Avatar name={f.name} hue={f.hue} size={36} />
                <span className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold text-ink">{f.name}</span>
                  <span className="block truncate text-xs text-mute">{f.provider}</span>
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-right font-mono text-xs tabular lg:text-right">
                <span className="lg:hidden text-mute">{fmtInt(f.elo)} · </span>
                {f.wins}–{f.losses}–{f.draws}

            <Button size="sm">
              Judge a duel <ArrowRight size={13} />
            </Button>
          </Link>

Stickblade Arena — Fight Program № 4
A from-zero reimagining of the Stickblade Arena frontend, second edition:
the arena presented as a printed fight program. Paper ground, ink
typography, hairline rules, exhibition numbering, rubber stamps and

sound.js

/**
 * Arcade audio — synthesized SFX, zero assets.
 * whoosh / hit / clash / crit / ko / bell / combo / cheer /
 * select / confirm / fight / beep / victory / click / reveal.
 */

let ctx = null;
let muted = false;
let noiseCache = null;

export function setSoundMuted(m) {
  muted = m;
}

function ac() {
  if (!ctx) {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return null;
    ctx = new AC();
  }
  if (ctx.state === "suspended") ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
  return ctx;
}

function noise(c) {
  if (noiseCache) return noiseCache;
  const len = c.sampleRate;
  const buf = c.createBuffer(1, len, c.sampleRate);
  const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
  noiseCache = buf;
  return buf;
}

function burst(c, t, { freq = 1200, q = 1, dur = 0.15, gain = 0.2, sweepTo = null, type = "bandpass" }) {
  const src = c.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = noise(c);
  const f = c.createBiquadFilter();
  f.type = type;
  f.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  if (sweepTo) f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(sweepTo, t + dur);
  f.Q.value = q;
  const g = c.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(gain, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + dur);
  src.connect(f).connect(g).connect(c.destination);
  src.start(t);
  src.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
}

function tone(c, t, { freq = 440, slideTo = null, dur = 0.15, gain = 0.15, type = "sine" }) {
  const o = c.createOscillator();
  o.type = type;
  o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t + dur);
  const g = c.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(gain, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + dur);
  o.connect(g).connect(c.destination);
  o.start(t);
  o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
}

export function play(name) {
  if (muted || typeof window === "undefined") return;
  try {
    const c = ac();
    if (!c) return;
    const t = c.currentTime;
    switch (name) {
      case "whoosh":
        burst(c, t, { freq: 500, sweepTo: 2600, dur: 0.16, gain: 0.1, q: 2 });
        break;
      case "hit":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 170, slideTo: 48, dur: 0.2, gain: 0.32 });
        burst(c, t, { freq: 300, dur: 0.12, gain: 0.16, type: "lowpass" });
        break;
      case "clash":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 1244, dur: 0.14, gain: 0.1, type: "square" });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 1866, dur: 0.11, gain: 0.08, type: "square" });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 932, dur: 0.18, gain: 0.1, type: "square" });
        burst(c, t, { freq: 5200, dur: 0.14, gain: 0.14, type: "highpass" });
        break;
      case "crit":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 150, slideTo: 44, dur: 0.24, gain: 0.36 });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 1567, dur: 0.16, gain: 0.1, type: "square" });
        burst(c, t, { freq: 4200, dur: 0.2, gain: 0.16, type: "highpass" });
        break;
      case "ko":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 95, slideTo: 28, dur: 0.7, gain: 0.5 });
        burst(c, t, { freq: 220, dur: 0.5, gain: 0.3, type: "lowpass" });
        tone(c, t + 0.05, { freq: 622, dur: 0.4, gain: 0.08, type: "triangle" });
        break;
      case "bell":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 880, dur: 0.6, gain: 0.12, type: "triangle" });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 1318, dur: 0.45, gain: 0.07, type: "triangle" });
        break;
      case "combo":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 880, slideTo: 1760, dur: 0.12, gain: 0.12, type: "square" });
        break;
      case "cheer": {
        // crowd roar: swelling band noise
        const src = c.createBufferSource();
        src.buffer = noise(c);
        src.loop = true;
        const f = c.createBiquadFilter();
        f.type = "bandpass";
        f.frequency.value = 900;
        f.Q.value = 0.6;
        const g = c.createGain();
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, t);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.22, t + 0.25);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 1.6);
        src.connect(f).connect(g).connect(c.destination);
        src.start(t);
        src.stop(t + 1.7);
        break;
      }
      case "select":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 520, dur: 0.06, gain: 0.1, type: "square" });
        break;
      case "confirm":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 523, dur: 0.09, gain: 0.12, type: "square" });
        tone(c, t + 0.08, { freq: 784, dur: 0.14, gain: 0.12, type: "square" });
        break;
      case "fight":
        // air horn: stacked saws
        tone(c, t, { freq: 233, dur: 0.5, gain: 0.2, type: "sawtooth" });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 311, dur: 0.5, gain: 0.16, type: "sawtooth" });
        tone(c, t, { freq: 466, dur: 0.5, gain: 0.1, type: "sawtooth" });
        break;
      case "beep":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 1046, dur: 0.09, gain: 0.14, type: "square" });
        break;
      case "victory":
        [523, 659, 784, 1046, 784, 1046].forEach((f, i) =>
          tone(c, t + i * 0.11, { freq: f, dur: 0.16, gain: 0.12, type: "square" })
        );
        break;
      case "click":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 660, dur: 0.05, gain: 0.08, type: "square" });
        break;
      case "reveal":
        tone(c, t, { freq: 523, dur: 0.16, gain: 0.12, type: "triangle" });
        tone(c, t + 0.09, { freq: 659, dur: 0.16, gain: 0.12, type: "triangle" });
        tone(c, t + 0.18, { freq: 784, dur: 0.3, gain: 0.14, type: "triangle" });
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  } catch {
    /* audio unavailable — the show goes on silently */
  }
}

announcer.js

/**
 * Ringside announcer — browser speech synthesis, zero assets.
 * "Round one… FIGHT!" in the deepest voice the browser has.
 */

let enabled = true;
let voiceCache = null;

export function setVoiceEnabled(v) {
  enabled = v;
  if (!v && typeof window !== "undefined" && "speechSynthesis" in window) {
    try {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
  }
}

function pickVoice() {
  if (voiceCache !== null) return voiceCache;
  try {
    const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
    voiceCache =
      voices.find((v) => /en[-_]/i.test(v.lang) && /male|daniel|david|fred|google uk english male/i.test(v.name)) ||
      voices.find((v) => /en[-_]/i.test(v.lang)) ||
      voices[0] ||
      null;
  } catch {
    voiceCache = null;
  }
  return voiceCache;
}

export function say(text, { rate = 1.02, pitch = 0.65, volume = 1 } = {}) {
  if (!enabled || typeof window === "undefined" || !("speechSynthesis" in window)) return;
  try {
    // warm the voice list (Chrome loads async)
    if (window.speechSynthesis.getVoices().length === 0) {
      window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => {
        voiceCache = null;
      };
    }
    const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    const v = pickVoice();
    if (v) u.voice = v;
    u.rate = rate;
    u.pitch = pitch;
    u.volume = volume;
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
  } catch {
    /* the show goes on silently */
  }
}

export function shutUp() {
  try {
    window.speechSynthesis?.cancel();
  } catch {
    /* silent */
  }
}
