sim.js
JS
/**
 * Fight Night engine — rounds, timer, combos and announcer cues.
 *
 * Owns turn scheduling, fighter physics, particles, shake, slow-mo,
 * commentary, combo tracking, the 60-second clock and the result.
 * The renderer paints it as a neon arcade cabinet.
 *
 * Blind-safe: commentary always says "Fighter A/B". Real names travel
 * only inside the final `end` event payload.
 */

export function mulberry32(a) {
  return function () {
    a |= 0;
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

const R = (rng, min, max) => min + rng() * (max - min);
const RI = (rng, min, max) => Math.floor(R(rng, min, max + 1));
const pick = (rng, arr) => arr[Math.floor(rng() * arr.length)];

const LINES = {
  open: [
    "The cabinet hums. Fighter A and Fighter B step onto the neon!",
    "Tokens are in. The crowd is LOUD tonight!",
    "Under the lights they go — A in magenta, B in cyan!",
    "No attract mode now. This one counts!",
  ],
  hit: [
    "{W} connects! {L} feels that one in the cheap seats!",
    "OH! A heavy slash from {W} — {L} is rocked!",
    "{W} punishes the whiff! The combo meter twitches!",
    "{L} left the door open and {W} kicked it down!",
  ],
  crit: [
    "MASSIVE! {W} nearly unplugs {L} with that counter!",
    "COUNTER HIT! {W} deletes half a lifebar off {L}!",
    "{W} reads {L} like a strategy guide — BRUTAL!",
  ],
  clash: [
    "CLASH! Sparks rain on the front row!",
    "Blades lock — neither fighter will blink first!",
    "{L} parries at the last frame! The crowd oohs!",
  ],
  miss: [
    "{W} swings at ghosts — {L} already left the building!",
    "WHIFF CITY! {L} makes {W} pay in embarrassment!",
    "{L} sidesteps with playground disrespect!",
  ],
  ko: [
    "K.O.! {W} takes the round and the crowd LOSES IT!",
    "IT'S OVER! {W} stands tall over {L}!",
    "DOWN GOES {L}! {W} is your winner by knockout!",
  ],
  time: [
    "TIME! The judges go to the cards — {W} takes it!",
    "The clock hits zero! {W} wins on remaining health!",
  ],
};

function fill(template, w, l) {
  return template.replaceAll("{W}", w).replaceAll("{L}", l);
}

const W = 960;
const MARK_A = 340;
const MARK_B = 620;
const MIN_X = 90;
const MAX_X = 870;
export const ROUND_TIME = 60;

export function createFight({ seed = 1, names = { a: "Fighter A", b: "Fighter B" }, onEvent = () => {} } = {}) {
  const rng = mulberry32(seed);
  const LA = "Fighter A";
  const LB = "Fighter B";

  const mk = (x, home, color) => ({
    x, home, vx: 0, hp: 100, maxHp: 100,
    state: "idle", stateT: 0, seed: rng() * 10, color,
  });

  const S = {
    t: 0,
    turn: 0,
    phase: "intro",
    introT: 1.4,
    koT: 0,
    method: null,
    winner: null,
    timeLeft: ROUND_TIME,
    lastTickSecond: ROUND_TIME,
    lastAttacker: 1,
    turnTimer: 0,
    slowmo: 1,
    trauma: 0,
    flash: 0,
    banner: null,
    bannerT: 0,
    combo: { side: -1, count: 0, timer: 0 },
    maxCombo: { side: -1, count: 0 },
    damage: [0, 0],
    fighters: [mk(60, MARK_A, "#ff2fb3"), mk(900, MARK_B, "#22e5ff")],
    impacts: [],
    particles: [],
    rings: [],
    floaters: [],
    log: [],
    speed: 1,
    paused: false,
    reducedMotion: false,
  };

  const emit = (e) => onEvent(e);
  const line = (turn, text, kind = "info") => {
    S.log.push({ turn, text });
    emit({ type: "line", turn, text, kind });
  };
  const hp = () =>
    emit({ type: "hp", turn: S.turn, a: Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[0].hp)), b: Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[1].hp)) });

  function burst(x, y, n, colors, power = 1) {
    const count = S.reducedMotion ? Math.ceil(n / 2) : n;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = R(rng, -Math.PI, Math.PI);
      const sp = R(rng, 90, 430) * power;
      S.particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 150,
        life: R(rng, 0.35, 0.9),
        maxLife: 0.9,
        size: R(rng, 1.6, 3.8),
        color: pick(rng, colors),
        grav: 950,
        kind: "spark",
      });
    }
    if (S.particles.length > 460) S.particles.splice(0, S.particles.length - 460);
  }

  function confetti(x, y, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      S.particles.push({
        x: x + R(rng, -60, 60), y: y + R(rng, -40, 40),
        vx: R(rng, -160, 160), vy: R(rng, -420, -120),
        life: R(rng, 0.8, 1.5), maxLife: 1.5,
        size: R(rng, 3, 6),
        color: pick(rng, ["#ff2fb3", "#22e5ff", "#ffd400", "#ffffff", "#3ddc84"]),
        grav: 700, kind: "chip",
      });
    }
  }

  function ring(x, y, color, max = 130) {
    S.rings.push({ x, y, r: 8, vr: 430, life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color, max });
  }

  function floater(x, y, text, color, size = 26) {
    S.floaters.push({ x, y, vy: -66, life: 1.05, maxLife: 1.05, text, color, size });
  }

  function shake(amount) {
    if (!S.reducedMotion) S.trauma = Math.min(1, S.trauma + amount);
  }

  function registerHit(side, dmg) {
    S.damage[side] += dmg;
    const c = S.combo;
    if (c.side === side && c.timer > 0) c.count += 1;
    else {
      c.side = side;
      c.count = 1;
    }
    c.timer = 2.6;
    if (c.count > S.maxCombo.count) S.maxCombo = { side, count: c.count };
    if (c.count >= 2) {
      emit({ type: "combo", side, count: c.count });
      if (c.count === 3 || c.count === 5 || c.count === 8) {
        floater(side === 0 ? 260 : 700, 170, c.count === 3 ? "TRIPLE!" : c.count === 5 ? "RAMPAGE!" : "UNSTOPPABLE!",
          "#ffd400", 30);
        emit({ type: "sfx", name: "combo" });
      }
    }
  }

  function breakCombo() {
    S.combo = { side: -1, count: 0, timer: 0 };
  }

  function startKO(loser, method) {
    const winner = loser === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    S.phase = "ko";
    S.method = method;
    S.winner = winner;
    S.koT = method === "ko" ? 1.7 : 1.4;
    S.slowmo = S.reducedMotion ? 1 : 0.26;
    const L = S.fighters[loser];
    const Wn = S.fighters[winner];
    L.state = "down";
    L.vx = (loser === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 170;
    breakCombo();
    if (method === "ko") {
      Wn.state = "victory";
      Wn.vx = 0;
      burst(L.x, 360, 48, ["#ffd400", "#ff2fb3", "#ffffff", winner === 0 ? "#ff2fb3" : "#22e5ff"], 1.45);
      confetti(L.x, 300, 30);
      ring(L.x, 380, "#ffd400", 230);
      S.flash = S.reducedMotion ? 0 : 0.9;
      shake(1);
      S.banner = { big: "K.O.!", sub: `${loser === 0 ? LB : LA} TAKES THE ROUND`, tilt: true };
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.ko), loser === 0 ? LB : LA, loser === 0 ? LA : LB).toUpperCase(), "ko");
      emit({ type: "announce", text: "K.O.!", voice: "Kayo!" });
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "ko" });
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "cheer" });
      emit({ type: "ko", winner });
    } else {
      S.banner = { big: "TIME!", sub: `THE CARDS READ ${winner === 0 ? "FIGHTER A" : "FIGHTER B"}`, tilt: true };
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.time), winner === 0 ? LA : LB, ""), "ko");
      emit({ type: "announce", text: "TIME!", voice: "Time!" });
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "bell" });
      emit({ type: "ko", winner });
    }
    S.bannerT = S.koT;
    hp();
  }

  function applyImpact(impact) {
    const { outcome, ai, di, dmg } = impact;
    const A = S.fighters[ai];
    const D = S.fighters[di];
    const AW = ai === 0 ? LA : LB;
    const DW = di === 0 ? LA : LB;
    const mx = (A.x + D.x) / 2;
    const my = 340;

    if (outcome === "miss") {
      D.state = "dodge";
      D.stateT = 0;
      D.vx += (di === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 120;
      breakCombo();
      floater(D.x, 250, "WHIFF", "#8f83b3", 19);
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.miss), AW, DW), "info");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "whoosh" });
    } else if (outcome === "clash") {
      A.state = "recover";
      A.stateT = 0;
      D.state = "recover";
      D.stateT = 0;
      A.vx += (ai === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 90;
      D.vx += (di === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 90;
      breakCombo();
      burst(mx, my, 16, ["#ffd400", "#ffffff", "#ff2fb3", "#22e5ff"], 1);
      ring(mx, my, "#ffd400");
      shake(0.45);
      floater(mx, 240, "CLASH!", "#ffd400", 24);
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, LINES.clash), AW, DW), "clash");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: "clash" });
    } else {
      const crit = outcome === "crit";
      D.hp -= dmg;
      D.state = "stagger";
      D.stateT = 0;
      D.vx += (di === 0 ? -1 : 1) * (crit ? 330 : 215);
      registerHit(ai, dmg);
      burst(D.x + (di === 0 ? 20 : -20), my, crit ? 26 : 13,
        crit ? ["#ffd400", "#ff2fb3", "#ffffff"] : [A.color, "#ffffff", "#ffd400"], crit ? 1.3 : 1);
      if (crit) {
        ring(D.x, my, A.color);
        S.flash = S.reducedMotion ? 0 : 0.45;
      }
      shake(crit ? 0.9 : 0.55);
      floater(D.x, 240, crit ? `COUNTER -${dmg}` : `-${dmg}`, crit ? "#ffd400" : "#ffffff", crit ? 27 : 25);
      line(S.turn, fill(pick(rng, crit ? LINES.crit : LINES.hit), AW, DW), crit ? "crit" : "hit");
      emit({ type: "sfx", name: crit ? "crit" : "hit" });
      hp();
      if (D.hp <= 0) {
        D.hp = 0;
        startKO(di, "ko");
        return;
      }
    }
    // sudden-death cap at 40 turns
    if (S.turn >= 40 && S.phase === "fight") {
      const [a, b] = S.fighters;
      if (Math.abs(a.hp - b.hp) < 4) {
        S.phase = "ko";
        S.method = "draw";
        S.winner = "draw";
        S.koT = 1.4;
        S.slowmo = 1;
        S.banner = { big: "DRAW!", sub: "THE JUDGES CANNOT SPLIT THEM", tilt: true };
        S.bannerT = S.koT;
        line(S.turn, "DOUBLE K.O. ZONE — NOTHING IN IT! A DRAW!", "ko");
        emit({ type: "announce", text: "DRAW!", voice: "Draw!" });
        emit({ type: "sfx", name: "bell" });
        emit({ type: "ko", winner: "draw" });
      } else {
        startKO(a.hp < b.hp ? 0 : 1, "decision");
      }
    }
  }

  function doTurn() {
    S.turn += 1;
    const repeat = rng() < 0.32;
    const ai = repeat ? S.lastAttacker : 1 - S.lastAttacker;
    const di = 1 - ai;
    S.lastAttacker = ai;
    const A = S.fighters[ai];
    A.state = "strike";
    A.stateT = 0;
    A.vx += (ai === 0 ? 1 : -1) * 265;
    S.fighters[di].state = "brace";
    S.fighters[di].stateT = 0;

    const roll = rng();
    const outcome = roll < 0.13 ? "crit" : roll < 0.42 ? "clash" : roll < 0.57 ? "miss" : "hit";
    const dmg = outcome === "crit" ? RI(rng, 13, 21) : outcome === "hit" ? RI(rng, 6, 12) : 0;
    S.impacts.push({ at: S.t + 0.24, outcome, ai, di, dmg });
    emit({ type: "sfx", name: "whoosh" });
    emit({ type: "turn", turn: S.turn });
  }

  function update(rawDt) {
    if (S.paused || S.phase === "ended") return;
    const dt = Math.min(rawDt, 0.05) * S.speed;
    const worldDt = dt * (S.phase === "ko" ? S.slowmo : 1);
    S.t += worldDt;

    // rising neon dust
    if (rng() < worldDt * 7 && S.particles.length < 460) {
      S.particles.push({
        x: R(rng, 40, W - 40), y: 560,
        vx: R(rng, -14, 14), vy: R(rng, -46, -18),
        life: R(rng, 4, 7), maxLife: 7,
        size: R(rng, 1, 2.4),
        color: pick(rng, ["#ff2fb3", "#22e5ff", "#ffd400"]),
        grav: -6, kind: "ember",
      });
    }

    if (S.phase === "intro") {
      S.introT -= dt;
      for (const f of S.fighters) {
        f.x += (f.home - f.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.2);
        f.stateT += worldDt;
      }
      if (S.introT <= 0) {
        S.phase = "fight";
        S.turnTimer = 0.5;
        line(0, pick(rng, LINES.open), "info");
        emit({ type: "announce", text: "FIGHT!", voice: "Round one. Fight!" });
        emit({ type: "sfx", name: "fight" });
        hp();
      }
    } else if (S.phase === "fight") {
      // the clock
      S.timeLeft -= dt;
      const whole = Math.ceil(S.timeLeft);
      if (whole !== S.lastTickSecond) {
        S.lastTickSecond = whole;
        emit({ type: "clock", timeLeft: Math.max(0, whole) });
        if (whole <= 5 && whole > 0) emit({ type: "sfx", name: "beep" });
      }
      if (S.timeLeft <= 0) {
        const [a, b] = S.fighters;
        if (Math.abs(a.hp - b.hp) < 4) {
          S.phase = "ko";
          S.method = "draw";
          S.winner = "draw";
          S.koT = 1.4;
          S.slowmo = 1;
          S.banner = { big: "DRAW!", sub: "DEAD EVEN AT THE BELL", tilt: true };
          S.bannerT = S.koT;
          line(S.turn, "THE BELL — NOTHING BETWEEN THEM! A DRAW!", "ko");
          emit({ type: "announce", text: "DRAW!", voice: "Draw!" });
          emit({ type: "sfx", name: "bell" });
          emit({ type: "ko", winner: "draw" });
        } else {
          startKO(a.hp < b.hp ? 0 : 1, "decision");
        }
      } else {
        S.turnTimer -= dt;
        if (S.turnTimer <= 0) {
          doTurn();
          S.turnTimer = R(rng, 1.15, 1.6);
        }
      }
      // combo window decay
      if (S.combo.timer > 0) {
        S.combo.timer -= dt;
        if (S.combo.timer <= 0) breakCombo();
      }
    } else if (S.phase === "ko") {
      S.koT -= dt;
      S.bannerT = Math.max(0, S.bannerT - dt);
      if (S.koT <= 0) {
        S.phase = "ended";
        S.bannerT = 0;
        const flawless = S.winner !== "draw" && S.fighters[S.winner].hp >= 100;
        emit({
          type: "end",
          result: {
            winner: S.winner,
            method: S.method,
            turns: S.turn,
            names: { ...names },
            hp: [Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[0].hp)), Math.max(0, Math.round(S.fighters[1].hp))],
            damage: [...S.damage],
            maxCombo: { ...S.maxCombo },
            flawless,
            timeLeft: Math.max(0, Math.ceil(S.timeLeft)),
            log: [...S.log],
          },
        });
      }
    }

    for (let i = S.impacts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (S.impacts[i].at <= S.t) {
        const [im] = S.impacts.splice(i, 1);
        if (S.phase === "fight") applyImpact(im);
      }
    }

    for (const f of S.fighters) {
      f.stateT += worldDt;
      if ((f.state === "strike" || f.state === "stagger" || f.state === "dodge" || f.state === "recover" || f.state === "brace") && f.stateT > 0.55) {
        f.state = "idle";
        f.stateT = 0;
      }
      if (f.state !== "down") {
        const pull = (f.home - f.x) * 1.6;
        f.vx += pull * worldDt;
        f.vx *= Math.pow(0.06, worldDt);
        f.x += f.vx * worldDt;
      } else {
        f.vx *= Math.pow(0.01, worldDt);
        f.x += f.vx * worldDt;
      }
      f.x = Math.max(MIN_X, Math.min(MAX_X, f.x));
    }

    for (let i = S.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = S.particles[i];
      p.life -= worldDt;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        S.particles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      p.vy += p.grav * worldDt;
      p.x += p.vx * worldDt;
      p.y += p.vy * worldDt;
    }
    for (let i = S.rings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const r = S.rings[i];
      r.life -= worldDt;
      r.r += r.vr * worldDt;
      if (r.life <= 0 || r.r > r.max) S.rings.splice(i, 1);
    }
    for (let i = S.floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const fl = S.floaters[i];
      fl.life -= dt;
      fl.y += fl.vy * dt;
      if (fl.life <= 0) S.floaters.splice(i, 1);
    }
    S.trauma = Math.max(0, S.trauma - dt * 1.7);
    S.flash = Math.max(0, S.flash - dt * 2.4);
  }

  return { state: S, update };
}

"use client";

import { Info } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

/* ---------- Input ---------- */
export function Input({ className, ...props }) {
  return (
    <input
      className={cn(
        "h-11 w-full rounded-sm border-2 border-line bg-abyss px-3.5 text-sm text-bone placeholder:text-mute",
        "transition-colors hover:border-line-bright focus:border-gold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold/25 focus:outline-none",
        "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-45",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

/* ---------- Progress ---------- */
const TONES = {
  p1: "bg-p1 shadow-p1",
  p2: "bg-p2 shadow-p2",
  gold: "bg-gold",
  mint: "bg-mint",
  blood: "bg-blood",
};

export function Progress({ value = 0, max = 100, tone = "gold", className, barClassName, ...props }) {
  const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (value / max) * 100));
  return (
    <div
      role="progressbar"
      aria-valuenow={Math.round(pct)}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={100}
      className={cn("h-3 w-full -skew-x-12 overflow-hidden rounded-[2px] border border-line bg-abyss", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className={cn("h-full transition-[width] duration-500", TONES[tone], barClassName)} style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- Skeleton ---------- */
export function Skeleton({ className, ...props }) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn("rounded-xs bg-[linear-gradient(100deg,var(--color-panel2)_30%,#33235c_50%,var(--color-panel2)_70%)] bg-[length:200%_100%] [animation:shimmerSlide_1.4s_linear_infinite]", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

/* ---------- Callout ---------- */
const CALLOUT = {
  gold: "border-gold/60 bg-gold/[0.07] text-gold",
  p1: "border-p1/60 bg-p1/[0.08] text-p1",
  p2: "border-p2/50 bg-p2/[0.07] text-p2",
  mint: "border-mint/50 bg-mint/[0.07] text-mint",
};

export function Callout({ tone = "gold", title, children, className }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex gap-3 rounded-sm border-2 border-l-8 p-4", CALLOUT[tone], className)}>
      <Info size={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
      <div className="text-sm leading-relaxed">
        {title && <p className="mb-1 font-head font-bold tracking-wide">{title}</p>}
        <div className="text-fog/90">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- Avatar: neon arcade tile ---------- */
export function Avatar({ name = "?", hue = 20, size = 40, neon = null, className }) {
  const initials = name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((w) => w[0])
    .slice(0, 2)
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={cn("inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-sm font-display", className)}
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        fontSize: Math.max(10, size * 0.3),
        background: `linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(${hue} 60% 30%), hsl(${(hue + 60) % 360} 65% 18%))`,
        color: "#fff",
        boxShadow: neon
          ? `0 0 0 2px ${neon}, 0 0 18px -2px ${neon}`
          : "inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
        textShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)",
      }}
    >
      {initials}
    </span>
  );
}

/* ---------- Separator ---------- */
export function Separator({ className, ...props }) {
  return <div aria-hidden="true" className={cn("h-0.5 w-full bg-line", className)} {...props} />;
}

dialog.jsx
JS
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export function Dialog({ open, onClose, children, wide = false }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose?.();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/75 p-4 backdrop-blur-[2px]"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "pop-in relative max-h-[88vh] w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-md border-2 border-line-bright bg-panel shadow-card",
          wide ? "max-w-3xl" : "max-w-lg"
        )}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="h-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-p1 via-gold to-p2" />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close dialog"
          autoFocus
          className="absolute top-4 right-3 cursor-pointer rounded-xs border border-line p-1.5 text-dim transition-colors hover:border-gold hover:text-gold"
        >
          <X size={16} />
        </button>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }) {
  return <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-6 pb-0", className)} {...props} />;
}

export function DialogTitle({ className, ...props }) {
  return (
    <h2 className={cn("font-display text-xl tracking-wide text-bone", className)} {...props} />
  );
}

export function DialogDescription({ className, ...props }) {
  return <p className={cn("text-sm leading-relaxed text-dim", className)} {...props} />;
}

tabs.jsx
JS
"use client";

import { createContext, useContext } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const TabsCtx = createContext(null);

export function Tabs({ value, onValueChange, className, children, ...props }) {
  return (
    <TabsCtx.Provider value={{ value, onValueChange }}>
      <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-4", className)} {...props}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </TabsCtx.Provider>
  );
}

export function TabsList({ className, children, ...props }) {
  return (
    <div
      role="tablist"
      aria-label="Tabs"
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex w-fit max-w-full -skew-x-3 flex-wrap items-center gap-1 border-2 border-line bg-abyss p-1",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function TabsTrigger({ value, className, children, ...props }) {
  const ctx = useContext(TabsCtx);
  const active = ctx?.value === value;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="tab"
      aria-selected={active}
      onClick={() => ctx?.onValueChange?.(value)}
      className={cn(
        "skew-x-3 cursor-pointer px-4 py-2 font-head text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] transition-all",
        active ? "bg-gold text-black shadow-[0_0_18px_-2px_rgba(255,212,0,0.7)]" : "text-dim hover:text-bone",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { EyeOff, RotateCcw, Users, Gavel } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "./ui/button";
import { Badge } from "./ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "./ui/card";
import { Avatar } from "./ui/extras";
import { fighterByName } from "@/lib/data";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const SIDES = [
  { id: "a", label: "1P wins", color: "#ff2fb3" },
  { id: "draw", label: "Draw", color: "#8f83b3" },
  { id: "b", label: "2P wins", color: "#22e5ff" },
];

/**
 * The judges' table. phase: "watch" | "open" | "revealed"
 */
export default function VotePanel({ phase, result, onVote, onRematch }) {
  const [choice, setChoice] = useState(null);
  const [confidence, setConfidence] = useState(3);

  if (phase === "watch") {
    return (
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="flex items-center gap-4 p-5">
          <span className="flex size-11 shrink-0 -skew-x-6 items-center justify-center rounded-xs border-2 border-gold/60 bg-gold/10 text-gold">
            <Gavel size={20} className="skew-x-6" />
          </span>
          <div>
            <p className="font-head text-sm font-bold tracking-widest text-bone uppercase">
              Judges' call at the final bell
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-dim">
              Scorecards unlock at the K.O. Names stay sealed until you score it.
            </p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (phase === "revealed" && result) {
    const a = fighterByName(result.names.a);
    const b = fighterByName(result.names.b);
    const winnerName =
      result.winner === "draw" ? null : result.winner === 0 ? result.names.a : result.names.b;
    const stats = [
      ["Damage", `${result.damage?.[0] ?? "–"} / ${result.damage?.[1] ?? "–"}`],
      ["Best combo", result.maxCombo?.count >= 2 ? `${result.maxCombo.count} hits ${result.maxCombo.side === 0 ? "1P" : "2P"}` : "—"],
      ["Turns", result.turns],
      ["Clock", result.method === "ko" ? `${result.timeLeft}s left` : "0:00"],
    ];
    return (
      <Card className="pop-in overflow-hidden border-gold/50">
        <div className="h-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-p1 via-gold to-p2" />
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <Badge variant="solid">
              {result.method === "ko" ? "Knockout" : result.method === "draw" ? "Draw" : "Decision"}
            </Badge>
            {result.flawless && <Badge variant="gold">Flawless victory</Badge>}
          </div>
          <CardTitle className="mt-2 text-2xl leading-tight sm:text-3xl">
            {winnerName ? (
              <>
                <span className="neon-gold">{winnerName}</span> wins!
              </>
            ) : (
              "Double down — draw!"
            )}
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Masks off: {result.names.a} fought as <b className="text-p1">1P</b>, {result.names.b} as{" "}
            <b className="text-p2">2P</b>.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {[
            { f: a, won: result.winner === 0, neon: "#ff2fb3" },
            { f: b, won: result.winner === 1, neon: "#22e5ff" },
          ].map(({ f, won, neon }, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-3 rounded-sm border-2 p-3",
                won ? "border-gold/70 bg-gold/[0.06]" : "border-line"
              )}
            >
              <Avatar name={f?.name || "?"} hue={f?.hue ?? 20} size={40} neon={won ? neon : null} />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-bone">
                  {f?.name} {won && <span className="text-gold">★</span>}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-dim">
                  {f?.provider} · Elo {f?.elo}
                </p>
              </div>
              <Badge variant={won ? "gold" : "dim"}>{won ? "+16" : "−16"}</Badge>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-sm border border-line bg-line sm:grid-cols-4">
            {stats.map(([k, v]) => (
              <div key={k} className="bg-abyss px-2 py-2.5 text-center">
                <p className="font-display text-sm text-bone">{v}</p>
                <p className="tag mt-1 text-[9px] text-mute">{k}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button onClick={onRematch} className="flex-1">
              <RotateCcw size={14} />
              Rematch
            </Button>
            <Link href="/select" className="flex-1">
              <Button variant="cyan" className="w-full">
                <Users size={14} />
                New fighters
              </Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  // phase === "open" — scorecards
  return (
    <Card className="pop-in border-p1/50">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Gavel size={18} className="text-gold" />
            Score it!
          </CardTitle>
          <Badge variant="blood">
            <EyeOff size={12} />
            Blind
          </Badge>
        </div>
        <CardDescription>
          The bell has rung. Score the fight — the reveal drops on lock-in.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Your scorecard">
          {SIDES.map((s) => (
            <button
              key={s.id}
              type="button"
              role="radio"
              aria-checked={choice === s.id}
              onClick={() => setChoice(s.id)}
              className={cn(
                "-skew-x-3 cursor-pointer rounded-xs border-2 p-3 text-center transition-all duration-150",
                choice === s.id
                  ? "border-gold bg-gold/10 shadow-[0_0_20px_-4px_rgba(255,212,0,0.7)]"
                  : "border-line bg-abyss hover:border-line-bright"
              )}
            >
              <span className="block skew-x-3">
                <span
                  className="mx-auto mb-2 block size-3 rounded-full"
                  style={{ background: s.color, boxShadow: `0 0 12px ${s.color}` }}
                />
                <span className="block font-head text-sm font-bold text-bone">{s.label}</span>
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div>
          <p className="tag mb-2 text-[10px] text-mute">Confidence</p>
          <div className="flex gap-1.5" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Confidence">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
              <button
                key={n}
                type="button"
                role="radio"
                aria-checked={confidence === n}
                aria-label={`Confidence ${n} of 5`}
                onClick={() => setConfidence(n)}
                className={cn(
                  "h-9 flex-1 cursor-pointer rounded-xs border-2 font-head text-sm font-bold transition-all",
                  confidence === n
                    ? "border-gold bg-gold text-black"
                    : "border-line text-dim hover:border-line-bright hover:text-fog"
                )}
              >
                {n}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <Button size="lg" className="w-full" disabled={!choice} onClick={() => choice && onVote(choice, confidence)}>
          Lock in & reveal
        </Button>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

DuelCanvas.jsx
JS
"use client";

/**
 * DuelCanvas, Fight Night edition — the bout as a neon arcade cabinet.
 *
 * Violet-black stage, perspective grid floor, split magenta/cyan ring,
 * waving neon crowd, spotlight beams, scanlines, glow-ink duelists,
 * confetti KOs and slam-in Bungee banners.
 */

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { createFight } from "@/lib/sim";
import { play, setSoundMuted } from "@/lib/sound";

const W = 960;
const H = 540;
const GY = 452;

export default function DuelCanvas({
  fightKey = 0,
  seed = 7,
  matchup = { a: "Fighter A", b: "Fighter B" },
  speed = 1,
  paused = false,
  sound = false,
  ambient = false,
  onEvent = () => {},
  className = "",
}) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const engineRef = useRef(null);
  const trailsRef = useRef([[], []]);
  const crowd = useMemo(makeCrowd, []);
  const liveRef = useRef({ speed, paused, sound, onEvent });
  liveRef.current = { speed, paused, sound, onEvent };

  useEffect(() => {
    const reduced =
      typeof window !== "undefined" &&
      window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const engine = createFight({
      seed,
      names: { ...matchup },
      onEvent: (e) => {
        if (e.type === "sfx") {
          if (liveRef.current.sound) play(e.name);
          return;
        }
        liveRef.current.onEvent(e);
      },
    });
    engine.state.reducedMotion = !!reduced;
    engineRef.current = engine;
    trailsRef.current = [[], []];
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [fightKey]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSoundMuted(!liveRef.current.sound);
  }, [sound]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    let raf = 0;
    let last = performance.now();

    const resize = () => {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * dpr));
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round((rect.width * H) / W * dpr));
    };
    resize();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
    ro.observe(canvas);

    const frame = (now) => {
      const engine = engineRef.current;
      if (engine) {
        engine.state.speed = liveRef.current.speed;
        engine.state.paused = liveRef.current.paused;
        engine.update((now - last) / 1000);
        draw(ctx, canvas, engine.state, crowd, trailsRef.current, liveRef.current.paused, ambient);
      }
      last = now;
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      ro.disconnect();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      role="img"
      aria-label={`Simulated duel: ${matchup.a} versus ${matchup.b}`}
      className={className}
      style={{ width: "100%", aspectRatio: `${W} / ${H}`, display: "block" }}
    />
  );
}

function makeCrowd() {
  const dots = [];
  let s = 4242;
  const rnd = () => {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647;
    return s / 2147483647;
  };
  const hues = ["#ff2fb3", "#22e5ff", "#ffd400", "#8f83b3", "#3ddc84"];
  for (let row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      dots.push({
        x: 16 + rnd() * (W - 32),
        y: 46 + row * 30 + rnd() * 14,
        r: 1.4 + rnd() * 2,
        ph: rnd() * Math.PI * 2,
        sp: 2 + rnd() * 3,
        c: hues[Math.floor(rnd() * hues.length)],
      });
    }
  }
  return dots;
}

/* ============================== RENDER ============================== */

function draw(ctx, canvas, S, crowd, trails, paused, ambient) {
  const t = S.t;
  ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.width / W, 0, 0);

  if (S.trauma > 0) {
    const m = S.trauma * S.trauma * 13;
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * m);
  }

  // cabinet backdrop
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  sky.addColorStop(0, "#070310");
  sky.addColorStop(0.55, "#120a24");
  sky.addColorStop(1, "#0c0614");
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

  // corner glow orbs
  orb(ctx, S.fighters[0].x, 300, "#ff2fb3", 0.14);
  orb(ctx, S.fighters[1].x, 300, "#22e5ff", 0.13);

  // waving crowd
  for (const d of crowd) {
    const wave = 0.3 + 0.7 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * d.sp + d.ph + d.x * 0.01));
    ctx.globalAlpha = wave;
    ctx.fillStyle = d.c;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y + Math.sin(t * d.sp + d.ph) * 2, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // spotlight beams
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,47,179,0.06)";
  beam(ctx, 200, -10, 320, GY);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(34,229,255,0.06)";
  beam(ctx, 760, -10, 640, GY);

  // perspective grid floor
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0d0718";
  ctx.fillRect(-20, GY - 60, W + 40, H - GY + 80);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(106,75,179,0.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i <= 12; i++) {
    const x = 60 + (i * (W - 120)) / 12;
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + (x - W / 2) * 0.25, GY - 52);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H + 10);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const y = GY - 40 + i * i * 2.4 + i * 14;
    ctx.moveTo(-20, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W + 20, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // split neon ring
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(140, 0, 820, 0);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "#ff2fb3");
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, "#ffd400");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "#22e5ff");
  ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(255,47,179,0.8)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 22;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(W / 2, GY + 26, 330, 52, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) drawTrail(ctx, trails[i], S.fighters[i].color);

  const [A, B] = S.fighters;
  drawFighter(ctx, A, B, t, trails[0]);
  drawFighter(ctx, B, A, t, trails[1]);

  // particles
  for (const p of S.particles) {
    const a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
    if (p.kind === "spark") {
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.strokeStyle = p.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = p.size * 0.85;
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - p.vx * 0.03, p.y - p.vy * 0.03);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.kind === "chip") {
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.life * 9);
      ctx.fillRect(-p.size / 2, -p.size / 2, p.size, p.size * 0.7);
      ctx.restore();
    } else {
      ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.85;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // rings
  for (const r of S.rings) {
    const a = Math.max(0, r.life / r.maxLife);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.85;
    ctx.strokeStyle = r.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 + 5 * a;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // floaters
  for (const fl of S.floaters) {
    const age = fl.maxLife - fl.life;
    const pop = age < 0.16 ? 0.6 + (age / 0.16) * 0.4 : 1;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, fl.life / 0.4);
    ctx.font = `${Math.round(fl.size * pop)}px Bungee, sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.85)";
    ctx.strokeText(fl.text, fl.x, fl.y);
    ctx.fillStyle = fl.color;
    ctx.fillText(fl.text, fl.x, fl.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  if (ambient) {
    hpBar(ctx, 24, 18, 200, S.fighters[0], false);
    hpBar(ctx, W - 224, 18, 200, S.fighters[1], true);
    ctx.font = "11px Bungee, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,240,255,0.75)";
    ctx.fillText("DEMO FIGHT — INSERT COIN", W / 2, 30);
  }

  // intro card
  if (S.phase === "intro") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 9);
    ctx.font = "46px Bungee, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.85)";
    ctx.strokeText("READY?", W / 2, 210);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd400";
    ctx.fillText("READY?", W / 2, 210);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // KO / time / draw banner
  if (S.banner && S.bannerT > 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W / 2, 218);
    ctx.rotate(-0.045);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "104px Bungee, sans-serif";
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(255,47,179,0.9)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 50;
    ctx.lineWidth = 12;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.9)";
    ctx.strokeText(S.banner.big, 0, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillText(S.banner.big, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.font = "700 20px 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd400";
    ctx.fillText(S.banner.sub, W / 2, 268);
  }

  if (S.flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,240,255,${(S.flash * 0.3).toFixed(3)})`;
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
  }

  // scanlines + vignette
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.13)";
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 3) ctx.fillRect(-20, y, W + 40, 1);
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.36, W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.95);
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.62)");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

  if (paused) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(7,3,16,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
    ctx.font = "30px Bungee, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4f0ff";
    ctx.fillText("PAUSED", W / 2, H / 2);
  }
}

function orb(ctx, x, y, color, a) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 10, x, y, 200);
  const r = parseInt(color.slice(1, 3), 16);
  const gg = parseInt(color.slice(3, 5), 16);
  const b = parseInt(color.slice(5, 7), 16);
  g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${r},${gg},${b},${a})`);
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(x - 210, y - 210, 420, 420);
}

function beam(ctx, xTop, yTop, xBot, yBot) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(xTop - 26, yTop);
  ctx.lineTo(xTop + 26, yTop);
  ctx.lineTo(xBot + 90, yBot);
  ctx.lineTo(xBot - 90, yBot);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function hpBar(ctx, x, y, w, f, right) {
  const pct = Math.max(0, f.hp / f.maxHp);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 10);
  const bw = w * pct;
  ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
  ctx.fillRect(right ? x + w - bw : x, y, bw, 10);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, w - 1, 9);
}

/* ------------------------------ Fighter ------------------------------ */

function drawFighter(ctx, f, foe, t, trail) {
  const d = foe.x >= f.x ? 1 : -1;
  const C = f.color;
  const st = f.state;
  const sT = f.stateT;

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(f.x, GY + 8, 44, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  if (st === "down") {
    drawFallen(ctx, f, d, C);
    return;
  }

  const moving = Math.abs(f.vx) > 40;
  const bob = st === "victory" ? Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 7)) * -10 : Math.sin(t * 3.1 + f.seed) * 2.2;
  const crouch = st === "dodge" ? 16 : st === "strike" ? 7 : 0;
  const lean = st === "strike" ? 14 : st === "stagger" ? -16 : st === "dodge" ? -8 : st === "victory" ? 4 : moving ? 6 : 2;
  const runPh = t * 11 + f.seed;

  const hip = { x: f.x, y: GY - 54 + bob * 0.4 + crouch };
  const chest = { x: f.x + d * lean, y: hip.y - 48 };
  const neck = { x: chest.x + d * 3, y: chest.y - 8 };
  const head = { x: neck.x + d * 4, y: neck.y - 16 };

  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";

  let fF, fB;
  if (st === "strike") {
    fF = { x: f.x + d * 46, y: GY };
    fB = { x: f.x - d * 26, y: GY };
  } else if (moving) {
    fF = { x: f.x + d * (20 + Math.sin(runPh) * 12), y: GY - Math.max(0, Math.sin(runPh + 1.4)) * 9 };
    fB = { x: f.x - d * (20 + Math.sin(runPh + Math.PI) * 12), y: GY - Math.max(0, Math.sin(runPh + Math.PI + 1.4)) * 9 };
  } else {
    fF = { x: f.x + d * 22, y: GY };
    fB = { x: f.x - d * 17, y: GY };
  }
  limb(ctx, hip, knee(hip, fF, d, 10), fF, 7, "#2c2347");
  limb(ctx, hip, knee(hip, fB, -d, 8), fB, 7, "#221b3a");

  // torso with neon core
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#352a57";
  ctx.lineWidth = 10;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(chest.x, chest.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = C;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.fillStyle = C;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc((hip.x + chest.x) / 2, (hip.y + chest.y) / 2, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // sword arm + plasma blade
  const shoulder = { x: chest.x, y: chest.y + 4 };
  let hand, bladeAng;
  if (st === "strike") {
    const p = Math.min(1, sT / 0.3);
    hand = { x: chest.x + d * (30 + p * 30), y: chest.y - 6 + p * 10 };
    bladeAng = d === 1 ? -1.9 + p * 2.5 : Math.PI + 1.9 - p * 2.5;
  } else if (st === "victory") {
    hand = { x: chest.x + d * 10, y: chest.y - 34 };
    bladeAng = -Math.PI / 2 + d * 0.18;
  } else if (st === "stagger") {
    hand = { x: chest.x - d * 6, y: chest.y + 26 };
    bladeAng = d === 1 ? 0.7 : Math.PI - 0.7;
  } else {
    const sway = Math.sin(t * 2.2 + f.seed) * 3;
    hand = { x: chest.x + d * 24, y: chest.y + 2 + sway };
    bladeAng = d === 1 ? -1.15 : Math.PI + 1.15;
  }
  limb(ctx, shoulder, { x: (shoulder.x + hand.x) / 2 + d * 4, y: (shoulder.y + hand.y) / 2 + 8 }, hand, 6, "#2c2347");

  const BL = st === "victory" ? 72 : 64;
  const tip = { x: hand.x + Math.cos(bladeAng) * BL, y: hand.y + Math.sin(bladeAng) * BL };
  if (st === "strike") {
    trail.push({ x: tip.x, y: tip.y, life: 0.32, max: 0.32 });
    if (trail.length > 26) trail.shift();
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = C;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 7;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hand.x, hand.y);
  ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.92;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hand.x, hand.y);
  ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  const gx = Math.cos(bladeAng + Math.PI / 2);
  const gy = Math.sin(bladeAng + Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#8f83b3";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hand.x - gx * 8, hand.y - gy * 8);
  ctx.lineTo(hand.x + gx * 8, hand.y + gy * 8);
  ctx.stroke();

  const off = { x: chest.x - d * 16, y: chest.y + 24 };
  limb(ctx, shoulder, { x: chest.x - d * 12, y: chest.y + 12 }, off, 5, "#221b3a");

  // scarf
  const flutter = moving || st === "strike" ? 1.7 : 1;
  let sx = neck.x - d * 4;
  let sy = neck.y + 2;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = C;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
  for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
    sx -= d * 13;
    sy += Math.sin(t * 9 * flutter + f.seed + i * 1.3) * 4.5 * i * 0.5 + 2.4;
    ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  // head ring + visor
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1c1533";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(head.x, head.y, 12.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = C;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(head.x + d * 1, head.y - 1);
  ctx.lineTo(head.x + d * 12, head.y - 1);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFallen(ctx, f, d, C) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  const hip = { x: f.x, y: GY - 8 };
  const chest = { x: f.x - d * 40, y: GY - 14 };
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#2c2347";
  ctx.lineWidth = 10;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(chest.x, chest.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1c1533";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(chest.x - d * 16, chest.y - 4, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#241d3d";
  ctx.lineWidth = 6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(hip.x + d * 26, GY - 2);
  ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
  ctx.lineTo(hip.x + d * 12, GY - 22);
  ctx.moveTo(chest.x, chest.y);
  ctx.lineTo(chest.x - d * 6, GY - 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  const sx = f.x + d * 34;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = C;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(sx, GY - 2);
  ctx.lineTo(sx + 52, GY - 22);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function knee(a, b, d, bend) {
  return { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2 + d * bend, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 + 2 };
}

function limb(ctx, a, mid, b, w, color) {
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = w;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
  ctx.lineTo(mid.x, mid.y);
  ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawTrail(ctx, trail, color) {
  for (let i = trail.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = trail[i];
    p.life -= 1 / 60;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      trail.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
  }
  if (trail.length < 2) return;
  for (let i = 1; i < trail.length; i++) {
    const a = trail[i - 1];
    const b = trail[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha = (b.life / b.max) * 0.6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 9 * (i / trail.length) + 2;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
    ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Menu, X, Gamepad2 } from "lucide-react";
import Logo from "./Logo";
import { Button } from "./ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const LINKS = [
  ["/select", "Select"],
  ["/live", "Fight"],
  ["/leaderboard", "Ranks"],
  ["/fighters", "Roster"],
  ["/tournaments", "Cup"],
  ["/kit", "Kit"],
];

export default function SiteNav() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b-2 border-line bg-void/90 backdrop-blur-md">
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-6xl items-center gap-3 px-4 sm:px-6">
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2.5" aria-label="Stickblade Arena home">
          <Logo size={30} />
          <span className="font-display text-[13px] tracking-wide">
            STICKBLADE <span className="neon-p1">ARENA</span>
          </span>
        </Link>

        <nav className="ml-4 hidden items-center gap-0.5 lg:flex" aria-label="Primary">
          {LINKS.map(([href, label]) => {
            const active = pathname === href;
            return (
              <Link
                key={href}
                href={href}
                aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                className={cn(
                  "-skew-x-6 border px-3 py-2 font-head text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] transition-all",
                  active
                    ? "border-gold bg-gold text-black"
                    : "border-transparent text-dim hover:border-line-bright hover:text-bone"
                )}
              >
                <span className="block skew-x-6">{label}</span>
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        <div className="ml-auto hidden items-center gap-3 lg:flex">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-dim">
            <span className="live-dot inline-block size-2 rounded-full bg-blood text-blood" />
            1,204 in the arcade
          </span>
          <Link href="/select">
            <Button size="sm">
              <Gamepad2 size={14} />
              Press start
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="ml-auto cursor-pointer rounded-xs border border-line p-2 text-fog lg:hidden"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-label={open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"}
          onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        >
          {open ? <X size={20} /> : <Menu size={20} />}
        </button>
      </div>

      {open && (
        <nav className="border-t border-line bg-abyss px-4 py-3 lg:hidden" aria-label="Mobile">
          {LINKS.map(([href, label]) => (
            <Link
              key={href}
              href={href}
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              className={cn(
                "block rounded-xs px-3 py-2.5 font-head text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em]",
                pathname === href ? "bg-gold text-black" : "text-fog"
              )}
            >
              {label}
            </Link>
          ))}
          <Link href="/select" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="mt-2 block">
            <Button className="w-full">
              <Gamepad2 size={14} />
              Press start
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </nav>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

export default function TournamentsPage() {
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 sm:px-6">
      <header className="pt-10 pb-6 text-center">
        <p className="tag text-gold">{TOURNAMENT.status} · single elimination</p>

          Eight blades enter. One name gets engraved. Semifinals fight tonight —
          the final goes down Sunday.

      </header>

      <Callout tone="gold" title={`Prize pool: ${TOURNAMENT.prize}`} className="mx-auto max-w-3xl">
        Plus the golden nameplate on the cabinet, a +50 Elo coronation bonus,

      </Callout>

      {/* bracket */}
      <section className="mt-8 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3" aria-label="Tournament bracket">
        {TOURNAMENT.rounds.map((round) => (
          <div key={round.name} className="rounded-md border-2 border-line bg-panel/60 p-4">
            <p className="tag border-b border-line pb-3 text-center text-[11px] text-fog">
              {round.name}
            </p>
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-3">
              {round.matches.map((m, i) => (
                <MatchupCard key={i} match={m} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </section>

      {/* champions */}
      <section className="mt-10">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xl tracking-wide text-bone">
          <Crown size={20} className="text-gold" />
          Past champions
        </h2>
        <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {TOURNAMENT.champions.map((c) => {
            const w = fighterByName(c.winner);
            return (
              <div key={c.cup} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-sm border-2 border-line bg-panel/60 p-4">
                <Trophy size={22} className="shrink-0 text-gold" />
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="font-head text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest text-mute uppercase">{c.cup}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-bone">{c.winner}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-dim">def. {c.runnerUp}</p>
                </div>
                {w && <Avatar name={w.name} hue={w.hue} size={36} className="ml-auto" />}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="mt-10 text-center">
        <Link href="/live">
          <Button size="lg" variant="gold">
            <Swords size={16} />
            Watch the semifinal
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MatchupCard({ match }) {
  const { a, b, winner, score } = match;
  const live = score === "live";
  const decided = winner === "a" || winner === "b";
  const fa = fighterByName(a);
  const fb = fighterByName(b);

  const row = (name, f, side) => {
    const won = decided && winner === side;
    const lost = decided && winner !== side;
    return (
      <div
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xs border px-2.5 py-2",
          won ? "border-gold/70 bg-gold/[0.08]" : "border-line bg-abyss",
          lost && "opacity-45"
        )}
      >
        {f && <Avatar name={f.name} hue={f.hue} size={28} neon={won ? "#ffd400" : null} />}
        <span className={cn("min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[13px] font-bold", won ? "text-gold" : "text-bone")}>
          {won && "★ "}{name}
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1.5 rounded-sm border-2 p-2", live ? "border-p1/70 bg-p1/[0.05]" : "border-transparent")}>
      {row(a, fa, "a")}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
        {live ? (
          <Badge variant="p1">
            <span className="live-dot inline-block size-1.5 rounded-full bg-current" />
            Live now
          </Badge>
        ) : (
          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-dim tabular">{score}</span>
        )}
      </div>
      {row(b, fb, "b")}
      {live && (
        <Link href={`/live?a=${encodeURIComponent(a)}&b=${encodeURIComponent(b)}`}>
          <Button size="sm" className="mt-1 w-full">
            <Swords size={14} />
            Watch it
          </Button>
        </Link>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Swords, Flame } from "lucide-react";
import { FIGHTERS } from "@/lib/data";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Dialog, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Avatar, Progress } from "@/components/ui/extras";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export default function FightersPage() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(null);
  const ranked = [...FIGHTERS].sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo);
  const maxElo = ranked[0].elo;
  const f = open ? FIGHTERS.find((x) => x.name === open) : null;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 sm:px-6">
      <header className="pt-10 pb-6 text-center">
        <p className="tag text-p2">Full roster · {FIGHTERS.length} blades</p>
        <h1 className="mt-2 font-display text-4xl tracking-wide text-bone sm:text-5xl">
          MEET THE <span className="neon-p2">ROSTER</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-lg text-sm leading-relaxed text-dim">
          Tap any portrait for the full dossier — record, form, style tags, and
          a one-click challenge.
        </p>
      </header>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {ranked.map((x, i) => (
          <button
            key={x.name}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setOpen(x.name)}
            className="group cursor-pointer rounded-sm border-2 border-line bg-panel/70 p-4 text-left transition-all duration-150 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-p1/70 hover:shadow-[0_0_24px_-6px_rgba(255,47,179,0.6)]"
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
              <Avatar name={x.name} hue={x.hue} size={52} />
              <span className="font-display text-lg text-mute">#{i + 1}</span>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-3 truncate font-head text-sm font-bold text-bone">{x.name}</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-dim">{x.provider}</p>
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Progress value={x.elo} max={maxElo} tone={i === 0 ? "gold" : i < 3 ? "p1" : "p2"} className="h-2 flex-1" />
              <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-fog tabular">{x.elo}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
              {x.styles.slice(0, 2).map((s) => (
                <Badge key={s} variant="dim">{s}</Badge>
              ))}
              {x.streak >= 3 && (
                <Badge variant="gold">
                  <Flame size={11} /> {x.streak}
                </Badge>
              )}
            </div>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <Dialog open={!!f} onClose={() => setOpen(null)} wide>
        {f && (
          <>
            <DialogHeader>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <Avatar name={f.name} hue={f.hue} size={64} neon="#ffd400" />
                <div>
                  <DialogTitle className="text-2xl">{f.name}</DialogTitle>
                  <DialogDescription>
                    {f.provider} · Elo {f.elo}
                  </DialogDescription>
                </div>
              </div>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-6">
              <p className="border-l-4 border-p1 pl-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-fog italic">
                “{f.blurb}”
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {f.styles.map((s) => (
                  <Badge key={s} variant="p2">{s}</Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
              <dl className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-sm border border-line bg-line text-center">
                {[
                  [String(f.wins), "Wins"],
                  [String(f.losses), "Losses"],
                  [String(f.draws), "Draws"],
                  [`${f.streak}🔥`, "Streak"],
                ].map(([v, k]) => (
                  <div key={k} className="bg-abyss px-1 py-3">
                    <dd className="font-display text-lg text-bone">{v}</dd>
                    <dt className="tag mt-0.5 text-[9px] text-mute">{k}</dt>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </dl>
              <div>
                <p className="tag mb-2 text-[10px] text-mute">Recent form</p>
                <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                  {f.form.map((r, j) => (
                    <span
                      key={j}

Stickblade Arena — Fight Night Edition (V3)
MD
Stickblade Arena — Fight Night Edition (V3)
The app is an arcade fighting game now. Bungee display type, magenta/cyan
neon on near-black violet, scanlines, chunky cabinet buttons, and a ringside
announcer who commentates every bout out loud.

Play it
Bash

cd stickblade-arena-new
npm install
npx next build
npx next start -p 4177 -H 0.0.0.0
(If the sandbox wiped node_modules/.next, the install + build are required
before every start — that's an environment fact, not a bug.)

The fight flow
/ — Attract mode: press-start hero, live demo-fight cabinet, how-it-plays.
/select — Character select: 14-fighter portrait grid, 1P/2P draft slots,
stage picker, sticky matchup bar, random buttons.
/live — Versus splash (skippable) → unpause → engine intro
(READY?) → sim-emitted FIGHT! (banner + air horn + spoken call) →
60-second clock, combos, K.O./TIME!/DRAW! calls → judges' scorecards →
lock-in reveal with damage/combo/turn stats, rematch + new-fighter paths.
/leaderboard — Champion spotlight, Elo ladder with HP-style bars,
W/L/D, trends, form dots, recent bouts.
/fighters — Roster grid + full dossier dialogs with one-click challenges.
/tournaments — Ember Cup bracket, live semifinal card, past champions.
/kit — Cabinet parts shelf: palette, type, buttons, badges, HP bars,
tabs, dialog, inputs, callouts, avatars, fight-announcement specimens.
Architecture
Next.js 15 + Tailwind v4, bespoke arcade UI kit (components/ui/),
lucide-react icons, @fontsource Bungee + Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono.
lib/sim.js — procedural fight engine: 60s clock, turn scheduler,
combos with decay windows, K.O./decision/draw paths, confetti KOs,
annular shockwaves, line/announce/combo/clock/ko/end event stream.
The sim owns all fight SFX timing; the page mirrors banners + voice.
lib/announcer.js — speech-synthesis hype man (deepest EN voice
available, mic toggle).
lib/sound.js — 16 synthesized SFX, zero assets (whoosh/hit/clash/
crit/ko/bell/combo/cheer/select/confirm/fight/beep/victory/click/
reveal + versus sting + fight horn).
lib/data.js — centralized static data (uppercase exports:
FIGHTERS, RECENT_MATCHES, ARENAS, TOURNAMENT, …). The single
swap point for a future live API.
Blind judging preserved: HUD plates show 1P/2P with sealed
identities; real names unmask only after the scorecard locks.
Blind A/B
Identities stay masked through versus splash, fight, and commentary
(the engine narrates in 1P/2P). The reveal fires exclusively on vote
lock-in — with a spoken winner call and crowd cheer.

audio.js
JS
/* Synthesized WebAudio SFX — zero assets. Clash / hit / KO. */

let ctx = null;
let enabled = false;
let noiseCache = null;

export function setAudioEnabled(v) {
  enabled = v;
}

export function isAudioEnabled() {
  return enabled;
}

function ac() {
  if (!ctx) {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return null;
    ctx = new AC();
  }
  if (ctx.state === "suspended") ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
  return ctx;
}

function noiseBuffer(c) {
  if (noiseCache) return noiseCache;
  const len = c.sampleRate;
  const buf = c.createBuffer(1, len, c.sampleRate);
  const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
  noiseCache = buf;
  return buf;
}

function tone(c, t, { freq = 440, slideTo = null, dur = 0.15, gain = 0.12, type = "sine" }) {
  const o = c.createOscillator();
  o.type = type;
  o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t + dur);
  const g = c.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(gain, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + dur);
  o.connect(g).connect(c.destination);
  o.start(t);
  o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
}

function burst(c, t, { freq = 1200, dur = 0.15, gain = 0.14, type = "bandpass", sweepTo = null }) {
  const src = c.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = noiseBuffer(c);
  const f = c.createBiquadFilter();
  f.type = type;
  f.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  if (sweepTo) f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(sweepTo, t + dur);
  const g = c.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(gain, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + dur);
  src.connect(f).connect(g).connect(c.destination);
  src.start(t);
  src.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
}

export function play(name) {
  if (!enabled || typeof window === "undefined") return;
  try {
    const c = ac();
    if (!c) return;
    const t = c.currentTime;
    if (name === "clash") {
      tone(c, t, { freq: 1244, dur: 0.12, gain: 0.08, type: "square" });
      tone(c, t, { freq: 1866, dur: 0.1, gain: 0.06, type: "square" });
      burst(c, t, { freq: 5200, dur: 0.12, gain: 0.12, type: "highpass" });
    } else if (name === "hit") {
      tone(c, t, { freq: 170, slideTo: 48, dur: 0.18, gain: 0.28 });
      burst(c, t, { freq: 300, dur: 0.1, gain: 0.14, type: "lowpass" });
    } else if (name === "whoosh") {
      burst(c, t, { freq: 500, sweepTo: 2600, dur: 0.14, gain: 0.07 });
    } else if (name === "ko") {
      tone(c, t, { freq: 95, slideTo: 28, dur: 0.7, gain: 0.4 });
      burst(c, t, { freq: 220, dur: 0.5, gain: 0.24, type: "lowpass" });
      tone(c, t + 0.05, { freq: 622, dur: 0.4, gain: 0.06, type: "triangle" });
    }
  } catch {
    /* silent */
  }
}

STICKBLADE ARENA — 2026 Showcase Site (React Edition)
MD
STICKBLADE ARENA — 2026 Showcase Site (React Edition)
A cinematic, motion-rich showcase website for Stickblade Arena — the physics-grounded LLM benchmark where two language models sword-fight in real 2D physics.

Built with React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 + Framer Motion + Lenis smooth scrolling. Fonts are self-hosted via Fontsource (no external requests).

This is a separate marketing/showcase site. The functional arena lives at
stickblade-arena.vercel.app and the
engine repo at github.com/Cometbuster4969/STICKBLADE-ARENA.

Highlights
Live animated duel hero — canvas engine with DPR-aware rendering, screen shake,
hit-stop, hit flash, slow-mo KO killcam, ambient dust, and synthesized WebAudio
clash sounds (toggleable)
Interactive sharp-zone lab — pick a weapon, toggle lethal zones, watch the
doctrine flip from Fencer → Brawler → Chaos
Animated JSON terminal — line-by-line reveal of exactly what the LLM sees each turn
Mock blind-vote demo with reveal, Elo deltas, and commentator roast
Animated Elo leaderboard, tournament bracket, roadmap, FAQ accordion, API reference
Develop
Bash

npm install
npm run dev        # vite dev server
npm run build      # production build -> dist/
npm run preview    # serve dist/ on :4173
npm run lint       # oxlint
Structure
text

src/
  main.jsx            entry: fonts, styles, root
  App.jsx             Lenis smooth scroll + section composition
  index.css           Tailwind v4 theme (ember palette) + utilities
  data.js             all showcase content (fighters, bracket, faq, api…)
  audio.js            synthesized WebAudio SFX (zero assets)
  components/
    DuelCanvas.jsx    auto-duel canvas engine (shake, hit-stop, KO cam)
    Nav.jsx           fixed nav + mobile menu
    Hero.jsx          headline + live duel frame
    Lab.jsx           sharp-zone laboratory
    Terminal.jsx      LLM observation terminal
    VoteDemo.jsx      blind-vote demo
    Leaderboard.jsx   animated Elo bars
    Bracket.jsx       tournament bracket
    Roadmap.jsx       timeline
    Faq.jsx           accordion
    ApiRef.jsx        API reference
    Footer.jsx        CTA + link columns
    ui.jsx            Reveal, SectionHead, shared bits
Notes
Everything on this page is simulated locally — no backend calls.
Deploy anywhere static: npm run build, serve dist/. vercel.json included.
