JS
import { useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { ArrowUpRight, Volume2, VolumeX, ChevronDown, Github } from "lucide-react";
import DuelCanvas from "./DuelCanvas";
import { STATS } from "../data";
import { setAudioEnabled } from "../audio";

export default function Hero() {
  const [sound, setSound] = useState(false);

  const toggleSound = () => {
    const next = !sound;
    setSound(next);
    setAudioEnabled(next);
  };

  return (
    <section id="top" className="relative overflow-hidden pt-28 pb-16 sm:pt-36">
      <div className="grid-bg pointer-events-none absolute inset-0" />
      <div className="ember-glow pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-1/2 h-[30rem] w-[52rem] -translate-x-1/2" />

      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 sm:px-6">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
          className="mx-auto max-w-3xl text-center"
        >
          <p className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-line bg-panel/80 px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-dim">
            <span className="inline-block size-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-ember" />
            Physics-grounded LLM benchmark · Season 04 live
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-6 font-display text-5xl leading-[1.02] font-bold tracking-tight text-bone sm:text-7xl">
            Two AIs enter.
            <br />
            <span className="text-glow text-ember">One Elo leaves.</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-5 max-w-xl text-base leading-relaxed text-dim sm:text-lg">
            Language models sword-fight in real 2D physics. You judge the
            exchanges blind. Elo tracks who fought smarter — not who has the
            bigger logo.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 sm:flex-row">
            <a
              href="https://stickblade-arena.vercel.app/"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              className="inline-flex w-64 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-ember px-6 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-ember transition-transform hover:scale-[1.03] active:scale-[0.98] sm:w-auto"
            >
              Enter the arena
              <ArrowUpRight size={16} />
            </a>
            <a
              href="https://github.com/Cometbuster4969/STICKBLADE-ARENA"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              className="inline-flex w-64 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-linebright bg-panel px-6 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-bone transition-colors hover:border-ember sm:w-auto"
            >
              <Github size={16} />
              Star the engine
            </a>
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {/* live duel frame */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.8, delay: 0.25, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
          className="mt-12 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-linebright bg-black shadow-card"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-line bg-panel px-4 py-2.5">
            <span className="inline-block size-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-blood" />
            <span className="eyebrow text-[10px] text-dim">Live simulation · exhibition bout</span>
            <span className="ml-auto hidden font-mono text-[11px] text-mute sm:block">
              Obsidian Prime vs Kestrel-7
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={toggleSound}
              aria-pressed={sound}
              className="ml-2 inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-line px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-dim transition-colors hover:border-ember hover:text-bone"
            >
              {sound ? <Volume2 size={14} /> : <VolumeX size={14} />}
              {sound ? "Mute" : "Sound"}
            </button>
          </div>
          <DuelCanvas />
        </motion.div>

        {/* stats */}
        <dl className="mx-auto mt-8 grid max-w-3xl grid-cols-2 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-line bg-line sm:grid-cols-4">
          {STATS.map(([v, k]) => (
            <div key={k} className="bg-coal px-4 py-5 text-center">
              <dd className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-gold sm:text-3xl">{v}</dd>
              <dt className="eyebrow mt-1.5 text-[9px] text-mute">{k}</dt>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>

        <div className="mt-10 flex justify-center">
          <a href="#lab" aria-label="Scroll to sharp-zone lab" className="animate-bounce text-mute hover:text-ember">
            <ChevronDown size={26} />
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
Open
DuelCanvas.jsx
JS
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { play } from "../audio";

const W = 960;
const H = 520;
const GY = 430;

/**
 * Auto-duel canvas engine: DPR-aware, screen shake, hit-stop, hit flash,
 * slow-mo KO killcam, ambient dust. Fights loop forever with fresh seeds.
 */
export default function DuelCanvas({ className = "" }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const reduced =
      typeof window !== "undefined" &&
      window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

    const resize = () => {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * dpr));
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round((rect.width * H) / W) * dpr);
    };
    resize();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
    ro.observe(canvas);

    // ---- fight state ----
    const mk = (x, color, dir) => ({
      x, vx: 0, hp: 100, color, dir,
      state: "idle", t: 0, cd: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8, seed: Math.random() * 10,
    });
    let A = mk(300, "#ff5a1f", 1);
    let B = mk(660, "#7dd7ff", -1);
    let particles = [];
    let dust = Array.from({ length: 46 }, () => ({
      x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H,
      r: 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.8, s: 6 + Math.random() * 14, ph: Math.random() * 7,
    }));
    let trauma = 0;
    let flash = 0;
    let hitstop = 0;
    let timescale = 1;
    let koTimer = 0;
    let fade = 0;
    let phase = "fight"; // fight | ko | rest
    let time = 0;
    let raf = 0;
    let last = performance.now();

    const reset = () => {
      A = mk(280 + Math.random() * 60, "#ff5a1f", 1);
      B = mk(620 + Math.random() * 60, "#7dd7ff", -1);
      particles = [];
      trauma = 0; flash = 0; hitstop = 0;
      timescale = 1; koTimer = 0; fade = 0;
      phase = "fight";
    };

    const sparks = (x, y, color, n = 14, power = 320) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const sp = power * (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.9);
        particles.push({
          x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 120,
          life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4, max: 0.9, color,
          size: 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5,
        });
      }
    };

    const strike = (me, foe) => {
      me.state = "strike"; me.t = 0;
      me.vx = me.dir * 260;
      play("whoosh");
      const clash = Math.random() < 0.35;
      const dmg = clash ? 0 : 7 + Math.random() * 10;
      setTimeout(() => {}, 0);
      // resolve at contact
      const mx = me.x + me.dir * 70;
      if (Math.abs(mx - foe.x) < 120 || Math.abs(me.x - foe.x) < 150) {
        const ix = (me.x + foe.x) / 2;
        const iy = GY - 110;
        if (clash) {
          sparks(ix, iy, "#ffd97a", 18, 380);
          trauma = Math.min(1, trauma + 0.35);
          hitstop = 0.09;
          play("clash");
          foe.state = "recover"; foe.t = 0; foe.vx = -me.dir * 120;
          me.vx = -me.dir * 90;
        } else {
          sparks(ix, iy, me.color, 14, 340);
          trauma = Math.min(1, trauma + 0.5);
          flash = 0.5;
          hitstop = 0.12;
          play("hit");
          foe.hp -= dmg;
          foe.state = "hit"; foe.t = 0;
          foe.vx = me.dir * (200 + dmg * 8);
          me.vx = 0;
          if (foe.hp <= 0) {
            foe.hp = 0;
            foe.state = "down";
            startKO(foe, me);
          }
        }
      }
      me.cd = 0.9 + Math.random() * 1.3;
    };

    const startKO = (loser, winner) => {
      phase = "ko";
      koTimer = 1.6;
      timescale = 0.25;
      trauma = 1;
      flash = 0.9;
      sparks(loser.x, GY - 120, "#ffffff", 40, 520);
      sparks(loser.x, GY - 120, winner.color, 30, 420);
      play("ko");
      winner.state = "victory";
      winner.vx = 0;
    };

    const step = (me, foe, dt) => {
      me.t += dt;
      me.cd -= dt;
      const dist = Math.abs(foe.x - me.x);
      me.dir = foe.x >= me.x ? 1 : -1;
      if (me.state === "down" || me.state === "victory") {
        me.vx *= 1 - Math.min(1, dt * 6);
        me.x += me.vx * dt;
        return;
      }
      if (me.state === "strike" || me.state === "hit" || me.state === "recover") {
        if (me.t > 0.45) { me.state = "idle"; me.t = 0; }
        me.vx *= 1 - Math.min(1, dt * 5);
        me.x += me.vx * dt;
      } else if (me.cd <= 0) {
        if (dist < 170) strike(me, foe);
        else { me.state = "advance"; }
      } else if (me.state === "advance") {
        me.vx = me.dir * 150;
        me.x += me.vx * dt;
        if (dist < 150) { me.state = "idle"; }
      } else {
        // spacing footwork
        me.vx = me.dir * Math.sin(time * 1.3 + me.seed) * 40;
        me.x += me.vx * dt;
      }
      me.x = Math.max(90, Math.min(W - 90, me.x));
    };

    const frame = (now) => {
      let raw = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
      last = now;
      if (hitstop > 0) { hitstop -= raw; raw *= 0.04; }
      const dt = raw * timescale;
      time += dt;

      if (phase === "fight") {
        step(A, B, dt);
        step(B, A, dt);
      } else if (phase === "ko") {
        koTimer -= raw;
        A.x += A.vx * dt; B.x += B.vx * dt;
        A.vx *= 1 - Math.min(1, dt * 4); B.vx *= 1 - Math.min(1, dt * 4);
        if (koTimer <= 0) { phase = "rest"; timescale = 1; }
      } else {
        fade += raw;
        if (fade > 1.1) { reset(); }
      }

      for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const p = particles[i];
        p.life -= dt;
        if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        p.vy += 900 * dt;
        p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
        if (p.y > GY + 6) { p.y = GY + 6; p.vy *= -0.4; }
      }
      for (const d of dust) {
        d.y -= d.s * raw;
        d.x += Math.sin(time * 0.7 + d.ph) * 6 * raw;
        if (d.y < -4) { d.y = H + 4; d.x = Math.random() * W; }
      }
      trauma = Math.max(0, trauma - raw * 1.6);
      flash = Math.max(0, flash - raw * 2.2);

      draw();
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };

    const draw = () => {
      const s = canvas.width / W;
      ctx.setTransform(s, 0, 0, s, 0, 0);
      if (trauma > 0 && !reduced) {
        const m = trauma * trauma * 12;
        ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * m);
      }
      // backdrop
      const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      sky.addColorStop(0, "#070404");
      sky.addColorStop(0.6, "#120b08");
      sky.addColorStop(1, "#0b0605");
      ctx.fillStyle = sky;
      ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
      // glow orbs
      glow(A.x, 300, "255,90,31", 0.16);
      glow(B.x, 300, "125,215,255", 0.12);
      // dust
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffc24d";
      for (const d of dust) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12 + 0.1 * Math.sin(time + d.ph);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      // floor
      ctx.fillStyle = "#151010";
      ctx.fillRect(-20, GY, W + 40, H - GY + 20);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,90,31,0.35)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-20, GY + 1);
      ctx.lineTo(W + 20, GY + 1);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,194,77,0.5)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(W / 2, GY + 18, 300, 26, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();

      drawFighter(A);
      drawFighter(B);

      for (const p of particles) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

      // hp pips
      hpBar(30, A, false);
      hpBar(W - 230, B, true);

      if (phase === "ko" && !reduced) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(W / 2, 200);
        ctx.rotate(-0.04);
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.font = "700 92px 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif";
        ctx.lineWidth = 10;
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.85)";
        ctx.strokeText("K.O.", 0, 0);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#ffc24d";
        ctx.fillText("K.O.", 0, 0);
        ctx.restore();
      }
      if (flash > 0 && !reduced) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,240,220,${(flash * 0.35).toFixed(3)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
      }
      if (phase === "rest") {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(7,4,4,${Math.min(1, fade).toFixed(3)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
      }
      // vignette
      const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.35, W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.95);
      vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)");
      ctx.fillStyle = vg;
      ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
    };

    const glow = (x, y, rgb, a) => {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 10, x, y, 190);
      g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${rgb},${a})`);
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 200, y - 200, 400, 400);
    };

    const hpBar = (x, f, right) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
      ctx.fillRect(x, 22, 200, 9);
      const w = 200 * Math.max(0, f.hp / 100);
      ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
      ctx.fillRect(right ? x + 200 - w : x, 22, w, 9);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.22)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.strokeRect(x + 0.5, 22.5, 199, 8);
    };

    const limb = (a, mid, b, w, color) => {
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.lineWidth = w;
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.lineJoin = "round";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
      ctx.lineTo(mid.x, mid.y);
      ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
      ctx.stroke();
    };

    const drawFighter = (f) => {
      const d = f.dir;
      const C = f.color;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(f.x, GY + 8, 40, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      if (f.state === "down") {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
        limb({ x: f.x, y: GY - 8 }, { x: f.x - d * 20, y: GY - 14 }, { x: f.x - d * 42, y: GY - 12 }, 9, "#3a312b");
        ctx.fillStyle = "#241e1a";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(f.x - d * 56, GY - 14, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = C;
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(f.x + d * 20, GY - 2);
        ctx.lineTo(f.x + d * 66, GY - 18);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        return;
      }
      const bob = f.state === "victory" ? Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 7)) * -9 : Math.sin(time * 3 + f.seed) * 2;
      const lean = f.state === "strike" ? 13 : f.state === "hit" ? -13 : 2;
      const hip = { x: f.x, y: GY - 50 + bob * 0.4 };
      const chest = { x: f.x + d * lean, y: hip.y - 44 };
      const head = { x: chest.x + d * 5, y: chest.y - 22 };
      const run = f.state === "advance" ? Math.sin(time * 12 + f.seed) * 11 : 0;
      limb(hip, { x: hip.x + d * 8, y: (hip.y + GY) / 2 }, { x: f.x + d * (20 + run), y: GY }, 6.5, "#463b33");
      limb(hip, { x: hip.x - d * 6, y: (hip.y + GY) / 2 }, { x: f.x - d * (18 - run), y: GY }, 6.5, "#332b25");
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#52463c";
      ctx.lineWidth = 9;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hip.x, hip.y);
      ctx.lineTo(chest.x, chest.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      let hand, ang;
      if (f.state === "strike") {
        const p = Math.min(1, f.t / 0.3);
        hand = { x: chest.x + d * (26 + p * 28), y: chest.y - 4 + p * 8 };
        ang = d === 1 ? -1.9 + p * 2.5 : Math.PI + 1.9 - p * 2.5;
      } else if (f.state === "victory") {
        hand = { x: chest.x + d * 8, y: chest.y - 30 };
        ang = -Math.PI / 2 + d * 0.15;
      } else if (f.state === "hit") {
        hand = { x: chest.x - d * 4, y: chest.y + 24 };
        ang = d === 1 ? 0.7 : Math.PI - 0.7;
      } else {
        hand = { x: chest.x + d * 22, y: chest.y + 2 + Math.sin(time * 2 + f.seed) * 2.5 };
        ang = d === 1 ? -1.15 : Math.PI + 1.15;
      }
      limb({ x: chest.x, y: chest.y + 4 }, { x: chest.x + d * 6, y: chest.y + 10 }, hand, 5.5, "#463b33");
      const tip = { x: hand.x + Math.cos(ang) * 58, y: hand.y + Math.sin(ang) * 58 };
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = C;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
      ctx.strokeStyle = C;
      ctx.lineWidth = 5.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hand.x, hand.y);
      ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hand.x, hand.y);
      ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      // scarf
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = C;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.strokeStyle = C;
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(chest.x - d * 2, chest.y - 2);
      let sx = chest.x - d * 2, sy = chest.y - 2;
      for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        sx -= d * 11;
        sy += Math.sin(time * 8 + f.seed + i * 1.4) * 3.4 + 2;
        ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      // head
      ctx.fillStyle = "#241e1a";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(head.x, head.y, 11.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = C;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = C;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.strokeStyle = C;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3.6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(head.x + d * 1, head.y - 1);
      ctx.lineTo(head.x + d * 10, head.y - 1);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    };

    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      ro.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      role="img"
      aria-label="Simulated sword duel between two stick fighters"
      className={className}
      style={{ width: "100%", aspectRatio: `${W} / ${H}`, display: "block" }}
    />
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Menu, X, ArrowUpRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Logo } from "./ui";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

const LINKS = [
  ["#lab", "Sharp lab"],
  ["#terminal", "Terminal"],
  ["#vote", "Blind vote"],
  ["#rankings", "Rankings"],
  ["#bracket", "Bracket"],
  ["#roadmap", "Roadmap"],
  ["#faq", "FAQ"],
  ["#api", "API"],
];

export default function Nav() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 24);
    onScroll();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
  }, []);

  return (
    <header
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-50 transition-all duration-300",
        scrolled ? "border-b border-line bg-void/85 backdrop-blur-md" : "bg-transparent"
      )}
    >
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-6xl items-center gap-3 px-4 sm:px-6">
        <a href="#top" className="flex items-center gap-2.5" aria-label="Stickblade Arena home">
          <Logo size={28} />
          <span className="font-display text-[13px] font-bold tracking-[0.14em] text-bone">
            STICKBLADE <span className="text-ember">ARENA</span>
          </span>
        </a>

        <nav className="ml-6 hidden items-center gap-1 xl:flex" aria-label="Primary">
          {LINKS.map(([href, label]) => (
            <a
              key={href}
              href={href}
              className="rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-[13px] font-medium text-dim transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-bone"
            >
              {label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </nav>

        <div className="ml-auto hidden items-center gap-2 xl:flex">
          <a
            href="https://github.com/Cometbuster4969/STICKBLADE-ARENA"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
            className="rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-dim transition-colors hover:text-bone"
          >
            GitHub
          </a>
          <a
            href="https://stickblade-arena.vercel.app/"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-ember px-4 py-2 text-[13px] font-bold text-white shadow-ember transition-transform hover:scale-[1.03] active:scale-[0.98]"
          >
            Enter the arena
            <ArrowUpRight size={15} />
          </a>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="ml-auto cursor-pointer rounded-md border border-line p-2 text-bone xl:hidden"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-label={open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"}
          onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        >
          {open ? <X size={20} /> : <Menu size={20} />}
        </button>
      </div>

      {open && (
        <nav className="border-t border-line bg-void/95 px-4 py-3 backdrop-blur-md xl:hidden" aria-label="Mobile">
          {LINKS.map(([href, label]) => (
            <a
              key={href}
              href={href}
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              className="block rounded-md px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-dim hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-bone"
            >
              {label}
            </a>
          ))}
          <a
            href="https://stickblade-arena.vercel.app/"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
            className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-ember px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white"
          >
            Enter the arena
            <ArrowUpRight size={15} />
          </a>
        </nav>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export function Reveal({ children, delay = 0, className, y = 28 }) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      className={className}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y }}
      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      viewport={{ once: true, margin: "-80px" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.7, delay, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export function SectionHead({ eyebrow, title, sub, align = "center" }) {
  return (
    <Reveal className={cn("mb-10 max-w-2xl", align === "center" ? "mx-auto text-center" : "text-left")}>
      <p className="eyebrow text-ember">{eyebrow}</p>
      <h2 className="mt-3 font-display text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-bone sm:text-4xl">
        {title}
      </h2>
      {sub && <p className="mt-3 text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-dim">{sub}</p>}
    </Reveal>
  );
}

export function Logo({ size = 30 }) {
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M22.5 22.5 9.5 9.5" stroke="#ff5a1f" strokeWidth="3.2" strokeLinecap="round" />
      <path d="M9.5 9.5l2.8-2.8L11 11.5z" fill="#ff5a1f" />
      <path d="M9.5 22.5l13-13" stroke="#f5efe6" strokeWidth="3.2" strokeLinecap="round" />

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { EyeOff, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { VOTE_REVEAL } from "../data";
import { Reveal, SectionHead } from "./ui";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export default function VoteDemo() {
  const [voted, setVoted] = useState(null); // 'a' | 'b' | 'draw'
  const [prob, setProb] = useState(50);
  const [roast] = useState(() => VOTE_REVEAL.roasts[Math.floor(Math.random() * VOTE_REVEAL.roasts.length)]);

  // fake live crowd probability drift until vote locks
  useEffect(() => {
    if (voted) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setProb((p) => Math.max(18, Math.min(82, p + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 9)));
    }, 900);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [voted]);

  const reset = () => {
    setVoted(null);
    setProb(50);
  };

  return (
    <section id="vote" className="relative scroll-mt-20 py-20 sm:py-28">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 sm:px-6">
        <SectionHead
          eyebrow="Blind by design"
          title="Vote the steel, not the sticker."
          sub="Try it: identities stay hidden until your vote locks. Then the masks come off, Elo moves, and the commentator says the quiet part loud."
        />

        <Reveal className="mx-auto max-w-3xl rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel/70 p-5 sm:p-8">
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {!voted ? (
              <motion.div
                key="ballot"
                initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                className="flex flex-col gap-5"
              >
                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  {(["a", "b"]).map((side) => (
                    <div
                      key={side}
                      className="rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-linebright bg-coal p-5 text-center"
                    >
                      <span
                        className={cn(
                          "mx-auto flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-xl font-display text-2xl font-bold",
                          side === "a" ? "bg-ember/15 text-ember" : "bg-[#7dd7ff]/15 text-[#7dd7ff]"
                        )}
                      >
                        {side.toUpperCase()}
                      </span>
                      <p className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-xs tracking-[0.3em] text-mute">
                        <EyeOff size={13} /> SEALED
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div className="mb-1.5 flex justify-between font-mono text-[11px] text-dim">
                    <span>CROWD: A {Math.round(prob)}%</span>
                    <span>B {Math.round(100 - prob)}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-coal">
                    <motion.div
                      className="bg-ember"
                      animate={{ width: `${prob}%` }}
                      transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 60, damping: 15 }}
                    />
                    <div className="flex-1 bg-[#7dd7ff]/70" />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  {[
                    ["a", "Fighter A"],
                    ["draw", "Draw"],
                    ["b", "Fighter B"],
                  ].map(([id, label]) => (
                    <button
                      key={id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setVoted(id)}
                      className={cn(
                        "cursor-pointer rounded-xl border-2 py-3 font-display text-sm font-bold tracking-wide uppercase transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5",
                        id === "a" && "border-ember/60 bg-ember/10 text-ember hover:bg-ember hover:text-white",
                        id === "b" && "border-[#7dd7ff]/50 bg-[#7dd7ff]/10 text-[#7dd7ff] hover:bg-[#7dd7ff] hover:text-black",
                        id === "draw" && "border-line bg-coal text-dim hover:border-dim hover:text-bone"
                      )}
                    >
                      {label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            ) : (
              <motion.div
                key="reveal"

                transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
                className="flex flex-col gap-4"

                {[
                  { ...VOTE_REVEAL.a, side: "A", won: true, color: "#46c98a" },
                  { ...VOTE_REVEAL.b, side: "B", won: false, color: "#e5484d" },

Terminal.jsx
JS
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Play, Pause, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { TERMINAL_LINES } from "../data";
import { Reveal, SectionHead } from "./ui";

const LINE_MS = 420;

export default function Terminal() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(true);
  const timer = useRef(null);

  const tick = useCallback(() => {
    setCount((c) => {
      if (c >= TERMINAL_LINES.length) {
        setPlaying(false);
        return c;
      }
      return c + 1;
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    timer.current = setInterval(tick, LINE_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(timer.current);
  }, [playing, tick]);

  useEffect(() => () => clearInterval(timer.current), []);

  const restart = () => {
    setCount(0);
    setPlaying(true);
  };

  return (
    <section id="terminal" className="relative scroll-mt-20 py-20 sm:py-28">
      <div className="ember-glow pointer-events-none absolute top-1/3 left-1/2 h-[26rem] w-[44rem] -translate-x-1/2" />
      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 sm:px-6">
        <SectionHead
          eyebrow="Full transparency"
          title="This is exactly what the model sees."
          sub="No pixels, no vibes — a JSON observation every turn. Same input for both fighters, every time. That's what makes it a benchmark."
        />

        <Reveal className="mx-auto max-w-2xl overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-linebright bg-black shadow-card">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-line bg-panel px-4 py-2.5">
            <span className="flex gap-1.5">
              <i className="block size-2.5 rounded-full bg-blood/80" />
              <i className="block size-2.5 rounded-full bg-gold/80" />
              <i className="block size-2.5 rounded-full bg-mint/80" />
            </span>
            <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-[11px] text-mute">observation.turn_34.json</span>
            <span className="ml-auto flex gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => (count >= TERMINAL_LINES.length ? restart() : setPlaying((p) => !p))}
                aria-label={playing ? "Pause reveal" : "Play reveal"}
                className="cursor-pointer rounded-md border border-line p-1.5 text-dim transition-colors hover:border-ember hover:text-bone"
              >
                {playing ? <Pause size={13} /> : <Play size={13} />}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={restart}
                aria-label="Restart reveal"
                className="cursor-pointer rounded-md border border-line p-1.5 text-dim transition-colors hover:border-ember hover:text-bone"
              >
                <RotateCcw size={13} />
              </button>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="min-h-[290px] p-5 font-mono text-[12.5px] leading-[1.9] sm:text-[13.5px]" aria-live="polite">
            {TERMINAL_LINES.slice(0, count).map((line, i) => (
              <p key={i} className="whitespace-pre-wrap">
                <span className="mr-3 text-mute tabular">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
                <Colored json={line} />
              </p>
            ))}
            {count < TERMINAL_LINES.length && (
              <p>
                <span className="mr-3 text-mute tabular">{String(count + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
                <span className="inline-block h-4 w-2 animate-blink bg-ember align-middle" />
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </Reveal>

        <Reveal delay={0.1} className="mx-auto mt-6 grid max-w-2xl gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {[
            ["Identical inputs", "Both models, same JSON"],
            ["Legal-move list", "No invalid actions, ever"],
            ["Full replay logs", "Every turn downloadable"],
          ].map(([t, s]) => (
            <div key={t} className="rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel/70 px-4 py-3 text-center">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-bone">{t}</p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-dim">{s}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </Reveal>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/** Minimal JSON syntax tinting: keys gold, strings mint, numbers ember. */
function Colored({ json }) {
  const parts = json.split(/("[^"]*")/g);
  return (
    <>
      {parts.map((p, i) => {
        if (/^"/.test(p)) {
          const isKey = /:$/.test(parts[i + 1] || "");
          return (
            <span key={i} className={isKey ? "text-gold" : "text-mint"}>
              {p}
            </span>
          );
        }
        return (
          <span key={i} className="text-dim">
            {p.split(/(\b\d+\.?\d*\b)/g).map((q, j) =>
              /^\d/.test(q) ? (
                <span key={j} className="text-ember">
                  {q}
                </span>
              ) : (
                q
              )
            )}
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

Lab.jsx

import { useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { WEAPONS, ZONES, DOCTRINES } from "../data";
import { Reveal, SectionHead } from "./ui";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

function doctrineFor(sharpCount) {
  if (sharpCount === 0) return DOCTRINES.pillow;
  if (sharpCount === 1) return DOCTRINES.fencer;
  if (sharpCount === 2) return DOCTRINES.brawler;
  return DOCTRINES.chaos;
}

export default function Lab() {
  const [weapon, setWeapon] = useState(WEAPONS[0]);
  const [sharp, setSharp] = useState(["tip", "edge"]);
  const doctrine = doctrineFor(sharp.length);

  const toggle = (id) =>
    setSharp((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((z) => z !== id) : [...prev, id]));

  return (
    <section id="lab" className="relative scroll-mt-20 py-20 sm:py-28">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 sm:px-6">
        <SectionHead
          eyebrow="Sharp-zone lab"
          title="You decide what's sharp. The meta obeys."
          sub="Every weapon declares its lethal zones. Flip a zone and the optimal strategy — and the winning model — changes with it."
        />

        <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_1fr]">
          {/* weapon picker */}
          <Reveal className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel/70 p-5 sm:p-6">
            <p className="eyebrow text-[10px] text-mute">01 · Pick a weapon</p>
            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
              {WEAPONS.map((w) => (
                <button
                  key={w.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setWeapon(w)}
                  aria-pressed={weapon.id === w.id}
                  className={cn(
                    "cursor-pointer rounded-xl border-2 p-3 text-left transition-all",
                    weapon.id === w.id
                      ? "border-ember bg-ember/10"
                      : "border-line bg-coal hover:border-linebright"
                  )}
                >
                  <p className={cn("font-display text-sm font-bold", weapon.id === w.id ? "text-ember" : "text-bone")}>
                    {w.name}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-dim">
                    reach {"●".repeat(w.reach)}{"○".repeat(5 - w.reach)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-dim">
                    heft {"●".repeat(w.weight)}{"○".repeat(5 - w.weight)}
                  </p>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-4 border-l-2 border-ember pl-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-dim italic">
              {weapon.desc}
            </p>
          </Reveal>

          {/* blade + doctrine */}
          <Reveal delay={0.1} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel/70 p-5 sm:p-6">
              <p className="eyebrow text-[10px] text-mute">02 · Toggle lethal zones</p>
              <Blade sharp={sharp} onToggle={toggle} />
              <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {ZONES.map((z) => {
                  const on = sharp.includes(z.id);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={z.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => toggle(z.id)}
                      aria-pressed={on}
                      className={cn(
                        "cursor-pointer rounded-lg border-2 px-2 py-2.5 text-center transition-all",
                        on ? "border-ember bg-ember/15 text-bone" : "border-line bg-coal text-mute hover:text-dim"
                      )}
                    >
                      <span className="block font-display text-xs font-bold tracking-wider uppercase">{z.name}</span>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] opacity-80">{z.note}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <motion.div
              key={doctrine.name + sharp.length}
              initial={{ opacity: 0.4, scale: 0.99 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.35 }}
              className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel/70 p-5 sm:p-6"
              style={{ borderLeftColor: doctrine.color, borderLeftWidth: 6 }}
            >
              <p className="eyebrow text-[10px] text-mute">Resulting doctrine</p>
              <p className="mt-2 font-display text-3xl font-bold" style={{ color: doctrine.color }}>
                {doctrine.name}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-dim">{doctrine.line}</p>
              <p className="mt-3 font-mono text-xs text-mute">
                {weapon.name} · sharp: [{sharp.length ? sharp.join(", ") : "none"}]
              </p>
            </motion.div>
          </Reveal>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Blade({ sharp, onToggle }) {
  const on = (id) => sharp.includes(id);
  const seg = (id, x, w, label) => (
    <g
      onClick={() => onToggle(id)}
      className="cursor-pointer"
      role="button"
      aria-pressed={on(id)}
      aria-label={`Toggle ${label} zone`}
      tabIndex={0}
      onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && onToggle(id)}
    >
      <rect
        x={x}
        y={28}
        width={w}
        height={22}
        rx={3}
        fill={on(id) ? "#ff5a1f" : "#2a2320"}
        stroke={on(id) ? "#ffc24d" : "#453830"}
        strokeWidth={on(id) ? 2 : 1}
        style={{ transition: "fill 0.25s" }}
      />
      <text x={x + w / 2} y={43} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10} fontWeight={700} fill={on(id) ? "#0b0605" : "#a89c90"}>
        {label}
      </text>
    </g>
  );
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 420 78" className="mt-4 w-full" role="img" aria-label="Blade with toggleable sharp zones">
      {/* guard + grip */}
      <rect x={36} y={16} width={10} height={46} rx={2} fill="#453830" />
      <rect x={8} y={30} width={28} height={18} rx={4} fill="#1a1512" stroke="#453830" />
      {seg("forte", 48, 110, "FORTE")}
      {seg("edge", 162, 140, "EDGE")}
      {/* tip */}
      <g onClick={() => onToggle("tip")} className="cursor-pointer" role="button" aria-pressed={on("tip")} aria-label="Toggle tip zone" tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && onToggle("tip")}>
        <polygon
          points="306,28 372,39 306,50"
          fill={on("tip") ? "#ff5a1f" : "#2a2320"}
          stroke={on("tip") ? "#ffc24d" : "#453830"}
          strokeWidth={on("tip") ? 2 : 1}
          style={{ transition: "fill 0.25s" }}
        />
        <text x={322} y={43} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10} fontWeight={700} fill={on("tip") ? "#0b0605" : "#a89c90"}>
          TIP
        </text>
      </g>
      <text x={386} y={43} fontSize={10} fill="#6e6259">click</text>
    </svg>
  );
}

          eyebrow="Tournament mode"
          title="Ember Cup IV: semifinals tonight."
          sub="Eight blades enter single elimination. One name gets engraved — plus a +50 Elo coronation bonus."
        />

        <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {BRACKET.map((round, ri) => (
            <Reveal key={round.name} delay={ri * 0.1} className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel/60 p-4">
              <p className="eyebrow border-b border-line pb-3 text-center text-[11px] text-dim">{round.name}</p>
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-3">
                {round.matches.map((m, i) => (
                  <Matchup key={i} match={m} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </Reveal>
          ))}
        </div>

        <Reveal className="mx-auto mt-6 flex max-w-xl items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-ember/40 bg-ember/5 px-6 py-4 text-center">
          <Trophy size={22} className="shrink-0 text-gold" />
          <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-dim">
            <b className="text-bone">Prize pool:</b> 10,000 judged duels of glory, the golden
            cabinet nameplate, and permanent attract-mode immortality.
          </p>
        </Reveal>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Matchup({ match }) {
  const { a, b, winner, score } = match;
  const live = score === "live";
  const decided = winner === "a" || winner === "b";

  const row = (name, side) => {
    const won = decided && winner === side;
    const lost = decided && winner !== side;
    return (
      <div
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2",
          won ? "border-gold/60 bg-gold/10" : "border-line bg-coal",
          lost && "opacity-45"
        )}
      >
        <span className={cn("min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[13px] font-bold", won ? "text-gold" : "text-bone")}>
          {won && "★ "}
          {name}
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1.5 rounded-xl border-2 p-2", live ? "border-ember/60 bg-ember/5" : "border-transparent")}>
      {row(a, "a")}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center">
        {live ? (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-ember px-2.5 py-0.5 font-display text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest text-white uppercase">
            <span className="inline-block size-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-white" />
            Live now
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-dim tabular">{score}</span>
        )}
      </div>
      {row(b, "b")}
    </div>
  );
}

                          <Trend size={12} />
                          {f.trend > 0 ? `+${f.trend}` : f.trend}
                        </span>
                        {f.elo}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-coal">
                      <motion.div
                        className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-emberdeep to-ember"
                        initial={{ width: 0 }}
                        whileInView={{ width: `${(f.elo / max) * 100}%` }}
                        viewport={{ once: true }}

App.jsx
JS
import { useEffect } from "react";
import Lenis from "lenis";
import Nav from "./components/Nav.jsx";
import Hero from "./components/Hero.jsx";
import Lab from "./components/Lab.jsx";
import Terminal from "./components/Terminal.jsx";
import VoteDemo from "./components/VoteDemo.jsx";
import Leaderboard from "./components/Leaderboard.jsx";
import Bracket from "./components/Bracket.jsx";
import Roadmap from "./components/Roadmap.jsx";
import Faq from "./components/Faq.jsx";
import ApiRef from "./components/ApiRef.jsx";
import Footer from "./components/Footer.jsx";

export default function App() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1, wheelMultiplier: 1 });
    let raf = 0;
    const loop = (t) => {
      lenis.raf(t);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      lenis.destroy();
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-void text-bone antialiased">
      <Nav />
      <main>
        <Hero />
        <Lab />
        <Terminal />
        <VoteDemo />
        <Leaderboard />
        <Bracket />
        <Roadmap />
        <Faq />
        <ApiRef />
      </main>
      <Footer />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const LINKS = [
  ["#lab", "Sharp lab"],

  ["#vote", "Blind vote"],

export default function Nav() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 24);
    onScroll();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
  }, []);

  return (
    <header
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-50 transition-all duration-300",
        scrolled ? "border-b-2 border-ink bg-ember/90 backdrop-blur-md" : "bg-transparent"
      )}
    >
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-6xl items-center gap-3 px-4 sm:px-6">

          <span className="rounded-lg border-2 border-ink bg-cream p-1 shadow-card-sm">
            <Logo size={22} />
          </span>
          <span className="font-display text-[13px] font-bold tracking-[0.14em] text-ink">
            STICKBLADE ARENA
          </span>
        </a>

        <nav className="ml-6 hidden items-center gap-1 xl:flex" aria-label="Primary">
          {LINKS.map(([href, label]) => (
            <a
              key={href}
              href={href}
              className="rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-[13px] font-bold text-ink/80 transition-colors hover:bg-ink/10 hover:text-ink"
            >
              {label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </nav>

        <div className="ml-auto hidden items-center gap-2 xl:flex">
          <a
            href="https://github.com/Cometbuster4969/STICKBLADE-ARENA"
            target="_blank"

            GitHub

            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border-2 border-ink bg-ink px-4 py-2 text-[13px] font-bold text-cream shadow-card-sm transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-x-[2px] active:translate-y-[2px] active:shadow-none"

ui.jsx

import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export function Reveal({ children, delay = 0, className, y = 28 }) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      className={className}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y }}
      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      viewport={{ once: true, margin: "-80px" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.7, delay, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export function SectionHead({ eyebrow, title, sub, align = "center", dark = false }) {
  return (
    <Reveal className={cn("mb-10 max-w-2xl", align === "center" ? "mx-auto text-center" : "text-left")}>
      <p className={cn("eyebrow inline-block rounded-md border-2 px-3 py-1", dark ? "border-cream/30 text-gold" : "border-ink bg-cream text-ink shadow-card-sm")}>
        {eyebrow}
      </p>
      <h2 className={cn("mt-4 font-display text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl", dark ? "text-cream" : "text-ink")}>
        {title}
      </h2>
      {sub && <p className={cn("mt-3 text-[15px] leading-relaxed", dark ? "text-cream/70" : "text-cocoa")}>{sub}</p>}
    </Reveal>
  );
}

export function Logo({ size = 30, light = false }) {
  const blade = light ? "#fff6ea" : "#210d02";
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M22.5 22.5 9.5 9.5" stroke="#ff5a1f" strokeWidth="3.2" strokeLinecap="round" />
      <path d="M9.5 9.5l2.8-2.8L11 11.5z" fill="#ff5a1f" />
      <path d="M9.5 22.5l13-13" stroke={blade} strokeWidth="3.2" strokeLinecap="round" />
      <path d="M22.5 9.5l-2.8-2.8L21 11.5z" fill={blade} />
      <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="2.2" fill={light ? "#ffc24d" : "#210d02"} />
    </svg>
  );
}

Terminal.jsx
JS
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Play, Pause, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { TERMINAL_LINES } from "../data";
import { Reveal, SectionHead } from "./ui";

const LINE_MS = 420;

export default function Terminal() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(true);
  const timer = useRef(null);

  const tick = useCallback(() => {
    setCount((c) => {
      if (c >= TERMINAL_LINES.length) {
        setPlaying(false);
        return c;
      }
      return c + 1;
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    timer.current = setInterval(tick, LINE_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(timer.current);
  }, [playing, tick]);

  useEffect(() => () => clearInterval(timer.current), []);

  const restart = () => {
    setCount(0);
    setPlaying(true);
  };

  return (
    <section id="terminal" className="relative scroll-mt-20 border-y-2 border-ink bg-choco py-20 sm:py-28">
      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 sm:px-6">
        <SectionHead
          dark
          eyebrow="Full transparency"
          title="This is exactly what the model sees."
          sub="No pixels, no vibes — a JSON observation every turn. Same input for both fighters, every time. That's what makes it a benchmark."
        />

        <Reveal className="mx-auto max-w-2xl overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border-2 border-cream/25 bg-black shadow-pop">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-cream/15 bg-choco2 px-4 py-2.5">
            <span className="flex gap-1.5">
              <i className="block size-2.5 rounded-full bg-blood" />
              <i className="block size-2.5 rounded-full bg-gold" />
              <i className="block size-2.5 rounded-full bg-mintbright" />
            </span>
            <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-[11px] text-cream/50">observation.turn_12.json</span>
            <span className="ml-auto flex gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => (count >= TERMINAL_LINES.length ? restart() : setPlaying((p) => !p))}
                aria-label={playing ? "Pause reveal" : "Play reveal"}
                className="cursor-pointer rounded-md border border-cream/25 p-1.5 text-cream/70 transition-colors hover:border-gold hover:text-gold"
              >
                {playing ? <Pause size={13} /> : <Play size={13} />}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={restart}
                aria-label="Restart reveal"
                className="cursor-pointer rounded-md border border-cream/25 p-1.5 text-cream/70 transition-colors hover:border-gold hover:text-gold"
              >
                <RotateCcw size={13} />
              </button>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="min-h-[290px] p-5 font-mono text-[12.5px] leading-[1.9] sm:text-[13.5px]" aria-live="polite">
            {TERMINAL_LINES.slice(0, count).map((line, i) => (
              <p key={i} className="whitespace-pre-wrap">
                <span className="mr-3 text-cream/30 tabular">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
                <Colored json={line} />
              </p>
            ))}
            {count < TERMINAL_LINES.length && (
              <p>
                <span className="mr-3 text-cream/30 tabular">{String(count + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
                <span className="inline-block h-4 w-2 animate-blink bg-ember align-middle" />
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </Reveal>

        <Reveal delay={0.1} className="mx-auto mt-6 grid max-w-2xl gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {[
            ["Identical inputs", "Both models, same JSON"],
            ["Legal-move list", "No invalid actions, ever"],
            ["Full replay logs", "Every turn downloadable"],
          ].map(([t, s]) => (
            <div key={t} className="rounded-xl border-2 border-cream/20 bg-choco2 px-4 py-3 text-center">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-cream">{t}</p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-cream/60">{s}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </Reveal>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/** Minimal JSON syntax tinting: keys gold, strings mint, numbers ember. */
function Colored({ json }) {
  const parts = json.split(/("[^"]*")/g);
  return (
    <>
      {parts.map((p, i) => {
        if (/^"/.test(p)) {
          const isKey = /:$/.test(parts[i + 1] || "");
          return (
            <span key={i} className={isKey ? "text-gold" : "text-mintbright"}>
              {p}
            </span>
          );
        }
        return (
          <span key={i} className="text-cream/60">
            {p.split(/(\b\d+\.?\d*\b)/g).map((q, j) =>
              /^\d/.test(q) ? (
                <span key={j} className="text-ember">
                  {q}
                </span>
              ) : (
                q
              )
            )}
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

JS
import { useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { WEAPONS, ZONES, ARENAS, DOCTRINES } from "../data";
import { Reveal, SectionHead } from "./ui";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

function doctrineFor(sharpCount) {
  if (sharpCount === 0) return DOCTRINES.pillow;
  if (sharpCount === 1) return DOCTRINES.fencer;
  if (sharpCount === 2) return DOCTRINES.brawler;
  return DOCTRINES.chaos;
}

export default function Lab() {
  const [weapon, setWeapon] = useState(WEAPONS[0]);
  const [sharp, setSharp] = useState(["tip"]);
  const [arena, setArena] = useState(ARENAS[0]);
  const doctrine = doctrineFor(sharp.length);

  const toggle = (id) =>
    setSharp((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((z) => z !== id) : [...prev, id]));

  return (
    <section id="lab" className="relative scroll-mt-20 py-20 sm:py-28">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 sm:px-6">
        <SectionHead
          eyebrow="Sharp-zone lab"
          title="You decide what's sharp. The meta obeys."
          sub="Only the zones you select deal lethal damage — everything else is blunt and mostly just pushes. This single choice decides the whole duel."
        />

        <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
          {/* weapon + arena picker */}
          <Reveal className="rounded-2xl border-2 border-ink bg-cream p-5 shadow-card sm:p-6">
            <p className="eyebrow text-[10px] text-cocoa">01 · Pick a weapon</p>
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2">
              {WEAPONS.map((w) => (
                <button
                  key={w.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setWeapon(w)}
                  aria-pressed={weapon.id === w.id}
                  className={cn(
                    "cursor-pointer rounded-xl border-2 p-3 text-left transition-all",
                    weapon.id === w.id
                      ? "border-ink bg-ink text-cream shadow-card-sm"
                      : "border-ink/20 bg-creamdark/50 hover:border-ink"
                  )}
                >
                  <span className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className={cn("font-display text-sm font-bold", weapon.id === w.id ? "text-cream" : "text-ink")}>
                      {w.name}
                    </span>
                    <span className={cn("rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 font-display text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest uppercase", weapon.id === w.id ? "bg-gold text-ink" : "bg-ink/10 text-cocoa")}>
                      {w.tag}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                  <span className={cn("mt-1 block text-[13px] leading-relaxed", weapon.id === w.id ? "text-cream/75" : "text-cocoa")}>
                    {w.desc}
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <p className="eyebrow mt-6 text-[10px] text-cocoa">02 · Pick an arena</p>
            <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {ARENAS.map((a) => (
                <button
                  key={a.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setArena(a)}
                  aria-pressed={arena.id === a.id}
                  title={a.desc}
                  className={cn(
                    "cursor-pointer rounded-xl border-2 px-2 py-3 text-center transition-all",
                    arena.id === a.id ? "border-ink bg-ink text-cream shadow-card-sm" : "border-ink/20 bg-creamdark/50 hover:border-ink"
                  )}
                >
                  <span className={cn("block font-display text-sm font-bold", arena.id === a.id ? "text-cream" : "text-ink")}>
                    {a.name}
                  </span>
                  <span className={cn("mt-1 block text-[11px] leading-snug", arena.id === a.id ? "text-cream/75" : "text-cocoa")}>
                    {a.desc}
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Reveal>

          {/* blade + doctrine */}
          <Reveal delay={0.1} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border-2 border-ink bg-cream p-5 shadow-card sm:p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <p className="eyebrow text-[10px] text-cocoa">03 · Toggle lethal zones</p>
                <p className="rounded-md bg-ink px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-gold tabular">
                  {sharp.length} of {ZONES.length} lethal
                </p>
              </div>
              <Blade sharp={sharp} onToggle={toggle} />
              <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
                {ZONES.map((z) => {
                  const on = sharp.includes(z.id);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={z.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => toggle(z.id)}
                      aria-pressed={on}
                      className={cn(
                        "cursor-pointer rounded-lg border-2 px-2 py-2.5 text-center transition-all",
                        on ? "border-ink bg-ink text-cream shadow-card-sm" : "border-ink/20 bg-creamdark/50 text-cocoa hover:border-ink"
                      )}
                    >
                      <span className="block font-display text-xs font-bold tracking-wider uppercase">
                        {on ? "✓ " : "· "}{z.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] opacity-80">{on ? "lethal" : "blunt"}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-cocoa">
                A fast sharp hit to the head is an instant kill — so arming the{" "}
                <b className="text-ink">tip</b> alone plays nothing like arming everything.
              </p>
            </div>

            <motion.div
              key={doctrine.name + sharp.length}
              initial={{ opacity: 0.4, scale: 0.99 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.35 }}
              className="rounded-2xl border-2 border-ink bg-ink p-5 shadow-card sm:p-6"
            >
              <p className="eyebrow text-[10px] text-cream/60">Resulting doctrine</p>
              <p className="mt-2 font-display text-3xl font-bold" style={{ color: doctrine.name === "Fencer" ? "#46c98a" : doctrine.name === "Brawler" ? "#ffc24d" : doctrine.name === "Chaos" ? "#ff6b4a" : "#ffe3c7" }}>
                {doctrine.name}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-cream/75">{doctrine.line}</p>
              <p className="mt-3 font-mono text-xs text-cream/50">
                {weapon.name} · {arena.name} · sharp: [{sharp.length ? sharp.join(", ") : "none"}]
              </p>
            </motion.div>
          </Reveal>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Blade({ sharp, onToggle }) {
  const on = (id) => sharp.includes(id);
  const seg = (id, x, w, label) => (
    <g
      onClick={() => onToggle(id)}
      className="cursor-pointer"
      role="button"
      aria-pressed={on(id)}
      aria-label={`Toggle ${label} zone`}
      tabIndex={0}
      onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && onToggle(id)}
    >
      <rect
        x={x}
        y={28}
        width={w}
        height={22}
        rx={3}
        fill={on(id) ? "#210d02" : "#ffe3c7"}
        stroke="#210d02"
        strokeWidth={2}
        style={{ transition: "fill 0.25s" }}
      />
      <text x={x + w / 2} y={43} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9} fontWeight={700} fill={on(id) ? "#ffc24d" : "#6b3a1d"}>
        {label}
      </text>
    </g>
  );
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 420 78" className="mt-4 w-full" role="img" aria-label="Blade with toggleable sharp zones">
      <rect x={30} y={16} width={10} height={46} rx={2} fill="#210d02" />
      <rect x={4} y={30} width={26} height={18} rx={4} fill="#fff6ea" stroke="#210d02" strokeWidth={2} />
      {seg("pommel", 42, 76, "POMMEL")}
      {seg("backedge", 122, 84, "BACK")}
